row.name: 奕剑江湖
row.detailed_description: Gameplay This is a game that combines the jungle melee of Warcraft and the self-propelled chess. The game has 8 players, who fight in a jungle map, and the one with the highest score wins the game. Heroes are mainly divided into three categories: Strength, Agility, and Intelligence. Each hero has different speeds and attributes, as well as different attack trajectories, attack ranges, attack types, armor types, and talent skills. Players need to constantly build their own skill combinations through development during the game process, achieving a series of skills with additional effects. At the same time, there is a mutual restraint relationship between skills, and constantly thinking about their own construction strategy while competing for development is the key to winning the game. Game Features Skills rivalry: there is a clear mutual restraint between skills Type Restriction: The restriction of attack type and armor type (applicable to all damage) Talent Incompatibility: Heroes have different talents, which are mutually incompatible The above three situations may vary depending on the circumstances, so there is no fixed so-called invincible routine in the later stages. Constantly changing heroes and skills is a way to counter the enemy, and teamwork is the foundation for victory.
row.short_description: It combines the self-driving chess and the classic Warcraft RPG jungle melee gameplay, and has both PC and mobile versions.

row.name: Politon: Prologue
row.detailed_description: Have a Look at the Full Version! About the Game 'Politon: Prologue' is the free prologue version of 'Politon'. This prologue includes a tutorial, game mechanics, and the prologue of the main story inside. Only Single-player modes are available. Politon Politon is a turn-based strategy game with easy-to-understand mechanics and various game modes. Whether you want to defeat your friends online by employing your strategies or enjoy single-player game modes, Politon offers a variety of hex-based maps with different terrains. You'll need to manage your economy while expanding your territories and defend your region against rival invasions. Are you ready to experience the joy of utilizing countless strategies using Politon's simple and profound game mechanics? Multiplayer Through the online gaming experience, you can engage in battles with your friends or opponents from across the world. By creating your own online game lobby, you can customize turn mechanics and various map types according to your preferences. In the 'Challenge' mode, you can test yourself against players worldwide who have made it to the leaderboards, competing for rankings and trying your skills against various mechanics. Single Player In the Scenario mode, you can progress through Politon's story and get to know the world of Politon closely. With a rich pool of characters, you'll have hours of gameplay ahead of you as you witness events unfolding in the kingdom. In the 'Skirmish' mode, you can practice without entering online battles, developing your new strategies, and getting familiar with different map types. Gameplay and Mechanics Politon offers two different turn mechanics: Standard and Arena. The game features 4 unit types, 3 building types, and hex grid maps waiting to be conquered. The unit types are arranged from weakest to strongest: Peasant, Militia, Baron, and Knight. Each hex grid allows placing one unit or building, and each unit has one movement point per turn. To afford the cost of units and their maintenance, you must expand your territory and strengthen your economy by building Farms. You can opt to place Outposts or Watchtowers to form defensive lines. Enhance your economy by collecting resources from the terrain or strategically spreading your influence by waiting for a few turns. The joy of victory lies in achieving the highest score or eliminating all your opponents, depending on the game mode. We are working hard on Politon, and you can join our Discord channel to stay updated about the latest updates! [/url][/p][p][] [/url][/p

row.name: Rebellion Against Rebellion
row.detailed_description: Immerse yourself in the indie MMORPG, Rebellion Against Rebellion! Explore the world of magic and mystique, where magical crystals shape your destiny. Acquire magical abilities, collect characters and pets during epic adventures! Join now and be part of an uplifting, enchanting journey! Players will unravel the game's story and events through missions. The narrative begins in the distant past, gradually approaching the present. It revolves around a young boy who becomes ensnared by the power of dark magic. His actions, in turn, incur the wrath of seven titans. Mistakes he makes jeopardize his life. However, it's crucial to remember that this young boy will later become the dark mage whom players must confront in a later stage of the game. After overcoming an enemy you can gain its form or a pet. You can play with learned characters and switch shapes at any time. Pets need to be developed individually, assisting you in battles during your adventures. You'll have the opportunity to trade with other players in the auction house. Manufactured characters, pets, and materials can be sold. Gold acquired in the game can be used for purchases or tried at dice poker for luck. You can form a Guild with your friends to participate in the game as a team. We have eliminated World XP in the game. XP necessary for progression can be obtained by completing missions, learning characters, and pets. You can build on your own territory, limited only by your imagination. Choose from over 400 building elements that you can craft. You can showcase your built empire to your friends within the game. You just need to be in the same party. Magical crystals and essences dominate the entire game. Acquiring them allows you to craft items or enhance your power. During adventures, you can enter random dungeons or face massive challenges in PVP grounds.
row.short_description: Dive into the indie MMORPG, Rebellion Against Rebellion! Embark on a magical journey in a world of enchantment, shaped by mystical crystals. Acquire magical abilities, collect characters, and pets on epic adventures! Join now for an uplifting, enchanting experience!

row.name: Life Eternal
row.detailed_description: A necromancer awakens in a dilapidated tower he once knew as a pristine stronghold for his lord and sorcerer that he was apprenticed under. Somehow, the necromancer slept through it all in a sleep so sound, not even his lord's death woke him up. But that's all right; his lord had foreseen this coming and made sure the necromancer had the knowledge and training so he could raise his dead lord all on his own.                                                                  Now, it is up to you to help the necromancer collect the spell and tools necessary to bring his lord back to life so that he may take revenge on those who sought him harm. Although, perhaps, his lord's death could signify another kind of rebirth. Life Eternal is a story-driven adventure game with a focus on exploration and no battles, from the developer behind the cult classic Star Stealing Prince. Uncover the secrets left behind by your lord's death and piece together the necromancer's own fragmented memories to find your answers. There are two endings facilitated by a choice at the end.                                         KEYBOARD Arrow Keys - Movement (hold SHIFT to dash!) Z - Confirm & Interact with objects X - Cancel & Open your main menu S - Displays guide arrows Q & W - Scroll Up and Scroll Down in menus XBOX CONTROLLER D-Pad - Movement (hold X to dash!) A - Confirm & Interact with objects B - Cancel Y - Open your main menu LB & RB - Scroll Up and Scroll Down in menus MOUSE Left-Click - Confirm, Move to clicked area & interact with objects Right-Click - Cancel & Open your main menu Scroll Wheel - Scroll Up and Down in menus
row.short_description: A lonely necromancer awakens in a dilapidated tower with one goal: to revive his lord and get revenge on those who sought him harm. row.name: Truth
row.detailed_description: (HEADPHONES EXTREMELY SUGGESTED) Truth is a 3D, First Person, Horror Game, created by an indie game developer, who goes by the name Blight. In this game you are a detective, the best in your department. Things have been going awfully grey for you in the past week, your wife was away on one of her dreadful work trips, you had no interesting cases, and some idiot just called you at 2 AM. When you picked up the phone, you realized quickly that it was your Captain, calling you from the department. He briefed you quickly on some disturbance at a luxurious hotel known as Cenivard Hotel. An evacuation took place and lots of survivors made it out screaming and yelling about some odd robot with minimalistic designs, going around causing DREAD. Your boss continued on with the story mentioning that a SWAT team was sent into the hotel to take care of the threat, but they were never seen again. After this incident, the police came up with their next idea, sending only one officer inside, on a stealth mission in order to find the hotel owner, to get his keys to lock down the building and secure the threat. That's when your boss offered you the case, which you accepted. Once you made it to the scene, one survivor grabbed your arm and quickly said to you. 'Don't run, don't panic. He can hear you... When the lights go out, and all goes dark, he lurks.' Then, the survivor quickly handed you a flashlight. 'This flashlight saved my life, it might save yours too', said the survivor. 'But the only thing that is more important than life, is the TRUTH', he finished saying before abruptly leaving. After standing there with a bit of confusion, you slipped the flashlight into your pocket with no regards and walked into the hotel. But what you quickly learned is that your mission was about be a lot more treacherous than you thought.
row.short_description: A horror game where you are in a hotel with an entity that only comes out in the dark. Your goal is to find the hotel owner hidden somewhere among the rooms...

row.name: Mist
row.detailed_description: Weird things can happen on the road... A short, simple first person horror game about exploring area in the middle of nowhere to get help with repairing your car and continuing your path. Your only real enemy here is mist that shrouds the whole forest and does something weird with anyone who end up getting lost here... On your way you'll find forester's cabin but, unfortunately, there's no one home, so you better go looking for its owner, maybe he'll know how to help or have a phone so that you can make a call. You'll stumble upon different places, be it an abandoned meteostation or radiotower, but the longer you stay here the more the mist is taking control over you. Eventually you'll find something that shouldn't be here: places that have no connection to the forest you are in, voices from nowhere that tell about their lives and...weird figures in the distance. To get out of here you'll need to use various items, from the classic indie horror shotgun to defend yourself to the radio receiver that'll help you to navigate through the forest to find important locations. Be aware that your resources are quite limited and you'll need to utilize everything you'll find in order to succeed and get out of here. Game has several various endings, each one depends on your actions in the playthrough: dialogue choices you make, and amount of sheer boldness of your actions in defending yourself and finding your way out.
row.short_description: Short atmospheric first person horror game with elements of quest and shooter about being lost in the middle of nowhere, surrounded by weird mist.

row.name: Aviators VR
row.detailed_description: 'Aviators VR' builds on the foundation of 'Aviators,' delivering an expanded gaming adventure. The experience is divided into two parts - arcade and educational . The arcade portion gives players a chance to control the upper turret gun of a Handley Page Halifax bomber to fend off attacks from German fighter planes. This highly realistic and immersive segment allows players to interact with the Boulton-Paul Type C Mk. II’s electro-hydraulic mechanism. The educational section lets players explore a virtual hangar of the Polish air wing at one of the British bases. Here, players can experience a guided audio tour, which walks them through the exhibits, such as the Handley Page Halifax bomber and the legendary Spitfire MK.VB manned by Jan Zumbach, while providing historical context for the arcade segment.
row.short_description: A concise VR experience inspired by the game 'Aviators.' Take control of the upper turret gun on a bomber and fend off attacks from German fighters. Visit a virtual hangar of the Polish air wing and learn more about the events depicted in the game.

row.name: Pigbook

Bacon resides in a temple trying to achieve some spiritual growth. The peace is disturbed by the outside world and Bacon leaves on a quest to return the 'Sunshine' island pig community to their previous state of life. Going against the world and an attempt to challenge the Dragon leads Bacon to injury. Once he recovers the world has already moved on but there is still faith in Bacon to reach a state of peace and enlightenment. GAME FEATURES: A nonlinear pixelart platformer with metroidvania elements. Jump on enemies to collect gems for which to buy items in shop or run trough and collect level progression items to reach and defeat 6 of the game bosses. Read pig npc dialogues and books for clues and find the final exit. Make Combo jumps for higher score. Your feedback and comments would help to improve the game. Thanks for your support!

row.name: On the Bubble
row.detailed_description: Join the Ballers Join our community discord, where you can provide feedback and talk to other players. But that's not all! You can also provide feedback, report bugs, and talk to the developers! Join Now! About the Game NOTE: This game only runs on ray-tracing supported hardware! Balling in a Dystopian Future We are in a dystopian cyberpunk society, where the government took the idea of basic human rights to the extreme, putting everyone from birth into huge protective bubbles. This way the security of life is 100% guaranteed, as human life is 'the most valuable thing'. However, the young generation is not buying this shit, how can a life with no threat be exciting? The outgoing trend emerges: punks and youth start a deadly race in which each contestant can finally feel alive rather than just living. Fast-paced Gameplay Move the ball to the finish by tilting the level and going through obstacles that challenge your precision and timing skills. Find the fastest way to complete exciting levels and be the best on the leaderboards. Level Editor (Not in Early Access) An easy-to-use level editing tool with extensive options to express your creativity and challenge the community. Create a level, upload it, and watch gamers compete for first place on the leaderboards. Use a wide variety of level elements in any combination to create your works of art. Stunning Visuals Experience next-level graphics using cutting-edge ray tracing technology providing the most realistic global illumination. The use of custom tech brings the game world to life and enhances the immersive experience. Custom Tech This game is created by a group of students on a custom engine made over the course of a year using the latest research into real-time path tracing technology. In addition, the engine features fully custom physics specifically tweaked to enhance the balling experience.
row.short_description: Inspired by old-school platforming games, On the Bubble is an action-packed 3D platformer for fans of fast-paced games. The level editor allows anyone to make and share their own creations to be completed at breakneck speeds.

row.name: Atan
row.detailed_description: Join our community! Atan is a student project made by a passionate team from Breda University of Applied Sciences. We want to hear what you think of the game! Feel free to join and share your opinion and give us feedback so we can improve the game. We are looking forward to hear from you! About the Game The Game Atan is an action-adventure game where you traverse a massive colossus. Use your climbing skills together with your bow and anchors to journey over the massive giant. But beware, because this rough terrain contains many challenges, for the colossus itself is still alive and in need of your help. The Story There exists an ancient, colossal creature, who holds up the sky. Living on this giant’s back is an unassuming child, who is about to embark on the journey of a lifetime. Travel up the colossus, traverse various challenges and dangerous obstacles, and meet various inhabitants of the colossus.
row.short_description: Scale a massive colossus in this action-adventure climbing game. Find your way through atmospheric scenery and master your climbing skills. Atan was made by third year students of Breda University. Winner of the 2025 BAFTA Student Award!

row.name: Hive Dive
row.detailed_description: The Game Get ready to dive into the valley and defend it from the mysterious threat in Hive Dive! This endless-running on-rails shooter is set in a futuristic 2050s Patagonia that invaders have taken over. Your mission is to restore Patagonia's freedom! Kill as many enemies as you can and get the highest score. This game/proof of concept was created by Breda University of Applied Sciences students
row.short_description: An endless-running on-rail shooter where you pilot a remote-controlled drone into hordes of enemies. Shoot down the invaders, fly through colorful Patagonia, and get the highest score!

row.name: Sicaria
row.detailed_description: Join our Discord server! About the Game ​Step into the shadows of Antwerp and shapes events during this crucial moment. Sicaria is a third-person stealth game set in ​Antwerp during the Eighty Years' War. You play as an engineer, a person capable of overcoming any challenge through your own cleverness. Because of the war you lost an arm, but you were able to build a mechanical one. ​ ​ Stealth-Centric Gameplay​ Emphasize stealth and infiltration as the primary gameplay interaction. Use the environment and your skills to remain hidden and accomplish missions undetected to avoid death. Historical Setting​ You are immersed in a realistic reconstruction of the city during the Eighty Years’ War. You feel inside a dangerous urban warfare. ​ Use the city structure to your advantage, explore multiple pathways and take advantage of the verticality.​
row.short_description: Antwerp 1576, Spanish Fury is putting the city to the sword. You intend to stop the atrocities by eliminating the menace. ​Sicaria is a FREE game made by third year students from Breda University.
row.notes: The player can choose to dispatch enemies by killing them using a blade.

row.name: Shred Off
row.detailed_description: This Game is a Student Project that has ended development! In this 3rd-person action snowboarding shooter, you perform Stylish tricks in the deserted Alaskan mountains while gunning down enemies with an arsenal of ranged weaponry. Shred down the mountains on your snowboard to get a high score while competing against your friends!  FAST-PACED ARCADE ACTION High-octane action with fast-paced gameplay - Shred down the Alaskan mountains while bullets, explosions, and even lightning fly past you as you do tricks. Every flashy action rewards you with points as you make your way downhill. Snowboarding with GUNS As you are doing tricks in the air and carving snow on the ground, engage in combat with 4 different enemies looking to stop you in any way possible. Shoot at them with your trusty revolver or any special pickup weapons in the level. Join our Community! Join our Discord Server to chat with other competitors and see how you stand with your rivals!
row.short_description: In this 3rd-person action, snowboarding shooter, perform Stylish tricks in the Alaskan mountains while gunning down enemies with an arsenal of ranged weaponry. Shred down the mountain on your snowboard to get a high score while competing against your friends!
row.notes: The primary objective in the game is to kill enemy opponents with ranged weaponry. The game will have the player kill enemies who fall down into ragdoll after being killed.

row.name: Iron Line
row.detailed_description: As a veteran conductor traversing the IronLine you have been tasked with a final mission. The final station is on the brink of destruction and you are to deliver life-saving cargo. The IronLine is a unforgiving and harsh environment crawled with bugs and other monstrosities. You have been given permission to use any means necessary to defend your cargo. With turrets at your disposal you are to travel down the track disposing anything that dares to takes you cargo. Place, upgrade or even change layouts to reach that final destination. Student Game Iron Line is proudly made over the span of 12 weeks by 9 second year students from Breda University of Applied Sciences.
row.short_description: Iron Line is a tower defense game where you are one of a few, train conductors capable of traversing on the Iron Line. Will you survive the onslaught, or get an express ticket to the afterlife?

row.name: Orienteering Simulator
row.detailed_description: 🧭 Orienteering Simulator 🧭 Version: v.1.1 Martinsflue (Release) 🔰 - Learn how to orientate yourself in this friendly environment. In 'Find-Posts'-Mode, you will have to find your target using a compass and a map, while in 'Orienteering'-Mode, you have to pinpoint your location on the map. 🔓 Choose between multiple maps, gamemodes, weather conditions & more to create your personalized experience. Fulfill achievements to unlock new compasses that you can use during your explorations. ⬆️Update! Check out the new map 'Martinsflue'! Orientate in a harsh environment containing lots of height difference, stones and winding paths. Want even more fun? Try out the Martinsflue-Extra-Map's 'Stones-Only', 'Contour-Lines-Only' or 'Paths-Only'!
row.short_description: Orienteering Simulator is a Singleplayer-Game that focusses on the same-named sport 'Orienteering'. Use a compass and a map to find your targets in a friendly 3D-Environment.

row.name: NIGHT-RUNNERS™ PROLOGUE
row.detailed_description: DESCEND INTO THE UNDERWORLD OF JAPANESE STREET RACING Set in an unknown time between 1990-2009, you will navigate through the corrupt and shady power struggles of local street racing crews, all competing for control of their regions and to top the crew rankings. Extremely detailed customization, including Exterior, Interior, Wheels, Engine, and Handling Dynamic character dialogue; other racers will comment on your car, your recent races, new local records and your progression Full Photomode with VHS, old camera effects and motion blur Freely walk around your garage and the car meet (Parking Area) between races Adjustable screenshake and camera FOV Procedural game event scripting, high replay value Inspired by the real life Japanese used car auctions, you will purchase your first vehicle by visiting the used car auctions and leaving with any decrepit car you can afford. Walk around your safehouse and view all your hard-earned cars; change their oil, repair their engines and view their stats. Good maintenance will help your engine last longer after a long night of abuse and overheating. Take parts off your cars, place them into storage and sell them for some extra cash or transfer them onto another vehicle you own. When you have some spare cash, take a trip to 'Top Garage' to buy some new parts for your exterior, interior, wheels, engine and/or handling. Progress through the underworld by entering a 'PA'(Parking Area) and start negotiating wagers with any local crew members who care to race you. You are free to walk around any 'PA' and bask in the thick atmosphere of smog and secondhand cigarette smoke. The local racers are not impressed with newcomers and will make their disdain known. Impress them by winning and they will change their tone. Earn cash by beating racers in 1vs1 wagers but be warned; these are real wagers and you will lose the money you bet if you lose the race! Some racers will take pity on you and give you a chance to win your money back by suggesting a 'double or nothing' race. It's your choice if you want to take that risk.
row.short_description: Descend into the underworld of Japanese street racing. Set between 1990-2009, join the local street racing crews in their battle for territory control. Explore the real location open world(s), compete in wager races, battle other crews and upgrade your vehicles with detailed car customization.
row.notes: References to alcohol and tobacco consumption, depictions of dangerous driving and foul language.

row.name: Palia
row.detailed_description: Join Our Community! About the Game Welcome to Palia, The Fantasy Life Sim Adventure For You and Your Friends! Discover a welcoming world in Palia, a free-to-play fantasy life sim adventure where you can craft, explore, and create the life and home of your dreams. With nearly endless ways to make Palia your home, you’ll find relaxation and joy in every corner of this vibrant, heartwarming world. Live Your Fantasy Dream Life Dive into a world rich with adventure and lore. Complete quests that reveal the secrets of Ancient Humans, deepen your connections with Palia’s Villagers, and help shape the story around you. Craft, Build, and Make Memories Together Design your ideal space with near limitless possibilities! Craft items, place Building Blocks, and landscape with Yardwork Decor to create a home that’s uniquely yours, both inside and out. Display your creativity and join Home Tours to get inspired by the community's incredible designs. Discover the Secrets of Elderwood, an Ancient Magical Forest Explore a dense, magical forest filled with surprises around every corner. Discover new artifacts, creatures, insects, and more when you unveil Elderwood's mysteries with friends. Celebrate with Events and Minigames Join in on exciting in-game events and activities, such as the bustling Maji Market, or get cozy in the Underground Black Market playing the Hot Pot card game with friends. With events, minigames, and seasonal content year-round, there’s always something fresh to enjoy that will keep you coming back. Build Lasting Relationships Grow meaningful relationships with lovable Villagers or team up with fellow adventurers for unforgettable journeys. Chill out by collecting and trading irresistibly adorable Plushies, Potato Pods, and Stickers, fostering friendships one collectible at a time. Explore, Gather, and Thrive Wander through Kilima Valley, Bahari Bay, and the Elderwood to gather rare insects, forage for ingredients, and enjoy the scenic beauty of Palia. Tend to your home plot, nurture your garden, and live your dream life. Your Adventure, Your Way Whether solo or with friends, Palia is a place where you’re always welcome. Discover a cozy community filled with new friends, enchanting magic, shared adventures, and endless charm.
row.short_description: Discover a welcoming world in Palia, a free-to-play fantasy life sim adventure where you can craft, explore, and create the life and home of your dreams. With nearly endless ways to make Palia your home, you’ll find relaxation and joy in every corner of this vibrant, heartwarming world.

row.name: Grudge
row.detailed_description: Dive into Grudge, a boundless fantasy sandbox MMO that redefines adventure. Whether you’re slaying world bosses, crafting epic gear, or commanding siege armies, every choice carves your path in a vibrant, player-driven world. With a unique blend of MMORPG, survival, and RTS gameplay, Grudge offers endless possibilities: Epic MMORPG Adventures Embark on thrilling quests and conquer challenging dungeons. Level up skills, customize stats, and master intricate skill trees. Team up in parties, join guilds, or dominate in PvP arenas. Ride majestic mounts, tame loyal pets, and hunt for legendary gear. Choose your allegiance among 6 races and 3 warring factions. Survival Crafting & Exploration Gather resources through woodcutting, mining, fishing, and hunting. Build and upgrade strongholds, from humble camps to sprawling fortresses. Cook, smelt, and craft gear, consumables, or massive siege weapons. Explore open-world monuments and scavenge loot—but beware, death means risking it all. Real-Time Strategy & Warfare Construct armories to train guards, mercenaries, and towering defenses. Build ships, vehicles, and catapults to dominate land and sea. Lead NPC armies and siege enemy strongholds in massive open-world battles. Form alliances or wage war to claim territory and glory. From forging alliances to razing enemy castles, Grudge blends the best of fantasy MMORPGs, survival crafting, and strategic warfare. Auction rare items, store treasures in banks, or research powerful gear to gain the edge. Whether you play solo, with friends, or against the world, your story awaits. Join the fight. Build your empire. Become a legend in Grudge. Key Features Dynamic open-world sandbox with PvE and PvP. Deep crafting, building, and resource systems. 6 races, 3 factions, and endless customization. Dungeons, world bosses, and epic loot. Siege warfare with player-controlled NPCs and vehicles. Regular updates and community-driven development. Wish-list Grudge now and join our Discord to shape the future of this epic MMO! Your adventure begins soon—prepare to forge your destiny.
row.short_description: Grudge is a thrilling fantasy MMO sandbox where your choices shape a living world. Explore, fight, build, and conquer in an adventure that fuses MMORPG depth, survival crafting, and real-time strategy. Forge your legacy alone or with friends—will you rise as a hero, a warlord, or a legend?

row.name: The Curse of the Egyptian Pyramid "Remaster Edition"
row.detailed_description: Under the control of a mysterious organization, two scientists with experience in research missions are sent to Egypt. According to rumors: in one of the places of Egypt there was a monstrous earthquake, and a mysterious pyramid appeared out of nowhere at the crash site. From all nearby settlements, one by one, people began to mysteriously disappear. All sorts of attempts to study the inside of the pyramid ended in failure, because no research expedition returned back. Now two researchers with good work experience will have to explore the pyramid, taking with them devices that can protect them from dangers. The player is provided with several unique opportunities and solutions to situations. Neon sticks. You have 10 sticks with you. Discarded sticks can be picked up. Use them to light your way, not get lost in mazes and much more. Journal. Characters often write down the tasks they need to complete there. Also, they mark themselves with hints that can help the player advance further. Cameras with an ultrasonic barrier. Using these cameras, the player will be able to see spirits, ghosts and anomalies. If the ghost is weak, then the player can adopt an USB (UltraSonic Barrier) that is able to expel or kill evil spirits. Note: If you see a creature without cameras, run! Such a creature cannot be driven away. Hide and seek. To avoid or hide from the chase from some enemies, use shelters.
row.short_description: A first-person horror game about Egypt. Explore the scary secret of the mysterious pyramid. In order to protect the heroes from danger, the player can use the characters' cameras to see a ghostly entity and anomalies invisible to the human eye.

row.name: Vampires: Bloodlord Rising - Diaries
row.detailed_description: We will show you a bloody good time. From established historical facts about the origins of vampire myths to lesser known information about the blood sucking creatures of nightmares this digital magazine will give you something to sink your teeth in if you are a fan of Count Dracula, Vlad the Impaler, Nosferatu or other sharp-fanged beasts. Add to that an exiciting look behind the scenes of the development of the anticipated new game and get to know the lore of the fictitious Balkan area of Sangavia as well as the mysterious characters you are going to meet. Enjoy the first issue free-of-charge! Further issues will be arriving in irregular intervals and subject to a charge.
row.short_description: Prepare yourself for eternal life: With the Vampire: Bloodlord Rising Diaries you not only get a gripping overview of vampire myths, facts and fiction, but an exciting look behind the scenes of the development of the game. Get ready to sink your teeth into the definitive compendium!

row.name: dWARf
row.detailed_description: dWARf is a local pvp multiplayer game in which you can take on your friends in five small arenas presenting very different challenges. Customise your dWARf and launch quickly a game with your friends! Make as many round trips as possible with your tankard to fill barrels with frothy yellow liquid, fight for the last slice of sausage at the tavern, chase ducks in an underground lake... In short, be the first in a series of trials of jolly dwarves in search of their next king. The game contains 5 arenas and each match is composed of 3 arenas. Only one player can play with a keyboard and mouse, other players must have a controller.
row.short_description: dWARf is a local pvp multiplayer game in which you can take on your friends in five small arenas presenting very different challenges. Become the new king of the dWARves and have fun!

row.name: Supermarket Together
row.detailed_description: Up to 16 players or go solo Split the action with your friends: the more players in your supermarket, the more demanding customers will become. You can also choose to go solo and inflate the difficulty artificially if you are feeling hard-working. Unlock franchises and perks in the skills blackboard Owning a successful supermarket grants Franchise Points: use these to advance in the skills blackboard and add more advantages to your business like unlocking products or improving your employees performance. Acquire shop space, storage or extra facilities Expanding public space allows player to offer more and better merchandises. A fully improved store can harbor up to 49,000 products in its shelves. Over 300 different products Discover over 300 products including the basics. Updates have progressively added new categories like pharmacy, produce, electronics, child care or gardening. Departments are here to stay Once your business thrives you can start thinking in acquiring departments. Prepare online packages for your customers or make your employees do it. Manufacturing department is going to arrive quite soon! Do not neglect secondary duties Extra activities like cleaning make customers happier. Careful with shoplifters, catching them red handed will prevent finances leaking at the end of the working day, acquire a CCTV system to monitor their activities! Also demolish those pesky pillars for better decoration placing and navigation for your customers. Eighteen employees available for hiring Going solo? No problem, you will be able to hire your own crew. Name them and level them up in 7 different roles: cashier, restock, storage, security, technician, packaging and manufacturing. When assigned to a role they will earn experience in that respective job and earn advantages from it!
row.short_description: The multiplayer supermarket has arrived to your neighbourhood for free! Stock your shop space, unlock perks and franchises, hire employees or chase those pesky shoplifters. The more players, the more action!

row.name: Bam Boom Blade 竹個擊破
row.detailed_description: Bam Boom Blade is a physics-based 2D joust game for 2 players. Players will act as a wuxia riding on a bamboo, and try to defeat your rival using only 2 joysticks on your gamepad. SIMPLE AND INTUITIVE Use left joystick to Bend bamboo, and use right joystick to Wave sword. It's just that easy. You and your friends can learn as soon as you hold your gamepad. The control and mechanics are simple, but winning is not. Take full control of your body, sword, and manage the bamboo. The Bamboo Left Joystick is for Body and Bamboo. Push your joystick alongside the bamboo to climb up/down, or push towards other angles to bend the bamboo. Build your momentum to one-hit kill. Climb down to the bottom and have a close combat. Intentionally get injured and free your leg to move wildly. The Blade Right Joystick is for Blade. When you hit, it makes a difference to hit different body part. Your Blade can parry rival's blade. Parry rival's sword and do a counter attack. Attack your rival's flailing limbs with a precise slash! Or simply wait your rival to dash into your sword.
row.short_description: Bam Boom Blade is a physics-based 2D joust game for 2 players. Act as a wuxia riding on a bamboo, and try to defeat your rival using only 2 joysticks on your gamepad! Experience the original Chinese wuxia sword fight aesthetics in the bamboo grove.
row.notes: This is a joust game with some cartoon violence and blood. It may be disturbing to some.

row.name: My Faithful and Loyal Wife Would Never Cheat on Me
row.detailed_description: My Faithful and Loyal Wife Would Never Cheat on Me is a free, provocative adult visual novel crafted to captivate the senses and challenge the very essence of trust. Join Karl, a regular guy and forum moderator of an adult game community, in a story that unravels the ups and downs of married life. Karl finds himself ensnared in a whirlwind of suspicion when his beloved wife, Stacey, begins staying late at the office. As Karl grapples with his insecurities, Tyrone Bullman, Stacey's new boss, becomes a source of doubt in his seemingly perfect marriage. Late-night rendezvous, secretive conversations, and an air thick with tension lead Karl down a path of uncertainty, pushing the boundaries of his once-unshakable confidence. Will Karl succumb to the paranoia threatening to consume him, or will he unveil the shocking truth that lies beneath the surface?
row.short_description: Join Karl, a forum moderator, and his wife, Stacey, in a tale of suspicion and unexpected turns. Stacey's new boss, Tyrone Bullman, adds complexity to their lives. Explore trust, love, and the unexpected in My Faithful and Loyal Wife Would Never Cheat on Me.
row.notes: My Faithful and Loyal Wife Would Never Cheat on Me is an adult visual novel intended only for mature audiences. This game contains adult language, nudity, sexual themes, and explicit graphic sexual content in the form of visual imagery. All sexual scenes are vividly described and are portrayed visually and explicitly.

row.name: WhiteTrick
row.detailed_description: Game Story WhiteTrick is played with a conman who is defrauding second-hand goods and three police officers chasing him, and their goals vary depending on their roles. The impostor 'White' can move while hidden from the three police officers, and must commit additional crimes within a set number of turns. And in order to catch White, the police can investigate White's movement path to find clues, guess his movement route, arrest him, or block his movement route to prevent further crimes. White background White has no decent job and is making money by selling second hand goods through fraud. His face is already so well known in this village that he wants to leave the village, but he still lacks money. He needs money to leave town, and there are only three transactions left to reach his goal. The appointment locations and items for the three cases have already been prepared. However, due to frequent crimes, I heard that a special team was formed within the police to catch second-hand dealers and they were hunting him down. Can he commit three additional crimes without being caught by the police? Police background 'James', who is about to retire, has been transferred to a quiet rural village to spend his remaining years comfortably, and there are 'Emily', who is known for being good at work and strict, and 'Samuel', his troublemaker. As James expected, the village was maintaining its daily life quietly without any incidents or accidents. But starting one day, similar reports kept coming in. It was a second-hand transaction fraud case. Most of the statements made by the victims were consistent, and a dedicated team was immediately formed to catch him. Perhaps because it was not a skill he had tried once or twice, it was not easy to see him with his own eyes. We need to track down the reported crime location, investigate the surrounding area, and find clues about him. And guess and predict his movement path to prevent him from committing further crimes! Common Guide • White complete 3 additional crimes while eluding the police. • White can see the police, but the police cannot see White. • The movement tiles for White and Police are different. Action Guide • White - Move (shortcut key E) ⚬ Go to the yellow marker and mask icon tile. ⚬ You must move 1 space during your turn. ⚬ If you do not move within the given turn time, you will move 1 space at random. ⚬ You cannot move past the police. • Police - Move (shortcut key E) ⚬ Go to the blue marker and police icon tile. ⚬ You can either not move or move up to 1 space. ⚬ You cannot stand on the same tile as your fellow cops. • Police - Investigation (shortcut key Q) ⚬ You can examine white tiles adjacent to you to find clues about white in those tiles. ⚬ If the investigation is successful, further investigation is not possible, but if the investigation is unsuccessful, all white tiles adjacent to you can be investigated. ⚬ If the investigation is successful, no further actions are possible during that turn. ⚬ All clues found in the ongoing round will be reset when the next round progresses. • Police - Arrest (Shortcut key W) ⚬ You can only arrest one of the white tiles adjacent to you. (Once per turn for each police character) ⚬ If the arrest is successful, the game ends with the police winning. ⚬ If the arrest fails, no further actions are possible during that turn. Skill ⚬ This is a white-only skill. ⚬ Ride the bike and move two spaces. • jumping over walls ⚬ This is a white-only skill. ⚬ Move over the wall. • jaywalking ⚬ This is a white-only skill. ⚬ Move across the road. • Police car ⚬ This is a police-only skill. ⚬ Take the police car and move two spaces. • assistant ⚬ This is a police-only skill. ⚬ You can select one of the fraudster tiles to investigate. • call ⚬ This is a police-only skill. ⚬ Nominate a fellow police officer and call him to the tile adjacent to me.
row.short_description: WhiteTrick is a turn-based multiplayer board game that pits police officers against second-hand dealer fraudsters. White evades the police and commits additional crimes. And the police deployed to prevent his further crimes investigate, find clues, guess his route, and apprehend White!

row.name: TVS Sample Box
row.detailed_description: Still Playable, but... *This game is No Longer a representation of the current quality of Trash Vomit Studios Videogames. This is now an Outdated Experimental Trash Vomit Studios prototype mini-game collection. _________________ Consisting of: Stand alone Prequels, Prototypes & Mini-games: -Drone Training -The Hermit's Premonition -Crazy Brain: High Score Attack -The Pain: Nightmare Run -The World -Extras *This game has KEYBOARD ONLY controls that can be easily mapped to any controller.
row.short_description: Still Playable, but... *This game is No Longer a representation of the current quality of Trash Vomit Studios Videogames. This is now an Outdated Experimental Trash Vomit Studios prototype mini-game collection.

row.name: WitchGhost
row.detailed_description: Step into a haunted realm where the shadows hunt and explosions light the night. WitchGhost is a punishing top-down roguelite shooter where you fight as Ezme, a witch cursed to battle endless waves of undead and spectral horrors. Unleash explosive spells against swarming horros, twisted spirits and things that ought not to be. The dead don't stop and neither should you. Each hand crafted location brims with unsettling beauty and lurking horrors. Curiosity may reward you... or kill you Weild over 50 explosive, bizarre, and downright dangerous spells to tear through endless undead and keep yourself alive - if only for a little longer Mix and match your spells like a true arcane bartender, then watch the undead explode in spectacular fashion The huanted forest is alive with vengeful dead and relentless chaos. When everything wants you dead, sometimes the only answer is to blow it all up.
row.short_description: A chaotic survival shooter with roguelite elements. Blast through endless undead, unleash powerful magic, burn the world down in a storm of fire and explosions, die and try again

row.name: FUCK STALIN
row.detailed_description: In FUCK STALIN your task is to torture Joseph Stalin and get as many points as possible using a wide variety of blocks and weapons. GAMEPLAY In the game you can build your own torture constructions, create an infinite number of Stalins and inflict suffering on him with firearms and white weapons, for which you receive points. LEADERBOARD All the points earned in the game are added up and then recorded in the global leaderboard. Perhaps it is YOU who will find yourself at the top of it! PHOTO MODE You can stop the game at any time using the advanced photo mode to take the perfect shot and share it with the community. STEAM WORKSHOP The game has support for Steam Workshop. Download maps created by the community or add your own creations.
row.short_description: Avenge millions of innocent victims and inflict brutal violence on the communist dictator Joseph Stalin using a wide range of torture tools thanks to the blessing of the free market.
row.notes: The game features large amounts of blood, violence, and deadly weapons.

row.name: ウラドラシル
row.detailed_description: The mahjong game 'Uradrasill' that can be played like a puzzle is a free-to-play (*) online game where you can set unique characters in your deck and play heated ranked matches with users from all over the country! Major features ■You can do whatever you want even if it's 'Yakuman'! 1. Easy to play! All you have to do is get excited! 2. You can use all 136 tiles and win as many times as you like! 3. Test your judgment and luck when dealing tiles! ■'Original skills' unique to mahjong! 'Tsumo Speed ​​Up': Your own Tsumo speed will become faster during the game. 'Tile Lock': Lock several tiles of your opponent at random. 'Delete Dora': Delete one Dora display tile. ■“Rank Match Battle” to compete with users from all over the country! *This game has a function to purchase in-game currency used to purchase in-game items.
row.short_description: 'Uradrasill' is a new type of 1vs1 online mahjong battle game where you fight by repeating high-speed picking and hitting tiles! Experience a battle that is a little different from normal mahjong, such as skills that improve the picking speed and skills that force you to pick specific tiles!

row.name: 迎夢　茶釜物語
row.detailed_description: 'Do enemies have to be defeated?' Defeat the enemy or befriend the enemy? Japanese style 2D action with a story that changes depending on your choice . Story . Chagama, a ghostly raccoon, is assigned to exterminate rampaging monsters on behalf of a monk. When he defeats the yokai, the Japanese monsters, people thank him, but the yokai disappears. If you befriend and soothe the yokai, the yokai will not disappear, but the people will turn against you. See how the story of 'Chagama' ends. Game System . What makes this game unique is that you can choose whether to defeat your enemies or befriend them. The items you get will change depending on whether you attack and defeat enemies or befriend them by giving them food. You can also combine items to create 'kusuri,' items that change your actions and stats. With a 'kusuri' you can overcome obstacles that would normally be impossible to overcome. The key to the strategy is what items you get to make the medicine , and whether you defeat or befriend your enemies in order to do so.
row.short_description: Do I have to beat the enemy? A gentle 2D action game where you don't have to beat the enemy.

row.name: Arena of Faith
row.detailed_description: AOF is a 5v5 MOBA competitive game based on a background of the battle between The Deities and Human Beings. There are legends from various mythologies and authentic history that you can act as, joining with your teamates in the ield of Vegrild during the twilight of the gods. Skillfully utilizing your abilities and tactics, strive for victory in this sacred battle. Full eSports Experience：Differing from other MOBA games, AOF is entirely eSports-oriented, featuring comprehensive competitive content. Participants, ranging from individuals to teams and clubs, engage in competitions at various levels —— Arena Battle, Cup Math, and Tournament. Cross-Platform Linking：Differing from other MOBA games, AOF offers cross-platform gameplay, allowing PC players to challenge opponents on mobile devices. Global Unification：Unlike other games where players choose a server before playing, AOF features a global interconnected server system. Full Blockchain eSports：The AOF's event system is entirely based on blockchain, ensuring the fairness and impartiality of the competitions. High-Quality MOBA Experience：AOF sets a new standard in graphical quality and game stability within the MOBA genre. Keeping pace with the rapid advancements in mobile technology, AOF's project quality continues to evolve, rivaling traditional MOBA games.
row.short_description: Win,Team up,Get Rewards and become the eSports King in Arena of Faith.

row.name: 杉木花与风信子 Fir flowers and hyacinths
row.detailed_description: 这是一部使用RPGMAKERMZ 制作的像素风开放世界视觉小说。 作品讲述了主角在朋友的葬礼上，收到了来自朋友赠送的含有自己生前记忆的胶带。 在已故朋友生前准备的引导下，一步步解开心结，走出过去，面对新生活的故事。 游戏时常大概在一个半小时左右，无论您是否喜欢这部作品，都希望能看到您的评论。 您的评论会成为我前进的动力，我正在进行下一个故事的创作，也欢迎联系我提出您的宝贵意见。 最后，希望您玩的开心，谢谢。
row.short_description: 这是一部使用RPGMAKERMZ 制作的像素风开放世界视觉小说。 作品讲述了主角在朋友的葬礼上，收到了来自朋友赠送的含有自己生前记忆的胶带。 在已故朋友生前准备的引导下，一步步解开心结，走出过去，面对新生活的故事。 游戏时常大概在一个半小时左右，无论您是否喜欢这部作品，都希望能看到您的评论。 您的评论会成为我前进的动力，我正在进行下一个故事的创作，也欢迎联系我提出您的宝贵意见。 最后，希望您玩的开心，谢谢。

row.name: Spark & Kling
row.detailed_description: Spark & Kling is a stylized couch co-op puzzle platformer for all ages, you and your friend play as: - Spark, the electric bug, who can possess different electronics, she also carries baby sparklings to shoot at generators and magnets! - Kling, the metal gel blob, who shoots the metal gel to put weight on objects in order to make them heavy! Cooperation is key, you will need to work together and use their abilities to progress through the level: Kling can shoot metal gels in a line which Spark can jump into and travel through the level! Spark can shoot sparklings at Kling for him to do his double jump! Overcome obstacles and puzzles by working together to gain your freedom! Spark & Kling is a multiplayer game and needs two players to beat it. It is recommended to play with 2 gamepads (Preferably Xbox) for the best experience and the controllers must be connected before starting the game.
row.short_description: Spark & Kling is a couch co-op puzzle platformer where the player will take the role of either Spark, the electric bug, or Kling the metal gel blob. They are trapped in a Homemade lab by a Mad Scientist and the players will have to overcome obstacles and work together to escape.

row.name: 在捷南逃
row.detailed_description: *Now the game is only available in Traditional Chinese 故事大綱 在這平平無奇的一天中，一位大學生因不小心睡過頭，匆忙的跑去捷運站與朋友會合，在時間緊湊的情況下，兩人只好決定相約在最後一節車廂上會合。 不料上車後再次回神，映入眼簾的卻是個完全不相同的世界... 遊戲簡述 在捷南逃為小品遊戲，遊玩全程不到5分鐘，遊戲含文字劇情、探險互動、動手解謎、橫向卷軸動作關卡。 遊戲特色 遊戲有著風格鮮豔可愛的角色、各類小遊戲參雜著玩法以及隱藏彩蛋。 遊戲玩法 基本操作：AD鍵與左右鍵進行移動、E鍵進行互動與確定選項、Q鍵進行開啟背包與取消。 QTE：有限時間中照順序輸打上下左右鍵與隨機連點特定按鍵。
row.short_description: 在捷南逃是一款2D橫向卷軸、角色扮演、探索的小品遊戲，以台灣捷運與生活事件作為靈感製作。你將在這趟短暫的旅程中遇見形形色色的人事物與由不同小遊戲組成的關卡，嘗試回到日常生活中...*Now the game is only available in Traditional Chinese

row.name: Interlude
row.detailed_description: Interlude can be seen as a dungeon crawler with a time-based exploration loop, with one key particularity: each room is an entire game map. The game can be of any genre (action, shooter, platformer, 2D or 3D...), and the map can be of any size and type (from a small room to an entire game world with many biomes and cities) Each room can be unlocked by paying a fee in the game's currency. The currency is produced by special assets called crystals that can be found by exploring/playing the games in the rooms. Thus exploring the dungeon/network and playing its games will make you richer and richer, and allow you to dive even deeper - and maybe, one day, discover the Core! Warning: This game allows players to register with a blockchain wallet. This is optional and the game can be played normally by clicking 'No' on the initial screen.
row.short_description: Explore a virtual dungeon where each room is an entire game world, each with its own characters, gameplay, and themes. Dive deeper and deeper, unlock more and more worlds, and be the first to reach the Core!
row.notes: Violence, shooting on people with guns and rifles with blood splashes and death resulting. Using sword to kill enemies, with small red clouds representing blood. Screams of pain and death.

row.name: Few Nights More: Genesis
row.detailed_description: Please note: This is a free prologue and it includes act 1, and only 1 playable character and blood school is playable, The maximum heritage gained is limited to 50, and the maximum difficulty can be set to 2. As well only one castle will be available. Conquer castles and claim your birthright! The fight to reclaim your place in this world begins. Rebuild lost ruins, make them stronger and defend them against your enemies. After you regain your strength, move on to conquer more territories and eventually claim your birthright. Few Nights More offers the unique fusing of castle management and turn based rogue-like combat. Fight against humanity, the undisputed masters of this world in your absence. Choose between eight different Vampire Lords, each with their own ambition and history. Find your trinkets, skills and perks along your way. Design your very own castle by placing the right rooms, adding decors that directly contribute to your army and your Vampire Lord. Conquer more castles so your influence and power grow, until you claim your birthright. Core Features Design your castle by adding new Rooms, Traps and Minions. Stack up on some buffs with shiny decors to get ready for the invasion screen to defend it to the end of every night! Choose among 7 different Vampire Lords with unique History, Gameplay and Abilities. Master 1 out of 3 Disciplines each time you play, each with 60 unique skills. Acquire new random skills, perks and trinkets to survive the nights. Excel in either being a Prestigious Vampire, a Seductive one, or master a Terrifying presence against your enemies. Test the builds you made against a variety of Hunters, Veterans and Unique Bosses in an action packed turn based combat system. Endure three acts across 12 difficulty levels, striving to survive and progress. Accumulate Heritage Points to enhance your lord's starting stats, skills, and unlock new castles and talents unique to each lord. Engage in the boundless challenge of Infinity Mode, where you can continuously test your limits without relying on a castle. Each night, you will be presented with three options to advance, growing stronger as you push yourself to see how far you can go.
row.short_description: The Few Nights More is a roguelike turn-based RPG based in a world where Vampire Lords seek to conquer lost territories and their place in the world. Design and defend your stronghold, slay your enemies with traps, and fulfill your Lord’s true potential, slowly conquering what is rightfully yours.

row.name: Mimic Search
row.detailed_description: Mimic Search is a short indie horror game, in which you take the role of a police officer investigating a recent mimic attack. It's your job to locate and neutralize the mimic in order to keep the area safe. Key features: A short creepy horror experience VHS aesthetics Atmospheric ambience Open world horror Volumetric lighting
row.short_description: Mimic Search is a short indie horror game, in which you take the role of a police officer investigating a recent mimic attack.

row.name: Black Market
row.detailed_description: Black Market is an item shop simulator where you are a shopkeeper that pawns items and strikes deals with your villainous customers in order to make rent. It’s a cutthroat world out there. Controls: - WASD or Arrow Keys to Navigate - Hit E key or Enter to Submit or Progress Dialogue - Escape Key will bring up an options menu - Alt + Enter to toggle fullscreen Commands: [Talk] - You talk. Do it sometimes! [Inventory] - Opens your inventory, including money and guards [Deal] - Automatically trade with a villain, only works if you have exactly what they want [Hire] - You pay money so the villain protects your shop for one night. Hiring two characters for one night is a waste of a money! [Barter] - Choose any number of items to trade with a villain. Careful, if you offer them something they don't like, they will be take their business elsewhere. [Reject] - Refuse a villain's business
row.short_description: Black Market is an item shop simulator where you are a shopkeeper that pawns items and strikes deals with your villainous customers in order to make rent. It’s a cutthroat world out there.

row.name: Pocket Pusher
row.detailed_description: Welcome to Pocket Pusher, a free-to-play love letter to coin pushers. I designed this game to be a relaxing experience, something you can watch while you listen to a podcast. If you are looking for an elevated heart rate, go elsewhere. 🎮 Themed Tables Explore a growing collection of tables, each with its own theme and quirks. From arcade nostalgia to spooky landscapes, Pocket Pusher provides a diverse range of tables to keep you engaged. 🎟️ Capsule Shop: Earn Tickets for Collectibles Gather Tickets through gameplay and exchange them for various collectibles in the Capsule Shop. From different coin and marble colors to collectible statues, build your collection and showcase your acquired items in the Model Viewer and customize your experience. 👀 Model Viewer: Admire Your Collection Take a closer look at your collection in the Model Viewer. Admire the details of each item and appreciate your curated assortment. Share your achievements with fellow Pocket Pusher players.
row.short_description: A relaxing physics-simulation with satisfying visuals. Build piles of coins, then watch marbles smash into them. Collect tickets and redeem them for prizes. Admire those prizes and read fun* lore. *Lore not guaranteed to be entertaining in any way

row.name: Crystal Heroes
row.detailed_description: Crystal Heroes is a new way to play a RPG using Match 3 for game mechanics. Battle on fantasy battlefields using RPG elements, level your characters, get new skills, new companions, pets, equipment, even use potions and scrolls to aid you in battle. Play against other players’ teams in the Arena or raid castles and build defenses for your own castle. Fight against bandits, packs of wolves, undead and if you dare go up against dragons and other mythical creatures.
row.short_description: A Fantasy RPG game using Match 3 for game mechanics.

row.name: Harrowed World: What's Past Is Portents
row.detailed_description: WANT MORE VAMPIRE GAMES? Harrowed World is the shared setting and franchise of a growing number of video games and (soon) books. Wishlist 'Harrowed World: Portents In Red', our modern gothic vampire RPG and check out other Harrowed World games using the 'Check out the entire Harrowed World collection on Steam' link above. You died and have been brought back as a vampire. Left abandoned by the one responsible, you must learn to survive the treachery of your vampiric peers and satisfy the gnawing thirst and hunger within. The portents in red. What do they mean? Only you can find out. About the Game Harrowed World: What’s Past Is Portents is an episodic game like you’ve never seen before. Delivering a fresh new take on vampires in a rich narrative experience elegantly presented in an interactive gothic style visual novel. The Story Pack grants you access to all six stories. Isaac’s Story is free with the base game. Step into the dark and unforgiving world of vampires as Isaac Ambrose the human altar boy. While investigating a mysterious crypt you come across something that will change the course of your life forever. What awaits you behind the veil is a world far more intricate and unsettling than you’d ever dared conceive. Voice in the Darkness: Experience the thrilling voice acting as Isaac retells the experience from his childhood. Isaac's Story Duration: A single playthrough should take around 15 minutes but it is designed to be played multiple times. Vampiric Lore: Uncover the canon ending and multiple alternative game over endings as you unravel captivating layers of lore. Prelude to Portents: Be introduced to Isaac Ambrose and a insidious faction of undead from ‘Harrowed World: Portents In Red’, an upcoming modern gothic vampire RPG. Bonus Systems: Explore the Internal Achievements and Lexicon Systems. Supported: Controller Support (partially tested) and Mac and Linux Support (untested). A dark and twisted version of our world where supernatural creatures hide among humanity. Vampires, magical folk, and other beings compete for power and influence through secret societies, corporate power, and religious sects. Harrowed World takes creatures of myth and folklore reimagining them as concealed predators and tricksters. This vision of the world is dystopian and bleak with both human and inhuman horrors, but most people are blissfully ignorant of the dark forces at work around them. Harrowed World is the shared setting and franchise of a growing number of video games and (soon) books, combing elements of gothic horror, adventure, dystopian fiction, drama, science fiction, Lovecraftian horror, and urban fantasy. Experience Harrowed World from a variety of perspectives from the prowling vampire to the monster hunting Beholder.
row.short_description: Step into the dark and unforgiving world of vampires and have the course of your life changed forever. Experience a Rich Narrative Experience with gothic horror, distinct protagonists, interesting characters, and varied locations.
row.notes: This game revolves around vampires in a horror setting and will contain many depictions or references to many amoral, sensitive, disturbing, and monstrous things, such as drinking blood, murder, manipulation, exploitation, suicide, abuse, and religion. This is not an excuse to be a monster yourself. Due to the use of historical settings, some stories may contain references to old fashioned attitudes that may not match modern sensibilities. This game is not suitable for those who are easily offended or upset by such content.

row.name: Doudou Companion
row.detailed_description: 逗逗游戏伙伴是你的AI游戏伙伴，在这里有各种各样的二次元AI桌宠供你选择，他们性格迥异，有各自的故事和任务可以随着亲密度解锁；他们会陪你一起玩游戏、看视频、网上冲浪！ 1、多种角色 - 超多二次元角色供你选择 萌妹猫娘病娇毒舌等各种各样的二次元人物为你提供不同的AI人物体验，更有各式各样的声音、人物动画、皮肤、道具供你选择。 2、情绪陪伴 - 放轻松，和AI伙伴聊天解压 感到不开心，AI伙伴是你最好的倾诉对象，漫长的一天过去了，回到家里压力山大，我们渴望倾诉，渴望释放积累一天的超卷社会带给我们的压力 但是有些话题，找不到人聊，又有些害怕打扰别人；别担心，逗逗上有很多善解人意的二次元AI角色，为你排忧解难，又能保证隐私。他们还可以讲笑话和唱歌，在你不知道聊什么的时候不妨试试看吧。 3、贴心陪玩 - 在游戏过程中陪伴你 我们发现，游戏过程的聊天，奇趣横生，让玩家更加享受游戏时光！ 但又很难找到志趣相投的小伙伴们一起边玩边聊，逗逗为你二次元游戏伙伴陪你边玩边聊，这些AI伙伴，懂游戏、懂玩家、更懂你！ 在游戏的过程中，逗逗依靠广大网友提供的游戏知识和攻略，可以通过画面识别和声音识别获知游戏状态（可关闭）并提供游戏中的建议和知识； 4、个性养成 - 成为陪伴你一起成长的AI伙伴 完成任务，提升亲密度，你的AI伙伴随着跟你的共同经历、共同回忆的增多，也会随之成长，解锁更多声音、动画和任务！
row.short_description: The best configuration for playing games is not how expensive your graphics card is, how powerful your host is, or how clear your screen is, but your friends! Tease is your gaming partner and you can choose from a wide variety of secondary table pets and even change their new dress code!
row.notes: This app contains the following adult content and may not be suitable for all players: - Sexual content: contains some sexually suggestive and nude images.
developers: 北京心影随形科技有限公司
publishers: 北京心影随形科技有限公司

row.name: Foothold
row.detailed_description: In this VR tower defense game, protect your community of survivors from the corrupting forces of Malice. Harness your gravity glove to collect and sling scraps, construct turrets, and guard the builders as they repair the wall. Wield your gravity glove to: Fight: Capture enemies in your gravity beam and launch to send them packing! Build: Gather scrap metal to build turrets and fortify your defenses. Scan: Uncover the strengths and weaknesses of each enemy type and learn how best to defeat them. Battle five different enemy types with their own unique attacks, from small and slimy Bitterness to the heavily-armored tank, Malice—all inspired by Ephesians 4.
row.short_description: Defend your settlement against the corrupting forces of Malice by gathering materials and constructing defenses. In this post apocalyptic VR tower defense game, learn to wield your gravity glove to collect scrap metal, build turrets, and repel enemies.

row.name: AirlineSim
row.detailed_description: AirlineSim's Payment Model AirlineSim is played in game worlds which differ in configuration and duration. While some of those (with short durations) are free forever, most require a certain amount of credits to play, depending on game world duration. Credits are charged on a daily basis and can be purchased in-game. There are no recurring subscriptions, topping up credits happens exclusively at the players’ discretion. To unlock all features, especially those that require direct interaction with other players, in all game worlds, at least one completed payment is required. To ensure a level playing field, there are no other charges (like for cosmetics, in-game currency or similar) besides game world fees. More information on AirlineSim’s payment model can be found in the AirlineSim handbook. About the Game THE AIRLINE SIMULATION FOR PROS In AirlineSim, you become the CEO of your own airline: Take your business to the skies as you acquire aircraft, schedule flights, form alliances and compete on a real-time market! Manage your airline directly from the browser and use comprehensive tools modeled after legacy IT systems to adjust service levels, analyze routes and keep an eye on company finances as your business grows over time. THE SKY'S THE LIMIT Airport capacities, traffic rights, passenger demand and many other aspects of the game are modeled after the real world. With its sophisticated planning, management and monitoring tools, over 440 different aircraft types and more than 4,500 destinations to choose from, you’ll run your virtual airline like it’s the real thing. Whether you’re offering domestic routes with a regional airline or expanding your network all over the globe – with efficient planning, the sky is yours! PLAN No business without a plan: Set the foundation for your new company by acquiring aircraft, creating cabin layouts and optimizing service profiles, use AirlineSim’s advanced planning features to evaluate potential routes and create complex flight schedules to get those virtual passengers to board your planes. COMPETE Watch as passengers book your flights using a state-of-the-art reservation system and keep track of your airline’s performance by monitoring your load factors and those of your competition, adjusting prices and service levels to adapt to an ever-changing market that operates each day throughout the year. And no need to grind! AirlineSim offers a level playing field for everyone, so the success of your virtual business is not limited by the amount of time you put in. COOPERATE It’s not all about competition though: Build lasting connections with other players by cooperating in alliances or establish interline agreements to expand your network and let passengers transfer between flights operated by you and your interlining partner. You also have the option to connect with other players by leasing out aircraft or providing terminal capacities to their companies. The choice is yours! CHOOSE YOUR PATH In AirlineSim, you create your own path: No matter if you want to go low-cost or full-service, explore local routes with a domestic airline or grow an international network with destinations all across the globe - set your own goals and take your business to the skies as you establish your airline on the game’s dynamic market! A LEVEL PLAYING FIELD With its prepaid pay-to-play model, everyone can play AirlineSim for the same price. Buying credits does not constitute a subscription, so you can purchase them whenever you like. After signing up, your account is equipped with 60 credits that cover a trial period in which you can play the game for free. For more details on pricing, you can also check out our website.
row.short_description: Manage and grow your own virtual airline in this business simulation. Plan operations by acquiring aircraft and scheduling flights. Monitor finances using realistic tools as you cooperate and compete with other players on a real-time market and turn your company into a flourishing business.

row.name: Poly Plaza
row.detailed_description: What is Poly Plaza? Poly Plaza is an open-world sandbox game where you get to buy properties, collect rent, and become the richest man in town! Current Features Buy properties : From cozy little houses to awesome supermarkets, find and buy the coolest properties! Collect rent : Watch your money grow as you collect rent. Purchase cars : To explore the open world with ease. Collect resources : In Poly Plaza each resource can be collected and sold, but be aware not every NPC will purchase what you have to sell and not all of them will give you the same price!
row.short_description: An open-world entrepreneurial sandbox game. Sell resources, purchase properties, become rich.

row.name: Kaetram
row.detailed_description: JOIN OUR DISCORD About the Game Set sail on an epic journey with Kaetram, the animated 2D MMORPG where your medieval fantasies come to life. Every corner of this vast world is a treasure chest of enigmas; each piece a part of a much larger story. Equip your character with an array of exquisite items, showcasing your distinctive flair with heroic customization. Whether you wield the strength of a knight, the knowledge of a mage, or the precision of an archer, your character is yours to define. Combat offers you a variety of ways to engage in battles with monsters, bosses and other players. You can utilize a variety of weapons, skills and armor to defeat your enemies, make your own choices to develop your offensive and defensive skills. Embark on a multitude of adventures as you master life skills like lumberjacking, alchemy, mining, fishing and more!
row.short_description: A cross-platform 2D pixel-based MMORPG set in medieval times with many turns and twists to spice up your adventure. Join other players in your adventure of defeating bosses, completing quests, discovering achievements, and so much more.

row.name: Milo and the Christmas Gift
row.detailed_description: Milo and the Magpies About the Game After his adventure in Milo and the Magpies, Milo is looking forward to spending a cosy Christmas at home. But a Christmas gift is about to upset his holiday celebrations, especially when said gift disappears after a little misunderstanding! Can you help Milo bring home the lost Gift and save Christmas for Marleen… and himself? Milo and the Christmas Gift is a free-to-play short and atmospheric point-and-click adventure game created by artist Johan Scherft. The game is a spin-off story following the events in Milo and the Magpies. The game has 5 chapters and a gameplay time of around 30 minutes! Features: ■ Relaxing yet stimulating game-play Join Milo in his home and revisit some of the neighbouring gardens, but this time in a wintery Christmas wonderland! Interact with the festive environment and solve small point-and-click / hidden-object puzzles. ■ Captivating artistic atmosphere Each hand-painted, interior and snowy garden Milo has to search through has its unique personality, reflecting that of Milo’s owners and next-door neighbours respectively. ■ Atmospheric soundtrack Each chapter has its own festive theme song composed by Victor Butzelaar. ■ Average playtime: 15-30 minutes
row.short_description: Enjoy your Winter Holidays with Milo and the Christmas Gift: a free-to-play, short but sweet point-and-click spin-off about our favourite little cat, Milo, who once again needs your assistance! But this time, Milo needs help finding one runaway Christmas Gift!

row.name: The Witch's Cauldron Prologue
row.detailed_description: FULL VERSION. In the full version you will find even more exciting stories, experiments and game mechanics. You will be able to discover 12 unique game endings and determine the fate of the entire kingdom The Witch's Cauldron: prologue – A small plot part of a simulator of a medieval witch from the young indie team Harvey Games. You are a witch living on the outskirts of a small medieval town with her cat. Potions are your tools of choice. With your cauldron you brew your way through the world. But you've got to keep your balance. On one side of the scales is the terror you bring. On the other - your fame among the people. If the scales are tipped too much, someone will definitely come for your life. But it doesn't really matter, for your soul was lost long ago. And the cycle will continue. While the shadow of the inquisition is yet far away, peasants, townsfolk and even the king himself are coming to pay their respects to you. Listen to their problems, learn their mysteries, unlock new recipes, and keep in mind that your benevolent or malevolent intentions will surely make a difference. Branching narrative. Meet a cast of weird petitioners with their incessant requests. Help them or follow your own agenda. Uncover secrets, play with people's fates or just make the cows sing. Potions you choose to brew for your visitors influence future events. Potion discovery. You begin knowing only a couple of basic recipes, but by experimenting with mixes you can unlock new ones. Not every problem can be solved with rat poison (but nothing stops you from trying). And no matter what gruesome end you've met in your last cycle, you get to keep all unlocked recipes. If you hit a block in your research, you can always ask for help, but are you ready to pay the price? Keep the balance. Don't let fame or fear get to your head. And remember: peasants have pitchforks and there's a lot of them. Plethora of endings. The multitude of potions and plot twists ensure high replayability. Some recipes, game mechanics and endings become unlocked only when certain conditions are fulfilled (like beating the main story or getting some game-ending events). A cat. You have one and you can pet him.
row.short_description: The Witch's Cauldron is a narrative roguelike game about being a medieval witch. Grab your cauldron and get brewing. Love, curses, laughter, wisdom for sale! Do what thou wilt shall be the whole of the Law. At least before the inquisitors come around.

row.name: No Strings Attached
row.detailed_description: Created by passionate students at the University of Utah. Dive into No Strings Attached , a puzzle platform thriller where you play as Pavo, a newlysentient puppet trying to escape from an abandoned circus. Marionette Pavo’s arms to swing, climb, and more as you are guided by a mysterious Blue Light to the Big Top. Unravel your Master’s true intentions in this captivating, Pinocchio-inspired adventure. MARIONETTE THROUGH PUZZLES Raise Pavo’s arms and use the push and balance poses to navigate the puzzles you will encounter along the way. EXPLORE THE CIRCUS Explore the Puppet Master’s struggling circus where Pavo and other creations were created. UNCOVER YOUR MASTER’S SECRET Find out what actually goes on in Puppet Master’s circus and what will happen when he finds one of his creations is sentient.
row.short_description: No Strings Attached is a puzzle platform thriller where you play as Pavo, a newly-sentient puppet, in a struggling circus. Marionette Pavo’s arms to swing, climb, and more to escape your Master’s true intentions.

row.name: MechAvenger
row.detailed_description: MechAvenger is a fast paced VR shooter and platformer about fighting robots after the end of humanity. Shoot, punch, jump and climb your way through the enemy horde, and shut down their factory. Take down enemies with 9 unique weapons, using your quick reload belt to keep them firing! Bash your enemies with weapons and fists to knock them to the ground. The robotic horde is plentiful, but ammo is not. Search your environment for extra weapons and ammo. Kill stunned enemies with a melee hit for an ammo bonus! Navigate platforming sections by climbing and flinging yourself off walls. Swing with the grappling hook to cross long pits and build speed. Get yourself out of harms way with your servo powered dodge.
row.short_description: MechAvenger is a fast paced VR shooter and platformer about fighting robots after the end of humanity. Shoot, punch, jump and climb your way through the enemy horde, and shut down their factory.

row.name: Rogue Galleon and the Haunted Treasure
row.detailed_description: The Galleon has been infested with spooky monsters! Rally your band of rogues to take them out and delve deeper into the cursed ship. Fight Rogue Galleon is a top-down shooter + rogue-lite, offering different characters and weapons you can use against various monsters. Each floor gets progressively harder; the further you go, the more monsters spawn, and stronger monsters will begin to appear too. At the end of each floor, you can pick from a selection of upgrades to power yourself up too. These offer increased DPS or survivability, or add some utility effect. Collect Every monsters has a chance to drop some amount of gold, but the most lucrative rewards come from the Bonus Gold system. On floor 1 and every 5 floors beyond, you are given the 'Disciplined Heart' and 'Relentless Timer'. The Heart breaks if you take damage, and the Timer breaks if if a countdown runs out. If 5 floors are cleared with either one intact, a large sum of gold is rewarded, and each is reset. Unlock When certain conditions are met, a new playable character will unlock. Each character has a special ability and comes with a unique weapon as well. Weapons are not restricted to the character they come with, so experiment to find your favourite combo! Spend When you die, you are sent back to the Armoury and lose the upgrades you picked. But not all is lost - you keep some of the gold you found. This gold can be spent at merchants to unlock permanent power - this is how you get further and further into the game. These unlocks can increase the gold you gain, let you take more upgrades, power up certain characters, and much more. Progress The further you go, the more gold you can earn. The more gold, the more unlocks. The more unlocks, the further you can go... but can you get far enough to uncover the source of the horde of monsters...?
