row.short_description: Rally your band of rogues to battle the spooky monsters haunting the Pirate's galleon! In this top-down shooter + rogue-lite game, power up with temporary upgrades, then spend gold on permanent power once you fall in battle.

row.name: Shape of Clouds
row.detailed_description: Welcome to Shape of Clouds, a captivating art game that challenges your creativity and spatial skills! Immerse yourself in a world of pixelated beauty where you embark on a unique journey to restore stunning pictures. Gameplay: In Shape of Clouds, your mission is to reconstruct intricate images by strategically rotating voxel pieces. This innovative puzzle experience combines the charm of traditional art with the excitement of 3D gameplay. Each level presents a canvas waiting for your touch, offering a refreshing challenge for your mind and a feast for your eyes. How to Play: - Select a level and observe the fragmented picture. - Click and drag to rotate voxel pieces until the picture is restored. - Enjoy the satisfaction of revealing the complete artwork. Diverse Themes: Explore a vast array of themes, from serene landscapes to vibrant cityscapes. Shape of Clouds takes you on a visual adventure through multiple levels, each featuring a distinct atmosphere and artistic style. Whether you're a fan of nature, architecture, or abstract designs, there's a puzzle waiting for you. 3D 360-Degree Perspective: Engage with the game in a way you've never experienced before. Shape of Clouds provides a dynamic 3D environment with a 360-degree perspective, allowing you to view and manipulate the voxel pieces from every angle. This adds an extra layer of immersion, making each puzzle-solving moment more enjoyable. Features: - Unique voxel art style - Intuitive controls for easy rotation - Relaxing yet challenging gameplay - Multiple levels with diverse themes - 3D 360-degree perspective for a truly immersive experience
row.short_description: Keep calm and drag. Then drag some more. Find the right angle to reveal the hidden beauty. Relax and enjoy the amazing artworks you will discover.

row.name: Museum Mystery: Deckbuilding Card Game
row.detailed_description: Museum Mystery is a fusion between deckbuilding rogulite game and narrative adventure with intriguing secrets waiting for you to uncover. Your first night as a museum security guard takes a disastrous turn. Animated exhibits, awakened gods, and total chaos. And it’s your job to restore order until dawn. Explore Various Eras Museum halls are portals into history. Literally. Walk through each era, from Ancient Egypt to the 19th century, to find the roots of what’s happening. Battle With Unique Enemies Museum exhibits have come to life. And most of them are mad. Try to calm down this amazing pieces of art. Master Hundreds of Cards Find cards of ancient artifacts or practices. Combine them, unlock new mechanics and craft your perfect hand. Adventure Through History and Art Talk with historical figures, complete side-quests and help legendary characters! Features 4 historical eras to explore 150+ cards to create the best deck possible Unique relics that give unprecedented power Can you solve this Mystery?
row.short_description: Museum Mystery is a deck-building, story-driven roguelite adventure where museum exhibits come to life, wreaking chaos. Explore halls from different eras, battle works of art, collect your own deck of artifacts, and solve the mystery!

row.name: Red Planet Rampage
row.detailed_description: Red Planet Rampage is a dieselpunk western-themed arena shooter where robots face off on Mars with wacky modular guns. Win gun parts in auctions and assemble a unique combination among hundreds of possible weapons! The game is developed by volunteers at Hackerspace NTNU and is free and open source! Lore The robots responsible for terraforming Mars have donned cowboy hats and started wreaking havoc with staged shootouts and competitions where they auction off rudimentary weapon parts assembled from scrap. Terraforming Inc. is still investigating the cause of this disturbance, but rumors point to a fateful upload of a western film. Features Modular weapons with wildly different parts; over 500 different combinations Auctions where players bid on these weapon parts Splitscreen and online multiplayer Fast-paced movement with rewarding tech Weapons Reload by playing a rhythm minigame or shaking a soda can Shoot bouncing cowboy hats Mount a frying pan at the end of your gun as a makeshift shield Slay your enemies in one hit with a rubber barrel that wiggles uncontrollably and more!
row.short_description: A build-your-own-gun FPS! Play online, splitscreen or vs. AI in this goofy party game with over 600 unique weapons! Outbid your opponents and assemble the wildest weapon on Mars!

row.name: 热血大唐
row.detailed_description: 新手攻略 大唐新手第一天不走歪路 热血大唐和传统SLG游戏不一样，没有所谓的开荒期，不需要种地，所以不是很肝。前期的发育更偏向于卡牌模式，本篇攻略就是简述大唐新手期第一天如何不走歪路正确的玩下去，内容会从等级提升，阵容选择，技能搭配，游戏玩法等多个方面阐述，下面进入正题！ 一、正确的升级之路 1. 大唐游戏里面的等级是用官职来表示的，升级其实也就是升官，升官则需要政绩，政绩就代表经验值，等级提升可以解锁武将等级上限，解锁建筑等级，解锁新的游戏活动，而且政绩是和氪金不相关的，你和氪佬永远在一个水平线！ 2. 政绩的来源： 2-1：靠时间自然增长，增长幅度和你的官职等级有关！ 2-2：提升建筑政务殿等级，这个建筑需要一定的等级才能解锁升级。 2-3：城府中处理政务，政务每2小时回复一次，最多只能存6次。完成后会有政绩，举荐令和元宝奖励，当你完成政务时的等级越高，获得的政绩越多！ 2-4：每日活跃任务奖励，这是每天政绩来源最多的地方，另外每次加政绩多少也和当前等级相关！ 2-5 ：章节任务和每日战功排行结算，这些差距不大，不细说。 二、游戏玩法 第一天游戏主要任务就是熟悉游戏玩法，跟着主线任务（章节）玩，把活跃任务完成即可。剩下的就是SLG常规玩法，开始打白城！这里城池也有守军和耐久，先打完守军才可以拆耐久，所以需要多组织点人手一起进攻，当然你单人打城也行，当做混战功就好。 战功在地图的下方可以点击“功”查看，打战功会有奖励领取，非常丰厚。而且打城死兵的战损会累计计算返还粮食和征兵加速劵奖励，所以是一点不会亏，不用担心打城把兵死没了，可以说第一天你完成可以从开服打到睡觉，兵都可以续的上，而且也不用一直盯着游戏，因为有挂机系统，你只需要选择队伍进攻，在预备兵足够的情况下，系统会帮你自动补兵自动攻城。 另外战功有排行，排行每天晚上会结算一些小奖励，每四天结算一次大奖励，大奖励中最主要的是称号，给大家看一下第一名的称号属性，其他称号以此递减就知道了。 白城分为5种，分别是都城、关城、郡城、县城、要塞。除了要塞打下来没什么奖励以外，其他城池第一次打下来都会触发民情任务，奖励资源和抽奖劵。其他城池在攻打的过程中，杀敌前三名和拆迁前三名都是有元宝或粮食奖励的。 About the Game 官方玩家交流群273173422 官方客服QQ3400343120 福利礼包详情请联系官方QQ：3400343120 —————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————— 《热血大唐》是一款文字策略养成类国风手游，具技能搭配、兵种相克、武将选择、答疑解密、国战策略等多种烧脑玩法。 隋朝末年，炀帝迁都避难 群民怒起，诸地烽火连连 时值乱世，英豪居高临下 无主大兴，看我逐鹿中原 广积粮，勤训兵 寻将觅相，修城挖壕 这江山，我主沉浮 那乱世，由我终结。 游戏以隋末唐初架空故事为大背景，你将作为一名出生寒门的小生，经历层层筛选，在严格的科举考试中脱颖而出，初入朝堂，涉世未深，要从最基础的处理政务做起，步步为营，利用自己的智慧步步高升，最后还天下一个太平！掌控权利，治理天下，再现大唐盛世！ 在朝堂上，处理政务、招募英才、发展国家； 在战场上，战法制定，募兵养将，攻城略池。 征战沙场，一统天下，还乱世一个清平安定！ 【游戏特点】： 【治国升官 醒掌天下权】 开局只是一个小小的主簿，勤勉治国，处理政务，真实还原唐朝官职体系升迁路线。从小小的主簿一步一步登顶权利高峰，随着官职提升而不断增加新的治国玩法。从最初的处理政务，到提升官职之后的判定冤案，平定叛乱，在其位而谋其政! 【文韬武略 百变技能秀】 武将的战法不再固定，每个武将都可以学习多样的技能。缴械、嘲讽、治疗、真伤、火攻、护盾等等近百技能可自由组合，技能组合好，一队打十队！秀出你的智商，秀出你的谋略！ 【兵种克制 人各有所长】 兵种之间存在克制关系。武将之间擅长带领的兵种也不一而同，让正确的将带正确的兵，才能实现效益最大化！以少胜多！ 【军争武械 专属锻造屋】 历数历史名将，说不清是武器成就一代名将还是名将成就武器凶名，名将专属武器需要你来指导锻造，成就麾下无敌英姿！ 【联盟互动 一起打天下】 战场最让人感动的就是，你从来不是一个人在战斗！在这里有战友，有牺牲，有并进，有迂回。为了统一天下，携手并进！
row.short_description: 《热血大唐》是一款文字策略养成类国风手游，具技能搭配、兵种相克、武将选择、答疑解密、国战策略等多种烧脑玩法。游戏以隋末唐初架空故事为大背景，你将作为一名出生寒门的小生，经历层层筛选，在严格的科举考试中脱颖而出，初入朝堂，涉世未深，要从最基础的处理政务做起，步步为营，利用自己的智慧步步高升，最后还天下一个太平！掌控权利，治理天下，再现大唐盛世！
developers: 广州玖趣网络科技有限公司
publishers: 广州玖趣网络科技有限公司

row.name: Apathy In Our Stars
row.detailed_description: After being in cryogenic storage for 18,000 years, re-emerge into the galaxy and try to make a name for yourself! Buy your freedom, upgrade your ship, and save the galaxy from an all consuming hive mind! And maybe even more... Discover what the Tretsi look like! Why have the humans formed an alliance with a Spider race? Who keeps breaking the galactic speed limit near Rehbe? And why not get married while you're out and about in Juxin? Inspired by Star Trader and Star Control 2, explore the galaxy and find all it has to offer! 14 aliens to meet and talk with 5 different ships 14 upgrades to buy and 26 to earn in quests 9 main quests and 20 side quests 22 enemies to fight 3 varied endings 80,000 words of dialogue 24 unique songs Supports cloud saves, and can transfer save data between phone and PC 100% free and done as a hobby project!
row.short_description: Meet some aliens, make some money, and save the galaxy while you're at it!
row.reviews: “This is what you've been working on for 2 years?” 12/10 – My Wife “Oh dude, maybe redraw that one more time. Come on now.” 11/10 – My Friends

row.name: Holo X Break
row.detailed_description: It was your usual daily life over at hololive HQ in Holo City, until one day their CEO mysteriously disappears! Moments later, a nefarious organization who called themselves 'holoX, the Secret Society' announces their plans to take over the world! Play as the talents of the Vtuber group Hololive to fight your way through the minions of holoX and put a stop to their plans in this classic style beat-em-up! -Play as different talents of hololive, such as the talents of Generation 5's 'NePoLaBo', each equipped with their own unique abilities and super attacks! -Find various kinds of equipment that will change the way you play each time! -Use quick consumable defensive or offensive items to change the tide of battle -Fight action packed boss battles against the members of holoX -Up to 4 players local with online in an upcoming update -Easy to pick up and get right into the action -Challenge harder difficulties that will put your skills to the test! -The 'X' in the title is silent. This game is published under CCMC Corp(※1)'s Indie game brand 'holo Indie'.(※2) This game is allowed to be monetized under the examination and terms of 'holo Indie'. Please note that any monetized derivative work games that include Cover Corp.'s content outside of holo Indie is not covered by these terms and is not allowed. ※1. About CCMC Corp. CCMC Corp. is entrusted with website management (ex: steam) including, examination, publishing and other necessary tasks by Cover Corp. ※2. About 'holo Indie' holo Indie's objective is to cooperate with hololive production fans and creators. It is a game brand that offers 'Game Creator Support Program' for the derivative work games. For more details about 'holo Indie', Please refer to the Cover Corp.'s 'Derivative work guidelines'.
row.short_description: Fight your way through endless waves of holoX's minions! Gear up with all sorts of equipment and items in this action packed beat-em-up to reach the 5 bosses of hololive's 'holoX', and put a stop to their plans!

row.name: 伏魔
row.detailed_description: 'Fumo' is a 3D MMORPG with the theme of Eastern Immortal Heroes. The game is set in 'Fengshen Yanyi' as the story background, showcasing the increasingly fierce struggle between Buddhism, demons, and Taoism in the human world 1500 years after being Fengshen. It showcases the story of once again creating a new world after the escalating disputes between the mortal world, the immortal, demonic, and divine realms in the human world! The combination of beautiful Chinese painting style and ancient epics creates a magnificent and imaginative painting scroll for players.
row.short_description: 'Fumo' is a 3D MMORPG with the theme of Eastern Immortal Heroes. The game is set in 'Fengshen Yanyi' as the story background, showcasing the increasingly fierce struggle between Buddhism, demons, and Taoism in the human world 1500 years after being Fengshen.

row.name: 我在2083年的末世求生 Playtest
Manor Madness
row.detailed_description: Manor Madness is a 3D, third-person sandbox game. In this game, you play a young ghost, Ghustav, who wants to learn how to become a real poltergeist. As a ghost, you can possess, throw, and interact with different objects around the house. Observe each visitor carefully to understand their fears and exploit them to make the humans’ blood run cold. Ghustav attends Polterhigh, the most prestigious school for poltergeisting. In the course Manor Madness, you will learn what it means to be a poltergeist and what abilities are at your disposal. In each assignment, your goal is to scare all the humans out of your assigned manor. Currently on sale, the manor is frequented by humans interested in buying the building and a realtor trying his best to sell the house. He needs to get creative in finding excuses for your spooky shenanigans. The realtor has a soothing effect on the other humans in the room. Distract him to maximize your scariness. Will you merely be able to send a shiver down their spine, or will you succeed in scaring their pants off? Your class starts now! Key Features Possess and interact with different objects Every room in your manor is equipped with unique objects for you to discover. Possess different objects and throw them across the room Interact with objects, flicker the light switch, or play an eerie melody on the piano Polter Sense Tap into your ghostly senses and see beyond the mortal realm. Use your Polter Sense to discover all the objects you can use.
row.short_description: You have been accepted to Polter High. As a ghost in training, you will learn how to scare people away from your assigned manor. At the end, it will be time for your final test before becoming a fully certified poltergeist.

row.name: Striker Manager 3 - Online Football Manager
row.detailed_description: JOIN THE DISCORD About the Game CREATE YOUR LEGACY Striker Manager 3 is the best multiplayer football manager game that combines the fun of traditional football games with the ability to own your in-game assets. Generate income by trading your in-game assets, get your plot in the world of Striker Manager 3 and become the real owner of your club. . BUILD A FOOTBALL EMPIRE In Striker Manager 3 you are not just a player, you are a true owner and creator of your own world . Each user manages a unique plot where you can build from scratch whatever you want to make your plot grow in value and beauty. COMPETE AGAINST REAL MANAGERS Compete daily against real opponents from all over the world and climb to the top of the Striker Manager 3 league. Each season lasts two months and you will have to face promotions and relegations depending on your team's performance. You will also compete in the Striker Cup and you will be able to organize private leagues to play online soccer matches against your friends. SHOW YOUR TACTICAL SKILLS Make your mark and define how your team will play using the advanced tactical tools that Striker Manager 3 puts at your fingertips. Is your football style based on counterattacking or do you prefer to keep possession of the ball? Talented players or physical wonders? Show us your style of play. EXPERIENCE REAL TIME 3D GAME PLAY Our advanced match engine gives you the opportunity to feel every football match with passion and in real time . Take care of your fans and make them fall in love with your team to get great attendances at home matches. STRIKER PASS Striker Pass allows you to unlock rewards by reaching new levels (25 per season) of in-game experience. Rewards can be acquired through the free Striker Pass, or through the Striker Pass Exclusive (Reedem Ucoins). Reaching new experience levels will unlock a free reward (not all levels have free rewards) and, if you have the Striker Pass Exclusive, you will always unlock an exclusive reward in each level .
row.short_description: Join the online Football Revolution and become the best Manager ever. Striker Manager 3 represents the nextgen of Football Manager games. Control all the management tools that Striker Manager 3 puts at your fingertips to take your team to the top.

row.name: Fantastic Haven: Prologue
row.detailed_description: ✨ WISHLIST THE FULL GAME You can now wishlist the full game on Steam! About the Game Fantastic Haven: Prologue is a free version of Fantastic Haven. In a world where magic is gradually disappearing in favor of technological advances that threaten the balance, you play the role of the Elders, protectors of the continent. While the inhabitants prefer to hunt the creatures and gradually abandon magic, your mission is to restore the balance by saving the fantasy creatures, while using diplomacy and teaching to convince people to live in harmony with them. Features: 4 creatures to encounter, save, and reintroduce into their natural habitat 10 buildings to unlock 1 region to explore 7 narrative events
row.short_description: Save fantasy creatures and protect them until releasing them into their natural habitat. Build your shelter, explore the neighboring region, and encounter a series of events.

row.name: The Bonerooms
row.detailed_description: Bonerooms is a PvPvE multiplayer game about surviving in an ever-changing maze. Use an array of items to sabotage, deceive, and explode your friends as you fight to be the last one standing! Bonerooms is designed for 4+ players! For the best experience, gather some friends, put on headphones, and use the in-game VOIP! Online Play with up to 8 players A maze that is constantly changing 15+ Items to use to defend yourself or sabotage others Per-round maze modifiers to keep you on your toes Proximity VOIP Bonerooms can be played in one of three Game Modes: Try to be the last one standing in Free for All Outlast the other team in Red vs. Blue Work together to survive as long as possible in Co-Op!
row.short_description: The Bonerooms is a goofy horror-themed multiplayer game about surviving in a living maze. What will be your downfall? The spooky inhabitants of the maze, or your fellow players?

row.name: Droste Effect
row.detailed_description: Embark on a mysterious journey with Alexandra , who moves to a charming Swiss countryside house. As Alex begins to settle down, she begins to notice strange happenings around her, like what she believes to be vivid dreams about the house's past. Alex will soon find herself forced to uncover the truth, living a bizarre adventure to find out more. Through the memories, Alex will realize that the distant past of the house is closer to her than she thought. Will she be able to escape and get her present back? Droste Effect is a 2D puzzle game with survival horror elements, created using Rpgmaker XP. Experience unconventional mechanics and embark yourself in immersive exploration through interactive minigames and classic puzzles . Look for hidden details and secret memories crucial to both puzzle-solving and understanding the plot. Be curious and observe your surroundings carefully. Immerse yourself in exploration through books, paintings, diaries and more Experience a mix of classic and interactive puzzles Manage survival elements such as sanity and flashlight Uncover a captivating storyline Discover all 4 epilogues in search of the true ending Try to complete the game through achievements and collectibles Unlock a secret extra gameplay Playtime: 2 hours minimum The DEMO is for demonstration purposes only of game mechanics. Storyline, mini-games and puzzles will be different in the full game although the style will be the same. DEMO playtime: at least 15 minutes
row.short_description: Explore the peculiar tale of Droste Effect, a captivating 2D puzzle game. Confront the mysterious past of your new home with Alexandra, uncover secrets, and manage your sanity in an intense adventure. Rediscover the power of memories as you dive into a past that will reshape your present.
row.notes: This game contains flashing lights and visual patterns which may affect players with photosensitive epilepsy or other photosensitivities. Furthermore, this game is not suitable for those who are sensitive to topics such as suicide, depression and religion. Proceed at your own risk.

row.name: VFurrika!
row.detailed_description: About VFurrika! VFurrika! is an addictive puzzle game that combines the charm of your favourite VFur streamers with strategic gameplay. Drop your favorite furry VTuber into a glass and witness them merging into other VTubers upon contact! Gameplay The game is simple: Aim and drop randomly-generated VTubers heads into a glass. Have 2 of the same heads touch each other for them to merge into a bigger head of another type. This kind of gameplay allows combos to be made, but only if you’ve got skills! Once the glass is filled to the brim, the game is over, but you can upload your score to the Leaderboards. Try beating your friends’ scores! Features: Leaderboards Addictive Gameplay Recognizable Faces Cute Visuals
row.short_description: VFurrika! is an addictive puzzle game that combines the charm of your favourite VFur streamers with strategic gameplay. Drop your favorite furry VTuber into a glass and witness them merging into other VTubers upon contact!

row.name: Deteriorate.1
row.detailed_description: 游戏梗概 《化鬼 Deteriorate》是一款动物主角题材的横版解谜恐怖游戏，你需要根据关卡提示解开谜题，并在追逐战中躲避反派的追杀，在【死亡交易】中存活下来。 在怨泽城，如果你是幸运儿，在你死去的瞬间，魂魄会来到雾魇窟。你将与雾魇窟进行一场【死亡交易】，雾魇窟将会为你开设一场“游戏”，赢下游戏，你将会被满足各种愿望，甚至是复活重生；一旦你输掉游戏，你将魂飞魄散，化为雾魇窟的养料。主角猫兽人秦薰梦和她的男友狐犬兽人朱嵌翡获得了一场死亡交易的资格，但这真的是他们足够幸运吗？ 游戏内容 1.此游戏是用rpgmaker制作的横板游戏。 2.游戏里你可以操纵主角进行行走或奔跑。 3.游戏里有不少的解谜可供玩家游玩，玩家需要使用特殊道具或密码来解开谜题。 4.游戏里有难度较高的追逐战（难度具有挑战性，值得尝试） 5.游戏中有大量闪图和CG。 操作 此游戏全程由键盘操作，请注意。 移动：方向键或WASD 确认或调查：Z/空格/回车 菜单或取消：ESC/X 跑步：SHIFT 设置：F1 注意：很多地方的事件需要特定的朝向才能触发。 关于实况与同人 欢迎实况与同人作品！！！！！ 成人内容描述 本游戏包含部分血腥暴力画面以及闪图，请注意。 本游戏包含少量暧昧动作情节。 特殊 由于作者能力有限，只能制作简体中文版本，十分抱歉。 最后祝大家游戏愉快！！！
row.short_description: 《化鬼 Deteriorate》是一款动物主角题材的横版解谜恐怖游戏，你需要根据关卡提示解开谜题，并在追逐战中躲避反派的追杀，在【死亡交易】中存活下来。

row.name: Karos Classic
row.detailed_description: Karos. Rebirth: Classic Edition is a classic of the MMORPG genre, with an amazing fantasy world in which you will find the most unusual adventures. The variety of locations, a great variety of dungeons and monsters will make you plunge into this world headlong. The beloved world of Azmara, filled with the confrontation between Light and Darkness, returns in its classic form. This legendary version of the game has absorbed all the best things that Karos heroes have loved over the years. It will bring back your original gaming experience and give you the opportunity to take a personal look at the origins of the famous MMORPG and remember how it was used to be. Choose one of four original races, fight for a better future and write your name in the history of your native lands. FEATURES - An ideal opportunity to indulge your nostalgia for your favorite game, untouched by years and updates. ​ - Four unique races and many classes, each of which can be developed by choosing additional specializations. - Intuitive game: no difficulties in mastering. - PvP at every turn: castle sieges, mine captures, endless battles in the open world. - Variety of PvE content: raid bosses, many dungeons of varying degrees of difficulty, which can be completed either alone or with a reliable team. - Interesting Flett system: get the energy of fallen monsters to create powerful equipment that will improve along with your character. - Mounts turn into beautiful accessories when you walk, and your little pet friends are able to grow and develop. - Low system requirements. Years passed, Karos changed, became better, updated. Today, many things look completely different from those in the distant years when we were just launching this legendary MMORPG. And now we are pleased to present you Karos. Rebirth: Classic Edition. It will take you back to the very beginnings of the Karos world and show you what the game looked like at the time of its inception.
row.short_description: The living legend returns in his original form! The Сlassic version of Karos. Rebirth, untouched by years and updates. Maximum level, sharpening level is limited.

row.name: Seeds of Paradise
row.detailed_description: / A linear mini visual novel that takes place in a monster girl brothel set in the same universe as 'Sylvie's Bar.' You play the role of a nameless, overworked man who's come to town just in time for the 'Fruits of the Forest' special. The time of your life awaits you with any of the lovely monster girls of the garden-grown variety, who will make you forget all about your worries and fretting. However, you quickly find that you're too late, and the girls have all gone home for the night. But, the owner seems to have taken pity on you, and maybe things will work out for you, in the end. Welcome to 'Seeds of Paradise.' We hope you enjoy your stay.
row.short_description: A mini side story set in the same universe as 'Sylvie's Bar' featuring a different flavor of monster girl brothels. You play an overworked man who's all but run out of luck, but the sadistic strawberry girl who keeps the business running may just take pity on you, yet.
row.notes: Game contains a scene of dubious sexual consent between the dominating heroine and the main character.

row.name: Brutal Ball
row.detailed_description: Brutal Ball is a multi-perspective option shooter that is also a deadly sport set on far away bizarre alien arena locations. Each team has a two meter tall spiked ball that can be controlled and thrown. In addition to its deadly spikes, the ball’s electric field will damage players if any contact is made. The ball will decrease in size depending on how many kills a team has. As the spiked ball shrinks, the ball becomes a more effective weapon and easier to shoot goals with. Oh yeah, players can also shoot their opponents if that is what they are into. Four different gauntlet weapons that cater to different play styles are available to choose from. Points are given for goals, and from traditional kills. Player motivation: As a hybrid, Brutal Ball has the strengths of both multi-view shooter and regular team-sports games. The game offers players a competitive environment with team building elements in addition to kill or be killed action. Outsmarting the opponent is key. To thrive, teammates must coordinate plans and execute them to be successful. Anyone who has ever been on a team knows: the bonding that comes from working as a team makes victory even sweeter. Plus, who doesn’t like killing opponents in different and exciting ways?
row.short_description: Brutal Ball is a retro-styled shooter-sport hybrid where players can kill each other with gauntlet weapons or giant controllable spiked balls of destruction. Players strive to work together and dominate a match scoring goal after brutal goal.
row.notes: Game contains strong violence, blood, gore, dismemberment, decapitation, gun and sword violence, exploding guts, and light cursing.

row.name: From Nava
row.detailed_description: From Nava is a 2D action puzzle game, set in the remains of a mysterious laboratory. You are equipped with only a seemingly ordinary pen that possesses the extraordinary ability to unleash magic attacks by drawing specific patterns. You must escape from this abandoned research laboratory by gathering all the keys and polaroids left behind in the aftermath of an unknown incident. Navigate through all 9 sectors using spells learned from fighting enemies or interacting with nearby objects. Various monsters and puzzles are all that stand in your way from fulfilling a stranger's final wish and unravel the mysteries of the world and yourself. Features 2D Movement and Action Casting Spells by Drawing Specific Patterns Customizable Patterns 9 Areas 5 Secret Rooms 5 Main Spells Detailed Pixel Art Various Puzzles with Multiple Solutions Assortment of Collectables Achievements This game is best played with a mouse and keyboard.
row.short_description: Uncover the secrets of an abandoned research laboratory by drawing patterns to cast powerful spells in order to escape a puzzle and monster-infested world.

row.name: Planetary Parfait
row.detailed_description: Based on ASU’s Mars Space Flight Facility JMARS GIS tool, Planetary Parfait is a platform for interactive access to planetary datasets, designed to enhance research and education around a plethora of planetary data collected by NASA instruments. Planetary Parfait supports collaboration between collocated and remote users across VR and desktop platforms, making it ideal for teams working together in real-time or asynchronously. Users can prepare terrains using JMARS GIS, save them to their accounts, and easily access them in Parfait, bringing the terrains and complementary scientific data layers into an immersive 3D environment. Whether you're analyzing surface features, navigating a lunar landing site, or preparing a virtual field trip to Mars, Planetary Parfait provides an engaging and dynamic way to interact with 3D terrain data.
row.short_description: Planetary Parfait is a scientific visualization platform that immerses you in custom 3D terrain and data layers while offering cross-platform collaboration between desktop and VR users. Engage in conversations over rich scientific data.

row.name: Aegis Dilemma: Veritas Omnia Vincit
row.detailed_description: Aegis Dilemma is now here on steam! Several centuries have passed since the Blight Era ended. All the suffering of the time seems to be over. Enter the journey of Jules, a normal mercenary thrust into unusual circumstances. Follow her journey to find the truth about herself and her close friends…. All to resolve the Dilemma. All for the Grand Library. Veritas Omnia Vincit A short 1 hour Visual Novel that explores the duality of humanity, and the mystery of which how the Aegis Dilemma came about. MEET THE CHARACTERS Jules the Survivor. A seducer, killer and a mercenary. Master of Infirma Punctium. she takes on a job which changes her life forever.... Cigar the Raider. A bandit chief of the Sorol Plains. Master of the control of hate and Odium Arts. His raiding of a particular person changes his life forever... Adeline the Hero of the Federation . A Former Konrad Federation officer. She struggles to accept her past which changed her life forever... Metcha the Tenebris Flammae . A mysterious girl with no remorse yet has a childlike attitude. Her encounter with Septium changed her life forever... Septium and Novem the Librarians . Former friends now turned enemies. Their service to the Grand Librarian changed their life forever.... Keywords: Aegis, Aegis Dilemma, Veritas Omnia Vincit, Latin, Adventure, Visual Novel, Philosophical, Linear, Story Rich, Story, Free, Descriptive Combat, Mystery

row.name: Umbrella Girl
row.detailed_description: 'Use an umbrella to defeat your enemies!' Umbrella Girl is a 2D belt-scroll action adventure game. You can enjoy various actions through the character's type transformation, and become the main character to free citizens from acid rain by defeating villains who suppress citizens through acid rain. “Umbrella Girl” consists of 4 stages, 3 bosses, and several quests. The three-stage combo attack, defense, and shape change will make your play more diverse. Have fun!

row.name: CLeM: The First Attribute
row.detailed_description: CLeM: The First Attribute is a free prologue that offers the first loop of CLeM, a narrative-driven puzzle adventure game with a dark twist. You awaken in a cold, dimly lit room, your senses slowly adjusting to the surroundings that, oddly, feel familiar. A strange sensation lingers in you, reminding you that something is not quite right. As you find your bearings, your attention is drawn to a peculiar item on the ground. A notebook labeled 'CLeM' lies before you. As you delve into its pages, covered with intricate sketches of insects accompanied by vague symbols, you find a note containing a cryptic message: “Bring me BEAUTY.” Lost in deciphering the contents, a voice interrupts your focus. Puzzles intertwine with exploration, weaving a unique narrative experience we call “Puzzlevania” with a shadowy story to unravel and countless challenges to overcome. Craft magic toys to unveil hidden secrets, access unreachable spots, and reclaim items from the past as you uncover new revelations in familiar spaces. Investigate a seemingly desolate house accompanied only by an obscure voice and a notebook full of annotations and drawings on alchemy, insects, and other creepy crawlies. Choose your fate in this dark story of manipulation, pride, forgiveness, and redemption. Features: A new genre, “Puzzlevania,” intertwines puzzles and exploration. Discover hidden secrets in each room as you delve deeper into the mysteries with every crafted magical toy. Unique and beautiful art style with hand-drawn elements. 2D graphics with 3D environmental navigation. Challenging and diverse puzzles to solve. An enigmatic story with a dark turn.
row.short_description: CLeM: The First Attribute is a free prologue that offers the first loop of CLeM, a narrative-driven puzzle adventure game with a dark twist. Wake up in a world where puzzles intertwine with exploration, weaving a unique narrative rooted in alchemy.

row.name: 陌界·终末序曲
row.detailed_description: A fantasy role-playing game with multiple endings, created using genuine RPG Maker XP and its materials. It uses up, down, left and right keys, spaces, esc, and shift controls, making it easy to get started. The game features features features such as a follower system, shift partner dialogue, and multiple endings, enriching the game's duration by more than ten hours. The story takes place in a world that appears stable on the surface but is plagued by hidden crises. The protagonist will face numerous encounters, sacrifices, and separations throughout the ten-year long story, as well as an unknown outcome that cannot be chosen. In the end, facing the crumbling world, the protagonist realizes. What he has experienced in the past ten years may just be a prelude to the end. Also: This game does not support English, please understand.
row.short_description: A role-playing game with multiple endings. Throughout the ten years of life from childhood to adolescence, the protagonist will experience encounters, sacrifices, choices and separation. Also: This game does not support English, please understand.

row.name: Blast Them All
row.detailed_description: SURVIVE ENDLESS WAVES. The growing waves of zombies challenge you and your dexterity. Keep your cool and put on a good show in the face of ever-increasing difficulty. ADAPT TO CHANGING ARENAS. At the end of each wave, the arena you survived fades away to make way for your next challenge. Take advantage of the new layout, weapons and traps at your disposal and try to survive. GO WILD AND SCORE MAXIMUM POINTS. Chain together elimination and ignite your gauge. Annihilate the zombies in your path and boost your multiplier before blasting your score. Push on and die proudly, with your name at the top of the leaderboard. STRENGTHEN YOURSELF DURING AND BETWEEN WAVES. Collect upgrades and take advantage of their contents to perform during the round. After each special wave, choose upgrades from the store and make good use of your reroll tokens to adapt your upgrades and push your survival further.
row.short_description: Reload your weapon, the show's about to start! Blast Them All is a wave-based twin stick shooter where you face endless hordes of hungry zombies. Use your agility, pick up weapons and activate traps to defend yourself, build up your strength, collect points and reach the top of the leaderboard!

row.name: Merchant Isle
row.detailed_description: A language Metroidvania and merchant game that includes story elements. Be a merchant in a new land with unfamiliar languages. Learn different languages to be able to communicate with people of different villages. Unlock new ways of interacting with villagers as your knowledge of the languages increases. Expand your language skills to be able to trade in new ways and understand the supply and demand in each village. Embark on a journey with mysterious languages to learn and island villages to connect. Features Learn new languages . Use language knowledge to unlock new NPC interactions. Become a travelling merchant . Explore ancient ruins for items. Negotiate trade prices . Balance making money with your reputation
row.short_description: As a language Metroidvania, Merchant Isle invites you to a tranquil world to be immersed in language, trade, and exploration. As you unravel the mystery of your ancestors, you'll negotiate with locals, forage for resources, and uncover hidden secrets. A cozy adventure awaits! 🌴💬🌊

row.name: Desktank
row.detailed_description: Desktank is a cozy idle aquarium that lives right on your desktop. Inspired by the charm of idle games like Rusty’s Retirement , Desktank brings a peaceful underwater world to your screen — whether you’re working, browsing, or just taking a break. You decide how you want to experience it: 🖥️ Keep it tucked in the corner like a cute screen companion, 🌊 Or let it float freely across your whole desktop for a full aquarium takeover. 🐟 Features: Idle Aquarium Gameplay – Fish swim, grow, and interact while you focus on other things. Desktop Integration – Always-on-top mode lets your tank float over your workspace. Customize Your Fish – Change fish colors and styles to create your perfect underwater vibe. Dynamic Ecosystem – Watch your tank come alive with fish behaviors and interactions. Peaceful & Non-Intrusive – No stress, no pressure — just ambient chill. Fully Customizable View – Resize, position, and theme your aquarium to match your mood.
row.short_description: A cozy idle aquarium that lives on top of your screen. Watch fish swim, grow, and interact while you work or relax. Desktank turns your desktop into a peaceful underwater world — float it in the corner or let it take over the whole screen. Just sit back and enjoy the calm.

row.name: HHHalloween
row.detailed_description: The story takes place in a small town full of rumours, where we will play as a little girl 'Fire', collecting candies, dealing with small troubles, getting information from various NPCs, and finding the truth of the rumours about the 'Halloween Devil'. The game has three endings. The game has three endings, each containing a different message. By reaching each ending, the story comes together in a way that may not be complete.
row.short_description: Play as a young girl who was sent to an orphanage just a month ago to find the truth about the Halloween demon. The game is a role-playing turn-based RPG. Players need to collect as much candy as possible, talk to passersby as much as possible, and advance the plot.

row.name: Divine Twins
row.detailed_description: Indie Game, Open World, Dual-Character Development! Catch fish, hunt monsters, dash, jump, with diverse gameplay and elemental reactions involving fire, ice, lightning, and poison! Companion Dual-Character Features : In a sunset-lit courtyard, vegetable garden, stable—capture various pets, plant crops, fish, hunt, gather resources, raise pets, race, battle, explore, idle, trade, raid dungeons, treasure hunt, cook, craft... A complete gear system and totem gameplay enhance the adventurer's ultimate abilities! New dimensions and hellish corrupted demon dungeons await your challenge! Game Overview Built on a self-developed engine with a brand-new upgrade, enjoy seamless dual-character open-world adventures with even more freedom. Use various attribute-based explosive barrels to catch fish or hunt monsters. Jumping fruits let you leap into the air or dive into the sea—thousands of different items to use! Weapons can be freely combined, and dual characters can switch gender and profession anytime: Sword skills with fire attributes, staff skills with ice attributes, bow skills with corrosion attributes, blade skills with lightning attributes. Elemental Reactions: Fire + Ice = Steam Damage Fire + Poison = Burning Poison Damage Lightning + Corrosion = Overload Damage Lightning + Ice = Frostshock Damage Under the moonlight or in daylight, your companion dual-characters await. In a sunset courtyard, vegetable garden, stable—capture pets, catch fish, hunt, cook, gather resources, raise pets, race in pet competitions, experience elemental reactions, jump and fly, battle, explore, treasure hunt, idle, team up... This open-world game offers endless fun. Switch freely between characters, control any one of them. Adventure with your partner, watch the flowers bloom and wither together in this vast world...

row.name: OrcinUS: Orca Pod Rescue
row.detailed_description: Your pod has been captured by a cruel marine park - only you can rescue all the orcas to reunite your family! SWIM FOREVER In this 'Endless Swimmer' game, you play an orca swimming through the ocean, catching fish and avoiding dangers. The simple one-button controls are easy for anyone to learn! EXPLORE VIBRANT BIOMES Your journey starts in a beautiful coral reef, but the quest to save your pod from cruel SlamWharf will bring you across the seas. Discover new food (and dangers) as you progress on your missions. RESCUE YOUR POD Unlock 4 unique playable orcas - each has different skills, swimming stats, and personality traits. Bring your family together! COMPLETE CHALLENGES Through dozens of unique missions, master the seas to level up your character and unlock new sights. The challenge doesn't stop there - several stats are also tracked for each swim, so you can always increase your high scores. UNLOCK COOL POWERUPS Grab powerups from helpful bubbles to slow time, gain lives, shatter obstacles, and more! Catch 6 fish in a row and your orca will gain a special boost. Plus, as you level up, additional powerups become available, so there's always more to explore.
row.short_description: Explore the sea and save the killer whales in this 'Endless Swimmer' game. Discover unique biomes, orcas, powerups, and more!

row.name: Santa's busy day
row.detailed_description: 'Santa's Busy Day' is an atmospheric little arcade game . You control Santa's sleigh and fly over roofs, trees, churches, and more. The goal is to drop presents at the right time, so they fall into the right place. There are two modes in this game: Compete with players around the world. Who can drop the most presents without crashing into a building? This mode will get progressively harder and faster . For everyone who wants to enjoy the peace and atmosphere of Christmas. It's specifically designed to be relaxing. There's no score, and it doesn't get faster – just for you to enjoy. If you're not yet in a Christmas mood, maybe you will be because of this game. That's our goal.
row.short_description: Santa has a hard time, delivering all his presents on time. In this little Arcade Game, you will help him fly over the roofs and drop the presents in the right spot. But be careful:The game gets progressivly harder, as Santa's reindeer is flying faster and faster and faster.

row.name: Notes To Myself
row.detailed_description: 'I'm writing to myself so they won't find my words...' Notes To Myself is a first-person horror game where you must navigate and escape from the embodiments of your worst fears. Pull switches, collect flashlights and run from demons in an unsettling world that exists between reality, your nightmares and your OS. So, you want to escape from the control of your keepers? Maybe the inspections have been getting a little 'too much' for you, or you wonder if you'll ever stop scratching the day counts into the wall/wrist? It ain't so simple, I'm afraid, since you are unable to function in the 'real world' and you've been sedated for so long it is impossible to tell what is real and what is fantasy. Well, let's break it down: when you are scratched, the scratch doesn't hurt, but you interpret it as pain, yes? So is this world, reality on the outside but the horrors of the world on the inside... or is it? Maybe all of those sedatives actually made you pass into the 'other world' where there really isn't any escape? Fortunately for you, the player can always reset the game , and maybe you'll be safe... or be trapped forever until the next update?
row.short_description: The horror began when you wrote your first note.
row.notes: This game contains fantasy violence, unexpected scary moments, and unsettling imagery.

row.name: AIMX
row.detailed_description: Free, easy to use & efficient aim trainer. Improve your aim on exercises made specifically for the game you wanna imrpove at! An aim trainer created by players. As passionate gamers with a strong desire to improve, we naturally became interested in aim training. After experimenting with various options, we realized that none of the existing aim trainers fully satisfied our needs. This is where the idea for AimX was born, a simple and intuitive aim trainer designed to provide players with exercises that are specifically tailored to the game they want to practice for. Players don't need 10'000+ exercises but only the ones that will help them improve the most. In the long term, AimX will analyze each player’s strengths and weaknesses to provide customized exercises. We want AimX to interact with its community in the way we wish all games would: listening to players, taking their feedback, needs and preferences into account to evolve in the right direction.
row.short_description: Free, easy to use & efficient aim trainer. Improve faster!

row.name: SaiBorRai

You shoot at everything that moves, try not to die, find memes, fight bosses, play minigames and have fun. features ● Easy-weapon customization On the Go ● Memes... Memes Everywhere ● Minigames such as 'WeebClicker and Pinball 3 double-D' ● Adjustable character lean that can break your spine ● NoobMode if you die too much You can attach a 16x sniper scope to your handgun and climb walls in this mode as character heath decreases less Note! there is going to be a parkour level if you like climbing walls in the future, but to access wall climb, noobmode is required ● WeebOS'The most Weeb Operating system in the world ● Cool Graphics with shiny walls ● Repair weapons on the toilet ● Loot enemies and get free stuff'You can pick up their weapon as they do not need it if you Finished them' ● Adjustable enemy AI that makes the AI either very stupid or Insane ● Bosses and Semi-bosses that has your teddy ● The Cat girl's tail is a USB-C charge Plug because why not? ● Decypher mode that does nothing but it looks cool'Spot Goons behind walls and check out the character in Third-person because she's freaking awesome!' the story Of Nakano the Saiborrai It's the year 2032 and Nakano finds herself back in the city of Aluminescence on a revenge mission against the goons who stole her farvorite teddy bear back when she was just 7 years old, They did also kidnap her parents and demanded a ransom, but as she only had monopoly money her request to get her teddy and parents back were ultimately declined. To hopefully one day seek reuninion, she started to train at Aluminescence's most highly rated Dojo and became Samurai of the year. But as the RatKing took control of the Goons and became their leader, she knew they were too powerful for her to handle alone and she needed help, so at the age of 20 after many painful years of mastering SAiFU, she turned to the one and only Mr. Nakamoto and kindly asked him for help. Though a powerful proccess and many Monolopy dollars later, he started to slowly replace Nakano's most crucial parts with cybernetics such as Ultra-strong cybernetic claws and high-fidelity hearing and eye-sight that gave her 'SUPA STRENGTH' making her one deadly samurai. The operation took several days and was deemed a success. As Nakano became history's first Cyborg-Samurai combi with insane 360 Noscope/Teabagging abillities, she was ready!. It is now your task to help Nakano defeat the goons , Get back the teddy
row.short_description: The Meme First-Person Shoot em' up in a Cyberpunk/SteamPunk world. Find Memes, Fight Enemies such as mutants and goons. Pick up your gun, shoot anything that moves and you'll be fine

Their is also Sexualized characters wearing revealing armor suits but no physical nudety, Certain In-game Characters does wear either slightly or highly revealing outfits that might not be suited for people under the age of 16.

row.name: SUPER LIFTPIA
row.detailed_description: Pick up the enemy and throw it! This is an action game drawn with dots that gives you a nostalgic feel. The difficulty level is set to low. The main character of this game, Lifton, is skilled at 'lifting up' his enemies. If you step on an enemy and flip them over, you can lift them up. Enemies can be lifted up in two layers. The lifted enemy can be swapped up and down with the up key. And you can throw the enemies in the lower row by pressing the X key. If you lift a specific enemy, that enemy may exhibit mysterious abilities. *This game does not use any text other than the title and staff roll.
row.short_description: Pick up the enemy and throw it! This is an action game drawn with dots that gives you a nostalgic feel.

row.name: Dark Memories: Prologue
row.detailed_description: About the Game Dark Memories is an episodic psychological horror game based on road thriller, slasher, and survival thriller genres. You are currently viewing the prologue episode of the Dark Memories anthology. Dark Memories: Prologue - Brenton Lake In the prologue episode of Dark Memories, you play as Benjamin, who is traveling to his friend Sarah's family house at Brenton Lake. As he enters the rural roads, weather conditions rapidly deteriorate and heavy snowfall begins. Benjamin finds himself alone on desolate roads, unaware of what this night has in store for him. The conditions that leave you vulnerable are filled with unpredictable dangers. The Prologue episode covers a small portion of the full story. Key Features Atmospheric environment and realistic graphics VHS film aesthetic Driving mechanics Dialogue and messaging system with NPCs Environmental interaction The prologue episode has an average playtime of approximately 15-20 minutes and aims to showcase the game's atmosphere and narrative approach.
row.short_description: Dark Memories is an episodic psychological horror game based on road thriller, slasher, and survival thriller genres. You are currently viewing the prologue episode of the Dark Memories anthology.
row.notes: The game features objects stained with blood and includes dialogue that contains strong language and profanity, which are integral to the narrative and ambiance of the investigative experience.

row.name: FADE^2
row.detailed_description: ||   This game is a prototype of our game, 《Nientum - Opus ZERO》.   || 　Everything became ashen, 　and a long lingering wish awakens. 　Deep in the cemetry, bleached within vast snow blindness, 　another wish, yet blue, is withering out. 　… desperate for the reanimated one. 　How fated would they be? 　Shall they be allowed to be redeemed? 　May the melody FADE to guide the way... * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * FADE^2 is a 2D action game that brings platformer, runner and music interactive genre all together. A desperate journey of the reanimated one, and the storytelling of music from the world. Menu control : Mouse Game control : F (jump) / J (ground) Single Gem : short input, Long Gem : long input, hold until the line ends. Special Flower : collide to be harvested.
row.short_description: FADE^2 is a 2D action game that brings platformer, runner and music interactive genre all together. A desperate journey of the reanimated one, and the storytelling of music from the bleached world. Run along the music, and play along the course!

row.name: Cover Yourself in Blood
row.detailed_description: blood floats on blood 1) wait for it to blood 2) cover yourself in blood 3) Cult classic 3D horror parody game, now on Steam! With now skins featuring 'The NecroCat', 'Long Toe', 'The Grand Stroker', 'Flame Face', 'KirbyPeter', and more to equip and 'Cover Yourself in Blood'. Break your high score because the game now has achievements and a brand new leaderboard !
row.short_description: It's raining blood. Blood floats on blood.
