row.name: Idle Fishing
row.detailed_description: Key Features Idle and Active Fishing with a mini-game. Hire Crewmates with unique stats and bonuses Ascension System with Big Upgrades Tree . 800+ In-game Achievements with rewards. 52 Weekly Holiday Events with many rewards. Buy Buildings to buy to generate income for you passively. Many Research upgrades to improve your fishing income. Many boats to unlock. Beautiful environments to visit with unique fish. Daily Quests
row.short_description: Relax and catch fish in a beautiful environment. Hire skilled crewmates, invest in lucrative buildings, unlock many boats & upgrades. Dive into the challenge of the fishing mini-game for an interactive experience unlike any other!

row.name: The Bard for Her
row.detailed_description: You are a bard that enjoys a hedonistic lifestyle. Your conservative, disapproving uncle sends you off to an institution to rehabilitate you. He threatens to take away your inheritance if you refuse him. Without much choice, you decide to play along with his wishes. At the institution you'll meet several women, the other residents likewise sent there by family members. Get to know them and their stories, as you romance them, and find a way out of the institution. The game is a visual novel with map exploration. You'll play your lute and woo the ladies in various places around the map. Featuring five women with different looks and personalities, get to know each, as you build a relationship with them and perhaps a future.
row.short_description: A visual novel, dating sim with map exploration. Play a womanizing bard with a lute and romance and build a relationship with five attractive women.
row.notes: Game contains nudity and sexual content intended for mature audience.

row.name: Tribes
row.detailed_description: Gear up for Non-Stop Action Join the action-packed world of Tribes, the low-poly First-Person Shooter by Block Bastards. Battle it out in beautifully designed arenas, armed with Interoperable weapons. Are you ready to dominate the competition? Use your own Interoperable Weapons — Elevate your gaming experience with Tribes. Unlock powerful weapons and bring them for a competitive edge like never before. With seamless interoperability, you can dominate in Tribes and beyond. So why settle for a standard arsenal? Bring your own weapons and emerge victorious. Explore all the different Tribes — Embrace the diverse cultures of the Rapper Tribe, the soulful Blues Tribe, the electrifying Metal Tribe, the laid-back Country Tribe and much more. Each tribe brings its own unique flair to the battlefield, offering distinct playstyles and aesthetics that will resonate with every gamer's preferences. Challenge your friends in different Game Modes — Experience the thrill of strategic teamwork and precision aiming in Capture the Flag. Dominate the battlefield alongside your squad in Team Deathmatch and test your individual mettle in Free-For-All battles! Defend your Tribe in all the different maps — Battle across a variety of maps, from the bustling parking lot to the lively festival map and the gritty docks in Shipyard, testing your mettle. Adapt, outsmart, and defend your tribe to victory!
row.short_description: Dive into the future of gaming and wield your own arsenal of weapons against adversaries. Most importantly, revel in the chaos of possibilities that the weapons provide in this new type of game and have an absolute blast!

row.name: Onward and Upward! DX
row.detailed_description: Meet Lily, an energetic young lady with a love for exploration. One boring day at school, Lily looks up at the sky and begins to ponder. 'Is the moon really made of cheese?' Determined to find out, Lily sneaks out and tries her hand at some parkour using her parasol, to try to make her way up to the moon. Look, man, I don't know either. Help Lily make her way to the moon! There are four tough levels to overcome, each more difficult than the last. Float across deadly chasms, grapple your way through tight corridors, and make your way upwards! And for an extra challenge, you can try finding the big coins! Once you've perfected the main game, there's also an extensive cheat selection to spice things up! With its tight controls, colourful graphics and expertly-crafted levels, as well as a great soundtrack, this short yet addictive game is sure to keep you coming back for more! This game also features a simple yet robust level editor that allows you to make your own Onward and Upward! DX challenges! Create the exact setting you wish for your level, play it through and share it with the world using Steam Workshop! From clever puzzles to devilish gauntlets, there's always something new to play! Originally made for GBJam 11.
row.short_description: Climb from the Earth to the Moon to try and solve an urban legend! Brave tough challenges as you float and grapple your way up to the tune of a great soundtrack! Be sure to bring a space suit, and get climbing!

row.name: Charrua Soccer - Mirror Edition
row.detailed_description: This is CHARRUA SOCCER!, with the same action and adrenaline that you already know from the Pro Edition, in this edition, you can face other players in Mirror Online matches! Mirror Online? yes! this is something new in football games… two simultaneous matches, one overall score! Control your local team and direct your remote team. The combined goals decide the winner! A ranked game mode, in which while you directly control your local team, another version of your team, playing as the visitor, faces the opponent on the remote PC, following the strategy you define in advance. Both players will be aware of what happens in the remote match, even being able to view the replays of the best moments from each game. Create and lead your team to glory, competing in ranked mode or playing with friends. You can face your rivals alone or if you wish, you can even invite friends to play on the same team, a feature available by connecting locally or through Steam Remote Together. Mirror Online: An original mode- a new way to play and compete against remote opponents. Two Matches Simultaneously- Home and away games, with remote match event alerts! Control your home team- you face the rival team under the direction of your opponent. Manage your remote team- with your direction, your team will play against the rival. Evolve your team- by playing you will get XP to improve your stats. Ranked Leagues- start at the bottom and lead your team to compete among the best. Ranked Matches- find an opponent with similar skills to play mirror online. Friendly Matches- play Mirror Online matches against a friend. Cooperative Matches- invite your friends to join your team to face rivals. The connection of these friends can be local or through Remote Play Together. Store: Earn coins as you play to buy cool items in the store, like custom balls, flags, stadiums, and player cosmetics – think unique hairdos to dog costumes. The possibilities are endless! Link with the PRO Edition: Those who already own or plan to purchase the Pro Edition will also benefit from accessing their thematic items, stadiums, balls, etc., in Mirror Edition as well. The Mirror and Pro versions are linked, the coins earned in both editions are unified, as are the items purchased in either store. That is, if you need coins for an item that you want to buy in the Mirror store, you can also collect coins by playing the various game modes available in the Pro edition. Features: Intuitive yet challenging gameplay, perfect for all skill levels. Dual control modes cater to both casual and seasoned players. Customizable assistance – turn it on for help or off for a tougher challenge. Realistic soccer elements: fouls, cards, injuries, penalties. Options for women's, men's, and mixed teams. Variety of moves: passes, shots, and specialty skills like Chilean kicks. In-depth team management: formation, strategy, substitutions, and more. The Mirror Edition promises endless entertainment! Are you prepared to challenge friends or fight for the title of ultimate champion?
row.short_description: Mirror Edition? Absolutely! Dive into the action and adrenaline you know and love from the Pro Edition, now face off against players online in both friendly and ranked matches through Mirror Online. Create your team, enhance it with every match, and progress until you reach the Elite league!

row.name: Меліній
row.detailed_description: Меліній — сюрреалістична, приправлена жорстокістю та гумором, візуальна новелла з елементами RPG. У цьому куточку Всесвіту Ви — голоси у голові Меланії. Хоча й безформені, але з характером. Будете її підтримкою, чи спаклюєте життя – вибір за вами. Аліса — давня подружка головної героїні. Вона буває допомагає з роботою та дуже полюбляє чай. Чаювання — чудовий привід знову зібратися у колі друзів. Саме на нього вас запросили. Та чи пам'ятаєте ви шлях? Допоможіть Мелі дістатися чаювання! Протягом своєї подорожі вирішуйте головоломки. 1 основна та 7 побічних кінцівок! Різноманітні спрайти та іллюстрації. Цікаві сюрреалістичні персонажі та локації. І пам'ятайте, кожна річ має свій сенс.
row.short_description: Сюрреалістична, приправлена жорстокістю та гумором, візуальна новелла з елементами RPG. У цьому куточку Всесвіту Ви — голоси у голові Мели. Вас запросила на чаювання давня подружка головної героїні. Та чи пам'ятаєте ви шлях?
row.notes: Graphic violence and death, blood, strong language, depictions of anxiety and incitement to suicide.

row.name: Kona & Snowrabbit
row.detailed_description: Kona, an ice artist with a reputation for mischief, and Snow Rabbit, a snow-white rabbit. After hearing rumors of the mermaid god Aquis, the two young artists set out to create the ultimate ice sculpture of the mermaid god and to break into the monastery of the mermaid god, known as the 'sea on land'. Quarter-view casual 'frozen' shooting action with a twist on the arcade genre. Cool 'Frozen' action Frozen Action Is A Must to Defeat Enemies! Your snobbish but reliable partner, Snow Rabbit, has the ability to freeze enemies by firing ice bullets. Once frozen, you can freeze them a second time to break them, or smash them with your hammer to send them flying! Nostalgic arcade gameplay We've included all the 'yummy' elements of the arcade genre! Intuitive controls with the attack button to attack and the dash button to dash, Stage-by-stage progression through rooms filled with menacing enemies, And an item that gives you access to a powerful attack for a brief moment! Personalized Comedic Elements Rabbit with ice coming out of its mouth is used as weapon and the rabbit turns into hammer, Enemies get frozen in the air and sink underwater, the protagonist is a villain who makes his enemies suffer... Enjoy the humorous atmosphere of this game with its comedic elements!
row.short_description: Kona, an ice artist with a reputation for mischief, and Snowrabbit, a white-furred snow rabbit full of desire. After hearing the story of Aquus, the mermaid goddess, the two down-on-their-luck artists break into the monastery of Aquus, nicknamed 'the sea on land,' to make a statue of a goddess.

row.name: Spark of Survival
row.detailed_description: Spark of Survival is a top-down 2.5D tower defense strategy game in which you must defend your kingdom against an incoming robot invasion using the five unique elemental towers at your disposal. Place, upgrade, and move towers strategically to form the strongest possible line of defense. Combine the effects of various towers to create elemental reactions that destroy the approaching robot army. Advance through increasingly difficult levels to finally destroy the robot leader once and for all. Key Features Unique elemental towers 25 tower upgrades Buy, move, and sell towers 16 types of enemies to destroy 3 levels
row.short_description: Defend your kingdom by fighting back against an approaching robot invasion. Place, upgrade, and relocate elementally-charged towers strategically to destroy incoming robots. Watch as elements collide and combine to create explosive reactions!

row.name: Paws Trail
row.detailed_description: Game Description: In this original adventure game, featuring a charming black cat as the protagonist, players will explore a beautiful forest, uncovering hidden secrets and unlocking mysterious doors. This game combines enchanting storytelling with gameplay that allows players to meet forest friends, and embark on new journeys with the cat. Key Features: 1. Enchanting Storyline: Follow the black cat on a mystical journey through the forest, meeting friends along the way. 2. Beautiful Graphics: A fantastical world filled with rich colors, lush forests, and vivid characters. 3. Meet Forest Friends: Interact with various animal friends in the forest to unlock new stories and puzzles. 4. Exploration and Discovery: Uncover hidden secrets as you explore every corner of the forest. Why It's the Perfect Choice for Players: 'Paws Trail' is suitable for all ages, with beautiful graphics and a captivating storyline that will transport you into a mystical world of the forest. Join the black cat on this adventure to meet new friends and experience an unforgettable journey. Embark on your forest adventure now with 'Paws Trail'! * This is still a visual demo version.
row.short_description: 'Paws Trail' is an enchanting adventure game where players guide a charming black cat through a mystical forest and unlocking secrets along the way. Experience a vivid world filled with engaging challenges and endearing forest companions.

row.name: KoChaos
row.detailed_description: Hi! I'm Alexander and this is my game KoChaos! This is a project I've been working on since 2020. Me and a buddy always discussed wanting to make a game in middle school and I went for it. It took me forever to get the idea down but I think I've got it. In KoChaos, you aim to defeat minions and bosses to collect XP to get extremely powerful. There are four difficulties that you can use to your advantage. Start small on Easy and work your way to Ko difficulty. There are eight heroes you can level up to your heart's content. Each has three abilities and there primary attacks to use at your disposal. There are tons of bosses to fight and conquer as well. -Features- - You can use glowing emerald swords. - Every bit of XP you gain for a hero stays with that hero and the stats. - The longer you play the easier the game becomes. - Guns are here for some reason. - Dash like never before! - You can infinitely ascend your heroes to make them extremely powerful. - No cap on stats. - The enemies have one eye. I hope you hop in the game and enjoy!
row.short_description: Slash, shoot, explode, vaporize, smash, and destroy, enemies with eight heroes to use to your advantage! Fight tons of bosses on one of four difficulties in the incredibly difficult souls-like/risk-like. The game takes inspiration from Risk of Rain 2, Dark Souls combat, and Vampire Survivors.

row.name: VIRTUE
row.detailed_description: VIRTUE: Virtual Interactive Reality Toolkit for Understanding the EIC VIRTUE is a standalone particle physics event display application designed for both desktop and virtual reality. Take a closer look at the future Electron-Ion Collider (EIC) at Brookhaven National Lab, or create and upload new detector geometries and particle physics data to be animated. Features: ePIC Detector Model: Investigate the ePIC detector model, including X-Ray and engineering versions, to understand its design. Simulated Electron-Proton Collisions: Witness simulated electron-proton collision events, showcasing the science planned for the future EIC. Customizability: Customize detector geometries and animate collision data using JSON and FBX files, adapting the application to new collision scenarios or experiments beyond the EIC. Animation Features: Freely navigate the virtual environment to investigate the detector and individual collisions, or set the camera and event animator on a loop for smooth, professional-level animations to record for presentations and demonstrations. Education and Outreach: VIRTUE serves as an educational resource, engaging young students through virtual reality and offering a unique exploration of collider experiments to physics enthusiasts. With its customizable features, VIRTUE offers an excellent opportunity for undergraduate-level projects, allowing students to adapt it to explore and understand new experiments in the field. Developer: Sean Preins Supervisor: Prof. Miguel Arratia Simulations and detector design by the ePIC Collaboration SketchUp detector model: EIC Project Menagerie Music: Josh Puddington Logo: Justyna Babinska ”JustaSuta” TriLib 2: Ricardo Reis This work was supported by the University of California, Office of the President
row.short_description: A customizable event display for collider experiments for desktop or virtual reality. Explore electron-proton collisions in the ePIC detector at the future Electron-Ion Collider, or upload your own detector geometry and detector data to be animated.

row.name: Mortal Glory 2 Prologue
row.detailed_description: Buy the full game! More skills, new game mode, unique items, bosses and a lot more! About the Game Mortal Glory 2 Prologue gives a quick glimpse into what the full game contains. Roll an explosive barrel at your enemy, throw them into a pit or take out two enemies by knocking them into each other. With a wide variety of tools available to you, your creativity will determine how you deal with the competition. Unique arenas, randomized environments and occasional special rules ensure that each fight offers new tactical opportunities. A wide variety of fantasy races are seeking glory, each with their own unique racial strengths. Whatever your tactics are, finding the best recruits is essential! There is a vast collection of unique relics, character perks and more to discover. Finding clever combos and deadly synergies will unlock new strategies and occasionally turn your gladiators into unfairly strong demons. Various difficulty settings will accommodate your preferred playstyle and there are increasingly harder challenges to master. But beware... The AI is brutally talented at the highest levels. With every step comes a new challenge or perhaps... an opportunity? It is up to you to guide where your team should travel next... and suffer the consequences. Each playthrough is different! With various tactics to try and additional increasingly harder challenges to master, the arena will keep welcoming you back again and again. Thanks to conveniently paced combat, Mortal Glory 2 is also great to play if you only have a moment to spare.
row.short_description: Manage a team of traveling gladiators in this turn-based fantasy roguelike. Find the best recruits, tinker with unique items and discover clever tactics on the battlefield. The tournament awaits those who desire MORTAL GLORY!

row.name: Trail of the Wretched
row.detailed_description: A land of danger and decay. You hop off the boat and step onto the dirt of the New World. The wind is suffocating. The people are suspicious. Outlaws roam free and corruption is an everyday fact of life. Between the small towns littered across the continent is a vast wilderness where no sane person would dare to venture. You are entirely out of your element, but there's no turning back now. Take those pictures like you were told to do, and try not to say anything stupid. Trail of the Wretched is a bleak visual novel set on a fictional continent inspired by the old west. You play as a photographer sent across the ocean to capture the New World in all its untamed and horrible beauty. You'll argue with the voices in your head, witness unspeakable acts, cross rivers, acquire a fancy new coat, put your head in a noose, and maybe, just maybe, you'll say something profound. Length: 1-2 Hours.
row.short_description: Nobody said being a photographer was easy.
row.notes: Explicit language and gore.

row.name: Sluggerpunk
row.detailed_description: About This Game Dive deep into the underground world of Sluggerpunk, where shadows loom large and danger lurks around every corner. Here, beneath the surface of a corrupt city, you arm yourself with nothing but a trusty baseball bat and baseballs to beat back the darkness and carve out a legend all your own. Make yourself stronger by buying powerful upgrades from Telebi's shop. Shock, burn and blast your enemies into oblivion by combining up to five items, creating your own unique way of fighting the perilous underground. Whether you're a seasoned adventurer seeking the ultimate edge or a newcomer eager to embark on your journey, our shop has something for everyone. Key Features: Fight enemies using your baseballs and bat by giving them bullet hell. Find and equip items that will grant you new abilities to fend off enemies. Mix and match them to see what builds you can come up with! Defeat the Grand Master Boss, and rob him of his golden crown. Survive in an arena mode that will require every possible trick you got up your sleeve. The longer you survive the stronger you, and the enemies, get.
row.short_description: Sluggerpunk is a gripping 2D survivors roguelike adventure. As you navigate through a myriad of challenges, hone your skills and strategies to clash with formidable foes lurking in the underground. Build a versatile arsenal of abilities and gear to enhance your chances to survive, but will you?

row.name: Satori
row.detailed_description: Satori is a Hack & Slash Roguelike game with a third-person camera where a mask allows you to choose between different passive abilities and a ghost arm gives you different special abilities that you must use to fight against yokais and Japanese gods, all with a unique aesthetic. Cell Shading in three colors. Satori consists of starting in a lobby, going through two rooms with simple enemies and finally reaching the boss room. Each enemy will give you coins that you can exchange in the lobby for new skills or character upgrades. If you die, you will always return to the lobby.
row.short_description: Satori is a Hack & slash game made as a final Master Degree project. Immerse yourself in a world of samurai and mystical creatures in this Japanese Hack & Slash. Master deadly skills as you unleash mayhem and honour in epic battles.

row.name: Anesthesia
row.detailed_description: Anesthesia is a third-person horror puzzle game about a young girl who woke up in a dreamy nightmarish hospital and must escape while on the look out for something dangerous lurking... 3rd person gameplay Explore a creepy and haunting environment Solve countless puzzles Gather clues that may lead to your escape This game was developed as a student project at DigiPen Institute of Technology and was created for educational purposes only. Please check out our publisher page for more information.
row.short_description: A third-person horror puzzle game about a young girl who woke up in a dreamy nightmarish hospital and must escape while on the look out for something dangerous lurking...

row.name: Furballer
row.detailed_description: Be welcome to the puppet show ! Today, The Furballer will amuse you with a unique performance: football puppet destruction. Furballer is an arcade game where you take on the role of a puppet football player: The Furballer. Navigate the stage, kicking the ball into the enemy puppets to rack up points and secure the best show. The public will rate your performance live so be sharp, don't miss and keep on kicking ass... or heads !
row.short_description: Furballer is an arcade game where you take on the role of a puppet football player. Navigate the stage, kicking the ball into the enemy puppets to rack up points and secure the best show. The public will rate your performance live so be sharp, don't miss and keep on kicking ass... or heads !

row.name: Sputnika Game
row.detailed_description: Meet our little friend Sputnik. Help its journey to become the greatest star in the solar system - the Sun! Unique Gameplay With Cosmic Gravity Cosmic gravity is applied to the planet, which makes it different from the classic Suika-style game. The ability to target the other side of the planets adds much more strategy and depth to the game! Merge Planets Match two identical planets to create bigger celestial bodies. Discover 10 dazzling planets, each with its own place in the solar system! Watch out for the bubble! If the planet pops out of the bubble, it's game over. Meet the Adorable Planets Our planets aren't just celestial bodies – they're full of life! Watch them interact – they might greet each other with a smile or gaze curiously at one another. Get ready for a whole lot of cuteness as you merge your way through the solar system.
row.short_description: A Cosmic twist on a Suika-style game with space gravity. Help our little friend Sputnik on his journey to become the Sun.

row.name: シモツケノヤカタ
row.detailed_description: ゲームの紹介 森の中、気を失っていた臆病な少年は、 一緒に居た妹の姿が見当たらない事に気付く。 慌てた少年は、近くで踊っている不思議な生物『ベレト』に 恐る恐る話しかけ、ここが現実とは異なる森だと教えられる。 それでも妹を探すという少年。 妹を探す手伝いをするというベレト。 一人と一匹は森の中、不気味に佇む洋館へと足を踏み入れる……。 ーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーー ドットで描かれたどこか懐かしい雰囲気が特徴的な2D探索型アドベンチャーゲームです。 リアルタイムで進行するゲームシステムや多数のイベントに加え、マルチシナリオ、マルチエンディングを採用。 RPGツクールによるゲーム制作の限界に挑戦しています。 動画等配信に関するガイドライン 収益化に関わらず自由に実況及び配信していただけます。 実況時、SNS、配信の概要欄に『#ワンコネさん観に来てね！』と記載されたら開発陣がお邪魔してコメントをさせていただくかもしれません。 逆に恥ずかしい！という方はタグはつけないでゲーム実況を楽しんでください。
row.short_description: ヤカタを探索して消えた妹を探す2Dホラーアドベンチャーゲーム。 妹が消えた理由と不思議な生物達の目的は・・・ ダークでメルヘンなホラーアドベンチャーゲーム、是非楽しんでください！
developers: 株式会社ワンコネクト
publishers: 株式会社ワンコネクト

row.name: Incursion2D
row.detailed_description: Fast paced reactive combat  Wave based enemies with unique moves each increasing in difficulty Advanced bossfights that don't care about your stats Decorate your own island and enhance your home which acts as the games' storage system Work on secondary skills and systems to enhance the power of your character: Farming, Alchemy, Fishing, Smithing and much more to come Gather equipment to change up your build Unlock new attack combo's/styles and ultimate abilities throughout your journey Personalize your characters by grinding out pets, outfits and character auras Combat should never be boring and require your focus at all times, that's why instead of having the player choose a class, you get to utilize each combat style at once! Quick swapping between melee, magic and ranged allows for mixing in a lot actions at once, increasing involvement and clearing out monsters in style! Each category of enemy you encounter in the world will have plenty of variants jumping into the fray to hit you with surprise mechanics! You will clear waves of these invaders in each room until you find the leader of that specific category! Getting to a boss and being able to finish it should feel satisfying at all times. Because we believe in the concept of making sure bosses should always be challenging, in this game you will not actually be able to out-level a boss to be able to cheese through it! Player stats aren't relevant in these fights and are a true test of skill and using your toolkit! Is that not enough for you?  Fear not! For each boss will have a hardcore version available with instakill mechanics that will be sure to keep you on your toes! How can one feel at home in a game without actually having a home? And why should you stop there? Enjoy a magical floating island that you can customize using all sorts of art assets that you encounter throughout your journey! You'll also unlock more floating islands as you progress further! Need a break from cutting through your enemies? Why not get stronger while doing that as well? Skills will give you passive combat increases and unlock various ingredients needed to upgrade other systems as well as materials to purchase furniture for your player owned island! You like shiny things? So do crows but don't let that stop you! At the end of every set of waves you slap a crystal which will reward you with a random piece of loot! Mix and match to get the build you want and try to get the rarest drops on the tables! Sometimes you just want to stop and admire. Unlock various outfits, pets and auras throughout your journey that will show off your progression and challenges in a fun way! And yes these will be shown off when multiplayer comes around (soon!) as well! - Continued Multiplayer support. Currently you are able to meet and chat to people online. You can always play in a party and heal/buff each other. In the endgame you are also able to tackle combat challenges together in the forms of dungeons! More of these will become available throughout the lifecycle of the game. - New skills will be added over time and upon the release of each new continent! - Controller support  already exists in a basic form. While the game is playable with a controller, certain features are still missing on it and it's not very smooth to navigate a menu. This will be iterated upon further down the line. - Content that gets added as you go. For this Early Access release you will have access to the first three continents of the game, the Weathered Woods, The Empire and The Frozen North!  We will gradually release new areas and bosses for you to progress through . Below is a sneak peek at what the world map looks like currently! We hope you'll enjoy your stay! Come help us shape the game at our Discord, let us know your thoughts or just join us for a conversation!
row.short_description: A fast paced action RPG where you will fight increasingly difficult waves of enemies, each with unique abilities! You will be fighting various bosses, work on your secondary skills, collect cosmetics for your character and work on your very own island!
row.notes: Contains fantasy violence and animated blood. Not all language used in the game may be suitable for children.

row.name: Westland Survival
row.detailed_description: Survive the Wild West and Build Your Legacy Step into the unforgiving world of the Wild West. In Westland Survival , you’ll build and expand your own ranch, tame fierce beasts, craft powerful weapons, chase outlaws, and take part in intense PvP showdowns—all in a world teeming with danger, opportunity, and mystery. Build and Expand Your Ranch Establish your homestead from the ground up. Gather resources, craft workbenches, and fortify your property. Grow crops, rear livestock, and turn your ranch into a true frontier stronghold. Tame, Breed, and Fight with Pets Hunt wild beasts, tame them, and turn them into loyal companions. Breed animals at your ranch to unlock stronger perks and build your ultimate pack—whether it's wolves, bears, or other fierce allies. Every predator you meet at the prairies can be your ally—even alligators! Raise and Ride Your Horses Build stables and breed horses with unique traits. Whether you need speed for swift travel or strength for hauling wagons, there’s a wide variety of types and colors to choose from. Craft Weapons and Gear Survive with a handcrafted arsenal. Forge everything from classic revolvers to durable armor. Discover rare blueprints to improve and customize your loadout to fit your playstyle. Engage in PvP and Join Alliances Prove your mettle in duels and clan wars. Join forces with other players in alliances, compete in ladders like Gold Rush, and dominate the Wild West!  Explore Mystical and Dangerous Frontiers This land holds more than outlaws—it echoes with the ancient legends of the Indigious, now brought to life. Venture into mysterious locations like the Canyon Trials and the Spirit Cave, where facing mythical forces grants powerful rewards. Uncover a Rich and Twisting Storyline The West holds secrets beyond survival. Follow a gripping storyline filled with frontier justice, ancient mysteries, and personal revenge. Meet unforgettable characters, investigate the disappearance of your sister, and face choices that shape your path through a lawless land. Dive into Regular Events and Challenges Experience rotating in-game events, time-limited challenges, and global activities that keep the frontier full of fresh content and rewards. Answer the call of the Wild West. Build your ranch, ride into battle, and become a legend.
row.short_description: Saddle up for the ultimate survival adventure in the untamed Wild West! Build your homestead, tame the wilderness, bounty hunt the outlaws, and duel against the dangers that lurk on the frontier. Do you have what it takes to be a legend of the West?

row.name: Blaster Multiplayer
row.detailed_description: About This Game Overview: Immerse yourself in the relentless action of Blaster Multiplayer , a third-person shooter. Striking a balance between strategic depth and high-octane gameplay, this game offers a robust platform for both competitive gamers and those looking to showcase their game development acumen. Gameplay Details: At its core, Blaster Multiplayer delivers dynamic combat scenarios across varied environments, each requiring a distinct strategic approach. Engage in the classic Deathmatch and Team Deathmatch modes where skill, precision, and teamwork pave the path to victory. As a showcase of technical prowess, 'Blaster Multiplayer' is a testament to sophisticated game design, featuring polished mechanics, seamless multiplayer experiences, and a display of advanced graphics. Key Features: Multiplayer Excellence: Enjoy refined matchmaking in both Deathmatch and Team Deathmatch modes. Varied Battlefields: Compete across multiple maps, each offering unique strategic advantages. Futuristic Armaments: Access an extensive arsenal of high-tech weaponry and gadgets. Visual and Technical Finesse: Powered by Unreal Engine 5 for groundbreaking visuals and physics. A Developer's Craft: More than a game - a professional portfolio piece exemplifying top-tier game development. Step into the Arena: Blaster Multiplayer beckons you to a constantly evolving battlefield. Perfect for those aiming to climb the leaderboards or scrutinize expert game development, the game stands ready to challenge your skills. Are you prepared to join the ranks and leave your mark ?
row.short_description: Thrust into the fray of Blaster Multiplayer, a tactical third-person shooter where strategy meets intense combat.
row.notes: This Game may contain content not appropriate for all ages, or may not be appropriate: Frequent Violence, Cruelty or Blood.

row.name: Timber!
row.detailed_description: Timber! is a 2D point-and-click storydriven game that takes you on an emotional journey. Explore a mix of feelings from the heart-wrenching struggles of dementia to the unraveling of a tragic story, all within the enchanting embrace of a whimsical adventure. Are you ready to play a game where your future is wasted, but your past has just begun? Find, click and combine! Explore and find useful items to help you on your way. Sometimes just a simple , boring everyday ~stick~ won't help you, but what if you combine it with fire ant eggs and ketchup? Hmm, makes you wonder... Talk, listen and learn? Sometimes you just have to listen . I know , you like to talk more, but I promise you, it will help you in the end... - Or you just wasted your whole day listening a story about a hedgehog with golden sandals and hearing a weirdly detailed description of the weird rash your neighbor has.
row.short_description: Dementia, tragedy and fun – all in the same taste of a potato! Timber! is a 2D point-and-click storydriven game that takes you on an emotional journey. Explore a mix of feelings, from the heart-wrenching struggles of dementia to the unraveling of a tragic story.

row.name: Karina Katana
row.detailed_description: Description Karina Katana is a classic 2D-style action adventure in a world divided into individual levels with 8 exciting biomes. Gameplay You level up your skills to traverse the different worlds and fight 8 different types of enemies. Every opponent has different strengths and weaknesses. You need to recognize these and use them against them. Upgrades Each enemy drops different items when you defeat them. Collect your opponents' items and use them to improve your weapons and skills in the shop. Items / Skins Find new items in the newly unlocked biomes and unlock new skins by playing. Speedrunning Each level also has a timer with which you can see your speed so you can be faster next time. You can also get up to 3 badges for different challenges for each level.
row.short_description: A 'Sidescroller' Adventure with Fight Mechanics and Leveling System for your skills and items.

row.name: Desperate ESCAPE
row.detailed_description: Story October 4, 2022 The first missiles hit Germany after an unresolved conflict between world powers. Ted Williams, one of the only survivors of the disaster, barely manages to find shelter in a school bunker. 3 years later: Food supplies are running out. Ted Williams, who is now mentally ill, has to escape the bunker. However, he previously locked himself in the bunker for his own protection and developed puzzles so that he would not be tempted to leave the bunker too early. Now he has to overcome these puzzles and obstacles in order to leave the bunker again after years. This is his last chance to survive... Even in the uncertainty of whether humanity has survived. What awaits you in the game... Six tricky puzzles and codes: Your determination and cleverness will be tested as you fight your way through six exciting puzzles. Find hidden clues, decipher codes and use your knowledge to find your way out. Every puzzle solved brings you one step closer to freedom. Important information at a glance: Name: Desperate ESCAPE Location: school bunker Puzzle: Six challenges that must be solved Objective: Escape the bunker and return to the surface Duration: 30 minutes (depending on speed) Are you ready to take on the challenge of “Desperate ESCAPE”?
row.short_description: Ted Williams, who has been sheltering in a school bunker for three years after a rocket attack, now has to escape due to a lack of food supplies. To do this, he has to solve his self-constructed puzzles and obstacles that were supposed to prevent him from escaping the bunker.

row.name: Ghost Only !
row.detailed_description: For the Resurrection of the Ancient demon! It's a real-time strategy game where you become a ghost, defeat heroes with skulls, and resurrect the ancient demon. Save the Altar! The altar is a place for the resurrection of the ancient demon. The heroes will break into the ghost's estate to deter it. Control the skulls and bring the ancient demon resurrect safely. Control the Skulls! Wake up the already dead skulls. Join forces with the skulls. Learn black magic and regain skull's memory to strengthen your skulls. If you have any bugs or questions, please sen me an email ! : minsang0610@gmail.com . Thank you for playing.
row.short_description: 'Ghost Only' is a RTS game of ghost to resurrect ancient demon. Let's defeat the disturbing heroes with the skulls and bring the ancient demon resurrect to create chaos in the world!

row.name: Rise of the Eternal
row.detailed_description: Rise of the Eternal is a 2D side scrolling game developed in Unreal Engine 5, it seamlessly combines platformer and beat'em up aspects. The pixel art design gives a nostalgic yet modern feel, offering a visually distinctive experience. As players embark on this early journey, they not only face the challenges of the first level but also contribute valuable feedback that will shape the future content of this promising title.
row.short_description: Rise of the Eternal is a 2D-side scroller developed in Unreal Engine 5. It has beat'em up aspects and boss battles.

row.name: 神魔决之九黎剑EA
row.detailed_description: 该游戏是一款独立制作的仙侠风格的战棋角色扮演游戏。 游戏的故事围绕一把魔剑展开，神秘人盗走了封印在门派中的魔剑，为了找回魔剑，主角弈剑秋离开门派，途中遇到女主顾梦瑶，随后二人一起展开一段冒险。 游戏中会遇到各种各样的队友，可以邀请总共20位不同定位的角色入队，不同角色之间会有羁绊效果（制作中，尚未完善），可以根据自己的想法合理搭配阵容。 游戏中有丰富的装备可以选择搭配，同时可以通过重铸功能，重铸装备的随机词条，使得装备搭配更加多样性。 游戏中除了装备，还有魂石系统，不同的魂石搭配也会有不同的效果。 游戏中还有其他的养成要素，就不一一列举了，感兴趣的朋友可以自己来体验一下。 游戏QQ群：634019932
row.short_description: 该游戏是一款独立制作的仙侠风格的战棋角色扮演游戏，游戏的故事围绕一把魔剑展开，神秘人盗走了封印在门派中的魔剑，为了找回魔剑，主角弈剑秋离开门派，途中遇到女主顾梦瑶，随后二人一起展开一段冒险。

row.name: Abstract Code
row.detailed_description: Embark on a unique gaming experience that delves into thought-provoking themes... this SHMUP/Visual Novel hybrid offers a compelling narrative interspersed with addictive arcade gameplay. Play through the captivating Story Mode , immersing yourself in a journey that combines engaging storytelling with arcade excitement. Alternatively, challenge your skills in the pure Arcade Mode , a score attack mode featuring 6 levels of intense action. Explore CODE KNIGHT's personal space within the game, an Apartment where you can enjoy a Juke Box, Gallery, and more additional FREE CONTENT In the digital world of Abstract Code, assume the role of CODE KNIGHT and embark on a mission to rectify the errors made by those less accountable than yourself. Engage in thrilling battles against the FINK incursion into humanities' knowledge center, CODENAME D1, and uncover the truth behind the enigmatic character known as Katie. Please note that the game contains content that may be triggering, as it explores various sensitive topics such as social masking, and transhuman identity. Stay connected with us on our Insta page @_ruok2000_
row.short_description: Embark on a unique gaming experience that delves into thought-provoking themes... this SHMUP/Visual Novel hybrid offers a compelling narrative interspersed with addictive arcade gameplay.

row.name: のり男子っ‼【体験版】
row.detailed_description: Would you like to live a sweet and funny school life with four good-looking noris? 【Story】 This is a world where 'nori' and 'rice' exist as a race. The union of 'nori' and 'rice' is called 'omusubi' and many people long for a beautiful 'omusubi'. The main character, Akita Komachi, transfers to a prestigious high school, 'Omusubi Gakuen', in order to meet a wonderful nori as a rice from a good family. What awaited Komachi were four wonderful 'good-looking noris' ......! Which 'nori' will you 'omusubi' with ......? 【Game Outline】 ・Game genre：Romance adventure game ・Characters to capture：４ noris ・Character voice：Partial only ・Route Branching：None(To be implemented in the full version) This game aims to 'Omusubi' with 'Nori', the target of the game, while reading the story. This game was created by graduates of Vantan Game Academy. Development of the game began while the students were still in school, and now a trial version has been completed with the cooperation of Vantan Game Academy.
row.short_description: 'Wound up? By any nori but me.' A thrilling school life with 4 good-looking nori! Which 'nori' will you 'omusubi' with ......?

row.name: L'Île Archéo
row.detailed_description: L’Île Archéo is a student game project made by student of the NAD UQAC about ecology, archeology and what will remain after we are gone. Play as Titi, a young archeologist on his first field internship on the mysterious Archéo Island, home of the lost human civilisation. Explore the island, rendered in a painterly picture book aesthetics, use your tools to recover and clean the artefacts you find, collect information, and discover the secrets of the island. The game was awarded the Bourse de rayonnement Illogika 2023-2024 as well as the Technical Excellence Award from the CHI PLAY 2023 Student Game Design Competition. Features: Explore the island: The Archéo island is a newly discovered island full of unexplored ruins of the now lost human civilisation. While they were the dominant civilisation of earth for several thousands of years there are now gone, bringing with them their strange tradition and secrets. In a 3d isometric view you will explore the beautifully rendered island with a painterly artstyle. Meet your colleagues: You will not be alone on your adventure, you will work side by side with your field supervisor and muscle bound corvid Corbac as well as your analyst and 8 armed technology expert Poulpa, nothing can go wrong with their expert guidance. Restore artefacts: Use your multitool to explore dark ruins and smash any obstacle standing in your way! By hammering, scraping, brushing, and cleaning, you will recover and restore lost artefact to discover the purpose of those strange fragment of the human civilisation. Uncover the secret of the island! Maybe you will be able to understand and solve the greatest mystery of the island; why did the human disappeared?
row.short_description: Explore a strange island and discover the secret of the mysterious human civilisation. Restore artefacts and uncover the past in this serious game about ecology, archeology and what will remain after we are gone.

row.name: Capybara: The story of Sisyphus
row.detailed_description: Special Offer DISCORD About the Game You play as a very lazy capybara who has to climb a mountain to take a bath in his barrel! It seemed that the capybara had already accepted her fate of not being able to take a bath. Prepare for the falls, try not to fall and keep going. Travel through different eras and reach the top of the mountain! You have a rope with a barrel to balance while climbing. Use all your experience to hold on to the capybara. There are several locations in the game: 🐪 Walk through ancient architecture! ⚔️ See medieval houses and walk through narrow streets! 🌵 Wild West - Walk through a small base and out into the mines! 🍜The City - Stroll down an anime inspired street! ⛰️ Climb a mountain and take a bath! ☯ If you suddenly fall off the mountain, there's a small chance you'll end up on the roof of a steampunk building!
row.short_description: Capybara: The Story of Sisyphus is a game about a very lazy capybara who wants to take a bath at the top of the mountain. To do this, the capybara must gain speed and cling to the obstacles with a rope with a barrel so as not to fall!

row.name: Gun vs. Zombies
row.detailed_description: Welcome to Gun vs. Zombies, the ultimate showdown between firepower and the undead! Brace yourself for an intense, physics-driven experience where your trusty gun becomes more than just a tool—it's your lifeline against waves of hungry zombies. In Gun vs. Zombies, you're in control of a unique weapon that's not just about aiming and firing. This isn't your typical shooter; the gun's physics play a crucial role in your strategy. Every shot you take applies forces to the gun, causing it to move dynamically. Your skill in managing this movement while taking down hordes of zombies will determine your survival. Your mission is clear: defend the precious brain located on the stage. Waves of relentless zombies are relentlessly advancing, driven by an insatiable hunger. It's up to your sharpshooting skills and mastery of the gun's physics to keep them at bay and prevent them from reaching their ultimate goal. Compete against other players and showcase your skills on the global leaderboard! In Gun vs. Zombies, it's not just about surviving the zombie onslaught—it's about proving your mastery. Climb the ranks by showcasing your prowess in eliminating the undead. Are you ready to experience the adrenaline rush of controlling a weapon that challenges traditional shooting mechanics? Get ready to immerse yourself in Gun vs. Zombies, where precision, strategy, and the laws of physics collide in a battle for survival!
row.short_description: Gun vs. Zombies is a thrilling showdown where precision meets undead mayhem. Take control of a dynamic gun affected by physics as you fend off waves of zombies hungry for a brain feast. Compete against others on the global leaderboard by showcasing your shooting skills.

row.name: Per Aspera Test
row.detailed_description: Curious to find out just how fast your mind works in a life-or-death situation? Welcome to the Per Aspera Test – a scary game that looks like those old PlayStation 1 games. Picture this: an intense 5-minute challenge, you against the unknown, racing to survive. Can you make split-second decisions and find your way out? Time to put your skills to the test! And hey, if you manage to escape, we've got some results waiting for you at the end! WHAT TO EXPECT Run for Your Life: Imagine you're in a movie, and you have to run away from scary stuff. That's what this game feels like. Run, make decisions fast, and try not to get too scared! Old-School Design: It's like going back to the old days of video games. The graphics are pixelated, just like the games on the first PlayStation. It's familiar but also kind of spooky. Stressful Challenges: We added some annoying and scary things on purpose to make it extra tough. Can you handle the stress and still be a quick thinker? Attention: Consideration for Visual Sensitivity Please be cautious: if you're sensitive to bright lights, this may not be the right fit for you. Our aim is for everyone to enjoy the game without feeling uneasy. Your comfort is important to us. HOW TO PLAY Run, breathe, and think fast to survive. It's not easy, but it's super fun. When you're done, we'll tell you how quick you were. Share with your friends and see who's the best!
row.short_description: Survive an intense 5-minute challenge in Per Aspera Test, a nostalgic horror game reminiscent of the PlayStation 1 era. Run, decide, and confront stressful challenges. Run, breathe, think fast - can you handle it? Share results with friends and find out who's the best!

row.name: Joy Land
row.detailed_description: This game is chapter based, this is the first chapter of this game! Features Joy Land is a first-person horror game that contains puzzles, exploration, investigation and more! Joy is the one that you always need to count on while playing this game, with her help you can uncover the mysteries of Joy Land. You can communicate with her through your special Joy walkie talkie, or what we like to call, The Joy Communicator! Lewis is the protagonist of this story, he'll try to explore and investigate on what happened to his sister and the many disappearances. Echo your virtual assistant, she's going to help Lewis too, with giving him an access card for many areas, and she's connected in all of Joy Land's devices, so if Lewis needed some help and Joy wasn't there he knows who to call! Welcome to Joy Land! Joy Land is a place to be enJOYed by all ages! Here, we provide you with the best experiences and memories that'll last forever. Making our guests happy is a rule we always follow, ensuring that every guest leaves with joy. JoyBots! To make the experience more enJOYable, our JoyBots are the best at it! They're the most fun, smart and joyful robots the world has ever seen. Our main mascot and symbol, Joy , is a friend for every guest, so if you're lonely you know who to call! Each JoyBot have their own special charm in this place, so what are you waiting for? come and have FUN! The Telly .V Show! How can we forget about Telly? The host with the most! With Telly .V you can have fun, joy, and even receiving education. With Mr. V you can be the next winner!!! So, what are waiting for? Come to Joy Land and sign up TODAY!
row.short_description: Lewis, an intelligent detective, finds himself on a mission to uncover the truth behind the many disappearances including his sister's. With the help of Joy, Lewis is going to explore what lies behind these walls. only to realize that there's much more to discover than he initially thought.

row.name: Finding Cinderella
row.detailed_description: A lighthearted game about love and murder. Assume the role of a royal successor to the throne, who is definitely not very good at their job or the brightest bulb there is, in their quest of finding the love of their life in the upcoming royal ball - select one of the 9 ladies to be your Cinderella. Fun times. But beware! There is an assassin coming for your life disguised as one of the ladies! Oh no! You must reveal the assassin's identity in 3 days time while winning the heart of your future queen. Get to know each lady, search for clues, but most importantly, survive! Multiple playthroughs! Assassin changes every round! Approximately 10 hours of quality time filled with love and blood. 9 or so romanceable ladies Epic minigames that will challenge your sanity as they progress Interactive BGs and daily activities! Achievements! Can you collect them all? Funny and livid dialogue sure to keep you mildly entertained! A unique art style, 20+ CGs, animated sprites! Jampacked with OWO energy throughout! Lady Anna Belle A bubbly daughter of merchants who just wants to know what’s inside your heart. Also, never refuse her cupcakes made with love, NEVER. Lady Sophie de Fleur A lady of royal lineage such as yourself, except that she’s a loner, but wants someone to understand and love her. Will you be able to catch her eye? Lady Juliet Espada Fearless, bold and confident, and a member of the royal guards, this lady sure is no damsel in distress. Humor is her best defense. Lady Katarzyna Von Liechtenstein Horses. Lady Gwynne Vanderbilt A lady with a mysterious background, for some reason, doesn’t show any interest in you at all. Maybe the rumors were true, maybe she did, infact, only come cus her father told her to. Lady Jewell Blue Your childhood friend, you remember her don’t you? A perfect lady in every way, or so they say. Lady Maria Keetab Smart, kind and patient, this lady is a teacher at the local orphanage. Is there a place in her heart for one more child? Lady Anastasia Nikolaevna Romanov I know. Lady Lilly Lupin Curious, energetic and eager to live her life to the fullest, this lady never stops. Will you help her find what she’s looking for?
row.short_description: A lighthearted game about love and murder.

row.name: Cyber Rush
row.detailed_description: Welcome to the adrenaline-fueled world of Cyber Rush, a fast-paced Rogue-Like FPS set in a dystopian future where survival is the ultimate goal. Dive into procedurally generated levels filled with relentless enemies, powerful bosses, and a vast array of futuristic weaponry to clear as many rooms as you possibly can!
row.short_description: Shoot your way through endless plagues of robots and use the game's advanced parkour and movement system to survive. Purchase special weapons and character upgrades to get stronger and survive more rooms!

row.name: Twistingo Free
row.detailed_description: Embark on an extraordinary journey across three captivating games in this exclusive free edition! 1. Twistingo: Bird Paradise: Dive into a world where puzzles reign supreme. Test your skills in a variety of challenging games, from hidden objects to bingo, and exciting marble-popping adventures. Each level is a unique blend of fun and cleverness - are you ready to meet the challenge? 2. Twistingo: Turtle Bay: Join Kanoa and Malia in Turtle Bay, a paradise under threat. Team up to rescue endangered turtles, discover hidden treasures, and unravel the island's ancient legends. With a series of enthralling puzzles and delightful mini-games, you'll help the locals and breathe new life into Turtle Bay. 3. Twistingo: Hummingbird Haven: After a devastating storm, it's up to you to rescue the hummingbirds in this tropical adventure. Solve puzzles, uncover hidden objects, and rebuild the hummingbirds' homes. Collect mystical amulets, engage in entertaining mini-games, and unlock the secrets of the island. Additional Features: Free access to a couple of levels of each game. A variety of mini-games to keep you entertained. A unique opportunity to preview the full experience of three sequels. Get a taste of the adventure, puzzles, and mysteries that await you in the full versions. Download now and start your journey in [Your Game's Title] - Free Edition!
row.short_description: Explore three captivating games in one free package! Bird Paradise, Turtle Bay, and Hummingbird Haven await with an array of puzzles, adventures, and mini-games. Dive into a world filled with challenges and exciting discoveries!

row.name: BoardLand
row.detailed_description: Create your own strategy with the dice The dice is rolled! Are you going to move? Are you going to act? Different effects are applied to each die, and the numbers determine your behavior. How do you combine numbers to get the best results? Every time you pick a number, you'll have to choose carefully. Make a powerful board by strengthening the tiles. Tiles get more and more powerful! Every time you act on a tile, the tile gains experience, and the tile with enough experience is upgradeable. Combine tiles with multiple properties to create the best strategy, your own board Defeat the monsters and bosses Monsters disturb you! Monsters can summon Fireballs, or they can curse and cause obstacles to certain tiles. You have to move and act with the dice, avoiding these patterns every time.
row.short_description: BoardLand is a turn-based strategy board game where you use the numbers rolled by dice to grow your own board and battle monsters.

row.name: Frostrain
row.detailed_description: Roam the frozen world Climate change has turned the world white and frozen, and the only thing moving on the planet is you, your passengers, and your train. It's a dead world, but ironically, it's all the more fascinating for it. A vivid landscape awaits you to explore. Keep your passengers happy The passengers on your train will work diligently at your command, but be careful: if you don't manage their happiness properly, they might throw you off the train. Build your own train with card decks Each time you pass through a city, you'll be able to add new train cars by launching a heavy lift drone. Be careful with each choice you make. If you are lucky, you'll be able to build a better, more synergized, happily-ever-after train deck, but it won't always go as you planned. Reach the Promised Land Lead your passengers in search of the Promised Land, somewhere on the eastern edge of the world. But the journey to the Promised Land isn't all smooth and pleasant. You'll have to pass through toxic areas, and a severe storm is brewing behind you. Pay attention to your passengers' happiness levels and lead them safely to the Promised Land. The journey is in your hands.
row.short_description: Be the last train conductor roaming the postapocalyptic frozen world! Expand, strengthen, and build synergies on your train. The promised land beyond the toxic zone awaits you and your passengers.

row.name: Gravitia
row.detailed_description: Gravitia is a unique adventure game that utilizes gravity to escape a mysterious world. The gun creates a gravity field centered on the point of impact, which attracts the environment and objects except for gravity bullets. This allows you to move objects that are out of reach or move walls that are in your way to move forward. Try this unique interaction that defies the laws of nature for a different experience. It is unclear where this mysterious place is located and how it came to be. Explore the unknown and approach the secrets of the space as they unfold in the fog. As the fog slowly clears, you will gradually reach the secrets of the space.
row.short_description: Gravitia is an adventure game about manipulating gravity to escape a unique world full of mystery.

row.name: Maneuver
row.detailed_description: Maneuver is a fast-paced, melee-focused, first-person perspective (FPP) action game featuring captivating synthwave art styles and innovative gameplay that allows players to heist opponent's body through hacking. Embark on a Journey Take on the role of the first mercenary, known as 'Knight,' on a quest for revenge against the 'Syndicate' that sealed your freedom. Unleash chaos in this unstable cyber realm and liberate yourself from those seeking to imprison you. Hacking Mechanics Use your shuriken to hack targets. Heist bodies, transform objects, and gain an advantage that can assist you in battle. Hack in-game objects strategically to turn the tide in your favor. First-Person Combat Experience Engage in swift combat through dashing and hacking, immersing yourself in gameplay from a first-person perspective. Navigate the cyber realm with dynamic and immersive gameplay. Hit Satisfaction in Synthwave Art Style In the synthwave art style, wield your weapon and experience the sense of impact, observing enemy debris scattering across the cybernetic landscape.
row.short_description: Maneuver is a 3D FPP melee action game where you fight by switching characters you manipulate through 'Hacking'. Experience fast tempo combat with strategies through hacking.
