row.name: Underminer
row.detailed_description: Welcome. New miner! Interesting underground world! Different minerals and formations, underground caves and treasure maps. There's a lot of interesting stuff under the ground! Get stronger to explore! Get closer to the 'King of Miner' rank. The more powerful drill machines you upgrade to, the deeper underground you can explore! Legendary Minerals in the Veil! Find clues to the legendary minerals hidden in ancient air defenses. Help the people of the underworld and you'll be one step closer to the secret. Adventure awaits!
row.short_description: Welcome to Underminer, an underground adventure game set in a subterranean world. Mine minerals, earn money, upgrade your drill machine and descend deeper into the earth. The truth about 'legendary minerals' and an exciting underground world are waiting for you!

row.name: Necro Rumble
row.detailed_description: Necro Rumble! About the Game Resurrect the corpses to build your army, defeat the mortals, and survive to the end! Lead the army of the undead. In our game, the Necromancer doesn't engage in direct combat. Instead, utilize undead units to fend off enemies approaching from all directions. For the Necromancer, the corpses of enemies are potential troops. Revive these bodies at critical moments to turn the tide of battle in your favor. Special enemies will appear to challenge you. However, once defeated and turned into corpses, they too can be resurrected as part of your undead legion. Do whatever it takes to survive until the last. Choose your rewards wisely to evolve into the ultimate Necromancer! Every Necromancer has a unique approach to combat. As you create and sacrifice undead, you'll be presented with choices to strengthen your undead forces. Through these enhancements, decide which type of undead in your legion will become more powerful and how to boost their abilities. Consider the synergies between different undead types to build a formidable army and engage in battle.
row.short_description: Master the dark art of necromancy in a 2D top-down strategy game. Unleash and lead your undead legions to defeat and dominate enemy waves in this action-packed adventure.

row.name: Dwarfs Delight
row.detailed_description: Welcome to the world of Dwarfs Delight, a thrilling local multiplayer game for 2 to 4 players, where humor, strategy, and action meet in a fantasy world populated by dwarves. Key Features Dynamic Local Multiplayer Join your friends in a battle for supremacy in lively taverns. Perfect for game nights with friends or family. Rich and Varied Environments From the classic tavern to the mysterious dragon's cave, each environment offers unique challenges and strategic opportunities. Strategic Gameplay Master the art of keeping your beer mug while dodging obstacles and countering your opponents. Each game is a new drinking session! Power-ups and Surprises Use random power-ups and avoid traps to gain an edge over your rivals. Customizable Passives At the end of each round, choose unique passives to strengthen your dwarf - gain speed, increase your throwing range, or withstand an extra hit. Charming and Immersive Graphics Dive into a world of dwarves with colorful graphics and captivating character design. Guaranteed Laughter Enjoy a hilarious and unpredictable gaming experience, where each game is filled with memorable and fun moments. Whether you are a fierce competitor or a casual player, Dwarfs Delight offers a unique and captivating gaming experience. Get ready to enter the legend of the dwarves, take on challenges, and share moments of joy with your friends. Download now and let the party begin!
row.short_description: Join the adventure of Dwarfs Delight, an explosive multiplayer game where dwarves battle in a tavern for glory and beer! Face off against your friends in this couch game, where every mug counts. Get ready for laughter and unforgettable moments. Ideal for nights with friends!

row.name: Moon Rider
row.detailed_description: Immerse yourself in a road adventure, leaving problems behind and delving into the depths of the human soul. Confront the storm of emotions and overcome all psychological stages. In this journey, every question, every dialogue is a conflict between decisions and doubts, revealing the depths of your own essence. Are you ready to embark on this adventure, or will you once again escape from your problems? Features: Narrative immersion — Explore the depths of the human soul, meeting strangers and answering questions, revealing your essence in visual novels. Psychological questions — Answer questions that can help you understand and delve into the depths of your feelings. Unique atmosphere and visual style — Enjoy beautiful, melancholic landscapes accompanied by soothing music and the sound of a motorcycle. Moon Rider is not just a game. It's a meeting with yourself, a dive into your own human soul. Do you think you are ready to confront your own 'self'?
row.short_description: Moon Rider is a road adventure not only through picturesque landscapes but also within the depths of the human soul. You are a motorcyclist fleeing from your problems. Encounter strangers in visual novels and answer soul-searching questions.
row.notes: This game contains references to violence, alcohol and tobacco.

row.name: Home Path
row.detailed_description: Home Path is a rogue-like Game where you have to help the Slime to Reach her Home. You have to survive 10 floors and help the little girl to not be hungry. Get Random power-ups when you travel to the next Floor. The floors are randomly generated so every playthrough has a new layout.
row.short_description: Home Path is a Rogue-Like Action game where you play as a Slime that has to go to different platforms to save a Little Girl that she has found.

row.name: Гордость Улыпа. VR-легенды Чувашии
row.detailed_description: Embark on a magical journey in which images from ancient legends, fairy tales and the real history of the Chuvash people are mixed and complement each other. Meet the giant hero Ulyp - the hero of the epic and folk tales - and accept his gifts. Find yourself in the center of the Vortex of time, which will take you through the history of the Chuvash people. Awaken the ancient Elder of the Chuvash oak forests by playing the parappan - a Chuvash double-sided drum. Look at the rising of the three Suns - a phenomenon described in an ancient Chuvash legend. Deal with the mysteries of the three giants by solving puzzles based on national symbols and ornaments. Find ancient images and hear the legend of Khan Kubrat and the Silver Bulgars. Collect all the pages of the tome “Treasures of Chuvashia” and learn about the warrior Goldilocks, the beautiful Narspi, division commander Vasily Chapaev and other real and fictional Chuvash heroes. Ancient language and delightful examples of folk crafts, modern production and innovative technologies, vibrant national cuisine and centuries-old traditions, rich history and unique culture - the project covers the past, present and future of the Chuvash Republic.
row.short_description: A fabulous VR quest will take you to a magical forest, where folklore merges with real history. Meet face to face with the giant hero from folk tales and challenge the Elder of the Chuvash oak forests. Solve the riddles of the ornament and hear the legend about Khan Kubrat and the Silver Bulgars.

row.name: Writeway
row.detailed_description: The easiest way to engage & reflect every day. With over 80 guided journals to choose from, you will always find new aspects of life to reflect about. Relax as you write with a large selection of peaceful backgrounds and ambient sounds.
row.short_description: Happy Journaling. Elevate your mental wellness through the evidence-based practice of writing.

row.name: Beer Run
row.detailed_description: Beer Run is an Indie game created to steal beers from supermarkets. Three guys with a plan to steal more beer after running out, they go into multiple grocery stores to rob beer. Security guards are the enemy while the characters intend to rob from a store. As you progress throughout the game, each level gets harder by improving their security system. Multiple security guards in certain levels that make it tough to steal without being caught. As you collect more beers the character starts to slow down from all the weight being carried, creating another challenge besides evading the security. Features include - Limited carrying supply Slowed down speed when carrying beers. Can drop beers to gain speed. 3-star reward system Story 3 different characters
row.short_description: Beer Run is an Indie game created to steal beers from supermarkets.

row.name: Za češtiny ve hrách!
row.detailed_description: A retro-pixel arcade game, where the objective is to transport Czech ships to an island while other players or AI try their best to prevent him from doing so, utilizing obstacles such as sharks. Controlling the movements of the boats is on the keyboard using the WASD keys. The sharks are controlled automatically by the computer, but can also be controlled by the other player using the arrow keys on the keyboard. When the time limit expires, the game ends. There is one point for each ship transported to the destination. Each ship destroyed by a shark is also one point. The winner is the side that scores the most points overall. What was the inspiration for this game? From February to October 2023, Pařanský ráj, under the leadership of our mascot Marushka, worked tirelessly on translating various games using AI. We translated a total of 45 games. This game was created as gratitude for your support during that period.
row.short_description: “A retro-pixel arcade game, where the objective is to transport Czech ships to an island while other players or AI try their best to prevent him from doing so, utilizing obstacles such as sharks.

row.name: The Lancaster Leak - Entity Exam
row.detailed_description: Episode 3 - Entity Exam The whistle-blowers have kept their promise and have leaked another tape. It seems to be some sort of training protocol used by the E.R.D. to train their agents on not only entities but field skills to improve their chances of survival. WARNING: This game is not suitable for children or those easily disturbed Multiple Modules There are 6 sections to prepare you for the final exam. Learn and practice the skills that cover this text, image, and audio-based game. Features 30-40 minutes long Linear Story Minor Jumpscares Playing the other games is recommended but not required.
row.short_description: YOU CONTROL THE FOUND FOOTAGE. Another tape has been leaked, this time a recording of a training protocol. By answering questions and resisting jumpscares, can you beat the Entity Exam?
row.notes: Disturbing images & audio and jumpscares.

row.name: Phantom Ascension
row.detailed_description: Unleash Chaos in a Dystopian World: Embark on a heart-pounding journey through a dystopian landscape ravaged by cataclysmic events. As humanity teeters on the edge of extinction, dive into the chaos that is the Blacklight Gang territory. Your Mission: In 'Phantom Ascension,' take on the role of a silent mercenary on a perilous quest to retrieve the stolen Quantum Orb. Navigate the disintegrating reality of the Blacklight Gang's domain, facing off against the tyrannical Bryce and his ruthless thugs. Advanced Prototype Suit: Equip yourself with an advanced prototype suit, a technological marvel that sets you apart in the midst of the apocalypse. Face overwhelming odds armed with a deadly melee weapon and cutting-edge capabilities. Intense First-Person Hack and Slash: Engage in relentless first-person hack and slash combat, where precision and strategy are your allies. Experience a unique blend of fast-paced action and strategic maneuvering as you confront the calamity head-on. Specialized Techniques: Master specialized techniques to outclass your adversaries. Use your high-tech suit to its full potential, executing nimble moves and devastating attacks that will leave enemies in awe. Save Humanity, Confront the Chaos: In 'Phantom Ascension,' you are always outnumbered but never outclassed. Confront the chaos head-on, employing your skills and advanced equipment to save what remains of humanity. Key Features: Intense first-person hack and slash gameplay Navigate a disintegrating dystopian world Advanced prototype suit with unique capabilities Face off against the tyrannical Blacklight Gang Master specialized techniques for strategic advantage Dive into the chaos and emerge as the silent savior humanity desperately needs in 'Phantom Ascension.'
row.short_description: Dive into the intense 'Phantom Ascension,' a single-player action game set in a dystopian 20XX. With unchecked corporate power, crumbling governments, and rampant lawlessness, the Blacklight Gang, a coalition of criminals and mercenaries, seizes control, plunging the world into chaos.
row.notes: Certainly! When addressing mature content in your game on Steam, you can provide information to customers by being clear and transparent. Here's a sample response for the "What should customers know about any mature content in your game?" section: Mature Content Disclaimer: "Phantom Ascension" features intense action sequences involving combat and killing. However, it's important to note that the game does not depict explicit gore or graphic violence. In our effort to provide an engaging experience without excessive visual elements, the depiction of combat results in a red screen effect, and defeated enemies disintegrate without graphic details. Key Points: Combat and Killing: Engage in intense first-person hack and slash combat throughout the game. Visual Representation: The game employs a red screen effect during combat, ensuring that explicit blood or gore is not depicted. Enemy Disintegration: Defeated enemies disintegrate without graphic details. We strive to maintain an immersive experience while being mindful of explicit content. "Phantom Ascension" is designed to provide an exciting and challenging gameplay experience without the inclusion of graphic violence. Please be advised that the game is intended for a mature audience, and player discretion is advised.

row.name: Legendary Hoplite: Arachne’s Trial
row.detailed_description: WISHLIST THE FULL GAME WISHLIST OTHER GAMES About the Game Try out the free prologue to get a taste of the exciting gameplay and easily transfer your progress to the full game. Transfer your progress to the main game The main game offers three acts, 38 areas, mini-games, and a lot of gear options for your hero. Progress seamlessly transfers from the prologue to the main game. Face 10 Levels and 2 Boss Battles Face the challenge of 10 distinct levels, each filled with hordes of mythic monsters. Try 6 different armies and test your skills against Arachne at the end of the prologue. Customize Your Build and Power Up Your Army Customize your build by trying out various gear combinations you come across. Find the perfect match for your playstyle as you explore. Strengthen your army by upgrading them and merging with the Hero to amplify your power, ready to face and conquer the enemy. War technique Elevate your armies with War Technique—a fresh way to upgrade. Experiment with various combos and effortlessly switch up your enhancements for effective improvements.
row.short_description: Legendary Hoplite: Arachne’s Trial is a combination of Tower Defense and Action RPG. Upgrade your army, get the best gear, and craft unique strategies across 10 levels. Face Arachne, and seamlessly transfer progress to the main game.

row.name: NOVA CORE CHAOS
row.detailed_description: NOVA CORE CHAOS is a chaotic co-op cooking game for one to five players. You and your fellow robot friends need to work as a team to prep and fill energy cores with their designated elements to help customers evolve into the Novas they want to be! But be fast, these customers don't like waiting too long! CUSTOMERS NEED CORES, YOU NEED TO CRAFT! Robots will come flooding in, asking for a energy core, so they too can have awesome powers just like you. It's your job to grab the empty energy cores, refine their shape and fill them with the correct energy sources. If you give a customer the wrong Nova-core, they'll end up angry! Make too many customers angry and you'll lose the game! So stay focused while making your energy cores. There's a total of 20 different combinations for you to make! 5 UNIQUE NOVAS, 5 UNIQUE PLAYSTYLES Every playable Nova has their own unique ability to help make the energy cores. Use these to speed up the workflow! Each Nova can only be picked once, but every Nova can help out with every task! UP TO 5 PLAYERS Work alone or together with up to 5 friends to help the customers evolve into a Nova! Just invite a friend from you friends list and start making energy cores!
row.short_description: NOVA CORE CHAOS is a chaotic co-op cooking game for one to five players. Play as one of five unique classes and follow the recipes to make energy cores. Give these to your customers to help them evolve into Novas!

row.name: Planet Mort
row.detailed_description: As soon as you wake up, life does not wait and you start to struggle. Choose to eat whatever you can find and stick with what you learn. Controls: - WASD/L-Stick: Move - Mouse/R-Stick: Move Camera - E/B: Interact - Shift/X: Crouch - Space/A: Jump ++ Crouch + Jump: Long Jump - LMB/RT(/RB): Attack ++ Jump + Attack: S-Jump ++ Move Back + Attack: S-Attack - RMB/LT(/LB): Aim Mode ++ Aim Mode + Attack: Shoot - MMB/R-Stick-In: Target Lock - Q/Select: Check Watch - Esc/Start: Pause Stranded on Planet Mort you go through one single day trying to stay alive. Every passing hour of that day breeds a new scenario with another problem to be solved. Your sole goal is to avoid starvation, your status is indicated in the top right of the HUD. To progress through the day, use mechanics such as running, jumping, diving, melee fighting, driving and shooting. There are multiple minigames and secret areas waiting to be found. The game supports manual saving and lets you create up to three save slots.
row.short_description: Adapt and live
row.notes: Contains cartoon nudity and blood

row.name: PvPillman
row.detailed_description: A short-run time game for preferably 5 players (I did not set a max number of players). Everyone will hunt the host player while the host tries to collect every pellet on the screen. The host is also going to play a top-down version of the game while everyone else is playing from a third person viewpoint. The host gains health from eating the other players, but also losses health when getting eaten by players. Doesn't seem to work for everyone, I had to mess around with UPNP settings on my router to let the game run normally.
row.short_description: A topdown and 3rd person game for ideally 5 players.

row.name: Steam Spire Chronicles
row.detailed_description: Steam Spire Chronicles is a combo-focused action roguelike set in a fantasy steampunk universe. Hack, dash, and wreak havoc as you fight your way through the Steam Spire’s ever-changing floors. Gather strength from a wide selection of items, and journey through a variety of distinct environments - make your way to the top of the tower and stick a wrench in the villain’s grand plan!
row.short_description: Steam Spire Chronicles is a combo-focused action roguelike set in a fantasy steampunk universe. Fight your way through an ever-changing labyrinth against creatures and automatons alike, picking up unique items that can change how you play!

row.name: Kalpa of Sword
row.detailed_description: 免费开玩 About the Game “这位兄弟请留步，我看你印堂饱满，紫气逼人，绝非凡胎，要不随我一同修仙....” 灵州大陆天道崩坏，灵力散落天地，奇魔异兽丛生，修士只有磨砺出至强实力方可自保。 因而法理尽失，弱肉强食；在野外探险，杀人夺宝，宗门劫掠比比皆是。修仙者肆性而为，或独身或合作或背刺，仙途全由自己选择，如此乱世，后人史称“剑气劫” 游戏内没有繁琐的任务和日常，地图全开放式采集、刷宝；资源的高频刷新，助力道友境界快速提升。道友们还能使用各色坐骑，御空飞行，游历广袤大陆。 奇魔异兽将君临各个不同属性的界域，静候各位道友的挑战。成功将其击杀还会爆出各色稀有武器和装备，更有附着强大技能的专属神器期待有缘人的降临。变强吧，命定之人！ 注意！野外将对全部道友开放敌对击杀功能，一旦死亡，道友等级积分全部清零；部分地图还附带死亡掉落功能，若身怀重宝请注意及时返回安全区储存或回收，以免被人中途劫道，杀人夺宝。 厌倦了尔虞我诈，道友还可以选择加入宗门，组队结伴修行。有了亲朋助力，无论是协力破魔，还是制霸界域，一切想象皆可成真。不同职业的配合，还能让战斗变得更加丰富刺激。 地图隐藏的随机事件等待各位道友的探寻。或偶遇先辈机缘，获得令人羡慕的神兵利器；又或雷劫渡体，一朝成就金仙最强之身，游戏里的惊喜无处不在。
row.short_description: 《剑气劫》是一款新国风题材的PVPVE游戏，生存斗法是游戏的唯一目标！ 游戏开放全地图探索掉落，装备全靠自己刷。但仙途险恶，无论是奇魔异兽还是路过的修士，皆可成为狩猎的目标。成王败寇，修仙乱世当以实力为尊，望各位道友好自珍重！

row.name: Sleeping With Sakuya Izayoi
row.detailed_description: Story In this small visual novel, your partner Sakuya Izayoi is tired after a long day of working at the Scarlet Devil Mansion, she invites you to relax with her in her private quarters! Talk to her, kiss her or just simply enjoy each other's presence. Features Chose up to 3 locations, the mansion quarters, the forest of magic or even an apartment room! Ambient music Gorgeous artwork with various expressions! Kiss Sakuya! Talk to Sakuya! Relax with Sakuya! Sakuya!
row.short_description: In this small visual novel, lay down and relax with Sakuya Izayoi. Talk to her, kiss her or just simply enjoy each other's presence! Chose between 3 different locations featuring stunning artwork in this Touhou Project Fangame.

row.name: of the Devil
row.detailed_description: AN EPISODIC CYBERPUNK MURDER MYSTERY GAME Download 'of the Devil' for Free to play the entirety of the fully-fleshed out prologue chapter: When Morgan finds herself assigned as Public Defender for the man the police say has shot six people through the heart, she'll need to leverage all her wits and the full force of her 'unique insight' into the case to come out unscathed and on-top. Purchase additional Episodes at your leisure to pursue other self-contained mysteries. Follow along as Morgan battles mega-corporations, cyberpunk gangs, VR cultists, aristocratic secret-society conspiracies, and government weapons projects, both inside and outside the courtroom. Fight for the truth-  and the freedom to do whatever the Hell you want. THE YEAR IS 2086. There's a camera in every device and a half dozen devices on every citizen. There are tracking implants in every cybernetic and location tags on every bullet. No stone goes unturned- and every stone is accounted for. Violent crimes are cleared in 97% of cases. The few cases that make it to trial result in a guilty verdict 98% of the time. People are safer now than at any other time in history, and getting away with murder is nearly impossible. So if you find yourself wrongly accused... Better hope you've got a Killer Lawyer. KILLER PROTAGONIST, ESQUIRE Examine 3D crime scenes, question multifaceted characters, and take advantage of Morgan's own unique killer insight to pursue the truth for your clients in this episodic series of murder mystery stories. HIGH-STAKES DEDUCTIONS Build up your CREDIT by investigating thoroughly and asking the right questions- Then read your opponents' hands, call their bluffs, avoid their haymakers and slam down the right evidence to upend their logic. RICH WORLD, PERSONALITIES, AND STORIES Explore an atmospheric and vibrant world where cyberpunk rebels clash against the surveillance state, from both inside the justice system and far beyond the reach of the law.
row.short_description: Immerse yourself in neon, smoke, and high-stakes legal gambles as a Defense Attorney with uniquely Killer insights in this episodic, diabolically stylish visual novel adventure game.
row.reviews: “Compelling and gripping...you should not miss if you are a fan of mystery thrillers.” 9/10 – NoisyPixel “Demonstrate(s) a love and understanding of its...inspirations in a fleshed out, well considered, and distinct style all its own.” 5/5 – Gamesline
row.notes: This game contains mature themes, descriptions and stylized depictions of violence, murder and implied psychological torture. Player discretion is advised.

row.name: Mahjong Soul
row.detailed_description: Mahjong Soul is an online game that adopted the classic Japanese Mahjong gameplay. Here, you can hone your mahjong skills with players from worldwide or spend leisure time with friends, bond with various charismatic characters, and experience an abundance of unique stories. Classic Japanese Mahjong Mahjong Soul preserves the features of classic Japanese Mahjong (also known as Riichi Mahjong). You can play against opponents at similar skill levels to hone your skills. Easy tutorial for beginners Beginners are welcomed with easy-to-understand tutorials, which cover not just the basics but also teach you how to handle various game scenarios. With step-by-step guides, even beginners can become proficient in no time. Enjoy yourself with pals, or engage in global matches You can not only create private rooms to play with friends in Friend Room, but also battle players from around the world. Test each other's skills, and enjoy a variety of special and amusing mahjong modes. Meet an abundance of charismatic characters Interact with a range of charming characters that bring unique stories to life, enhancing your gaming experience as you form bonds and explore the world of Mahjong Soul with them. Fancy-up matches with decorations Immerse yourself in dynamic effects that make every mahjong match a thrilling game. From a tiny tile to an entire tablecloth, every detail can be customized to suit your taste. Expressive character emotes Make use of the emotes to liven up your matches. Engage in mischief and mayhem with hilarious character emotes!
row.short_description: Mahjong Soul is an online game that adopted the classic Japanese Mahjong gameplay. Here, you can hone your mahjong skills with players from worldwide or spend leisure time with friends, bond with various charismatic characters, and experience an abundance of unique stories.

row.name: Oil Strike '75
row.detailed_description: Oil Strike '75 X WDC, Whale and Dolphin Conservation Oil Strike ’75 now supports optional charity donations via DLC sales.  Please note that Oil Strike '75's DLC packs do not contain any content or unlocks, in-game or otherwise. These are charity donation payments, and 95% of net publisher and developer revenue Secret Mode receives from these purchases will be donated to WDC, Whale and Dolphin Conservation. About the Game Experience the official prequel to Still Wakes the Deep , originally released in secret ahead of the BAFTA-winning horror masterpiece.  WHAT WILL YOU DISCOVER BELOW? Get ready to earn while you learn in Oil Strike ’75, a fun, exciting, and educational new game from Cadal Corp. where you’re tasked with running a rig and discovering new oil deposits at the bottom of the sea – no matter the cost. Who knows what you’ll find! Utilise super-safe seismic exploration to discover oil wells deep beneath the ground. Hop in and pilot a helicopter to bring vital supplies from shore. Run, jump, and climb your way to the top of the rig as you build your drill longer and longer – just be sure to avoid the totally normal health hazards! Then use the money you’ve earned from completing jobs to drill as deep as you can and discover brand new oil deposits that will help keep your rig afloat and most importantly make your shareholders super happy. Oh and don’t worry, there’s no such thing as too deep when you drill with Cadal! Learn the business of drilling for oil as you complete three fun yet increasingly tricky tasks to earn money to make your drill longer The more you complete, the longer your drill becomes, and the deeper you can go! Earn exclusive Steam achievements! Keep playing and who knows what you’ll discover! Please note: If you should discover any bugs, please call our bug hotline on: 0325 75

Run an oil rig and discover new oil deposits at the bottom of the sea – no matter the cost. Who knows what you’ll find in the official prequel to Still Wakes the Deep?

row.name: Data Rush : La course aux données
row.detailed_description: Game only available in french Data Rush : La course aux données is a unique educational video game set in the world of digital data. Take control of a customizable avatar and race through crazy 2D levels with a singular art direction. Learn more about the world of DATA through memorable encounters with colorful characters, dynamic mini-games and offbeat puzzles. In Data Rush: La course aux données , you'll experience an adventure mixing mystery and humor in the heart of digital spaces, in the company of your sidekick Clic. Set off in search of your lost data and foil the plans of the Machiavellian Dr. Frankenclic! The game alternates between exploration phases in 2D levels designed and animated entirely by hand, interactions with NPCs, as well as enigmatic phases, games to test your knowledge and puzzles. But there's more to come...
row.short_description: Data Rush: The Data Race is an educational 2D adventure video game about the world of DATA. Take control of a customizable avatar and traverse crazy levels packed with original characters and mini-games, to become the master of digital data !

row.name: Forest Of Perdition
row.detailed_description: Jonny Everhart, a man with a troubled past, takes a job as a night security guard at an isolated forest park. The site, once a haven for visitors, hides dark secrets left by its blood-stained history. However, as Jonny begins his rounds, he realizes something is wrong. Strange sounds echo through the trees, shadows move where they shouldn't, and an invisible presence seems to watch you at every step. Between unfinished reports from former employees and distorted radio recordings, Jonny discovers that the forest isn't just haunted... it wants something from him. Now, trapped in a nightmare where reality falls apart, Jonny must fight to survive while trying to unravel the park's mysteries. But the real question is: does he really want to know the truth?
row.short_description: 'Forest of Perdition' is a horror and mystery game that plunges players into a tranquil park, progressively transformed by supernatural events. Each step forward is a step closer to the terrifying truth that awaits at the heart of this haunted forest.

row.name: La Bestia: The Migrant's Long Journey
row.detailed_description: La Bestia: The Migrant's Long Journey is a virtual reality game that provides an immersive experience of the challenges faced by migrants on their journey from South America to the United States of America. The game is set on a train called La Bestia, where you take on the role of a migrant. You will encounter many other migrants on the train, each with their own unique story to share. These stories are based on real events and offer insights into the difficulties and experiences of migrants. You need to move around the environment and get closer to each migrant to hear their story. The game consists of two scenes. The first scene places you in a train car with other immigrants. It is a contemplative experience where you can interact with the migrants, who are represented as statues, by simply moving around. The second scene takes place inside a train car, and the mechanics are the same as in the first scene. The game automatically switches between the two scenes. It is a moving experience that offers a glimpse into the harsh reality of the migrant journey. In this version, all the migrant dialogues are in Spanish.
row.short_description: Imagine having to leave your home and everything you know behind. Live the experience of a migrant immersed in a lonely journey while listening to the stories of your companions.

row.name: Project Tape
row.detailed_description: The Last Tape A Hidden Truth For over 50 years, Lurmont has kept dark and disturbing events hidden from the public eye. But everything changes when, during an exploration, tapes are discovered revealing the atrocities committed by the company. Only You After months of investigating Lurmont’s clandestine activities, you decide to venture alone into an abandoned estate that once belonged to the company. Unaware of what awaits you, you step into a place where the truth has been buried for years. Horror Without Horror? The Last Tape aims to immerse you in a constant psychological horror atmosphere, creating a sense of unease and suspense at all times. However, the game does not rely on cheap jump scares or extreme tension... or does it? The Story Doesn't End with the Prologue The narrative of The Last Tape will continue to evolve through chapters released periodically from the same launcher. Each new episode will offer unique experiences in found footage format, although the prologue will take a different approach. All the stories are connected, but it’s up to you to discover how. A Game Created by Two Passionate Developers This project was developed by two students passionate about the horror genre, aiming to deliver an innovative psychological horror experience. We use the powerful Unreal Engine 5 to bring this eerie adventure to life, keeping the price accessible to everyone. Plus, the prologue will be available completely free. Proyect Tape The story will begin with the Prologue of the same, every X time new chapters will be released
row.short_description: Experience the arrival of The Last Tape's protagonist in this short horror adventure that reveals what happened before the main events. Explore Lurmont’s abandoned facilities, avoid the mysterious creature, and descend step by step into a hell you might not escape from

row.name: Cat Got Your Tongue
row.detailed_description: Cat Got Your Tongue is a quirky little platformer inspired by the classic phrase “Cat got your tongue?” — a saying used when someone’s too shy or hesitant to speak. But in this game, you’re not the nervous human — you’re the mischief-making cat! You play as a naughty little black cat jumping and scrambling across a human’s tongue, determined to snatch his tiny voice and stop him from expressing his inner thoughts. Go get your claws and join our evil kitty crew! 🎮 Controls: Hold Arrow Keys or A & D to control jump direction Press Spacebar to attack enemies ✨ Features: Fun & Whimsical Interactions A vertical jumping game packed with surprises: dodging oral bacteria, avoiding tartar-blasting toothpaste, riding guinea pigs, slipping on buttered toast, or catching sight of mysterious waving kitties — all await your discovery. Cute and Grotesque Art Style A mix of adorable and weird visuals, with hand-drawn comic scenes between stages and alternate endings depending on your success or failure. Short and Snackable Gameplay Each round lasts just a few minutes — perfect for quick, casual play sessions. Endless Mode for Hardcore Cats An Endless level awaits players who crave a real challenge! 🐾 The game can be tricky — don’t lose your temper (or your keyboard)! ⚠️ Note: The game launches in fullscreen by default, which might affect resolution. Please adjust screen settings manually in “Setting.” Credits: Shanshan – Design, Art Finn – Design, Blueprint, Music
row.short_description: Cat Got Your Tongue is a vertical platformer where you play a mischievous black cat, jumping and attacking across a tongue to stop the protagonist from speaking, with quirky art, playful interactions, and fast-paced, challenging yet casual gameplay.

row.name: Sunflower Pie
row.detailed_description: The worst thing about Oliver’s breakfast is that it wants to be eaten. Inspired by early RPGmaker horror games and Adult Swim bumpers, Sunflower Pie is a bite-sized visual novel with extra parasites (for flavor). Much like real life, it oscillates violently between discomfort and sincerity. Unlike real life, however, there is only one correct choice. Features: *You can beat this visual novel in 25 minutes *Oliver’s speech therapist is good at her job and owns a revolver *Learn about all the cool ways to remove ticks from your body *Made with love (sincerely)
row.short_description: A short story about a parasitic sunflower and her loyal son. Eat everything you can. Enjoy the sunshine. Do whatever it takes to make her happy. This is a prequel to Siren's Call: Escape Velocity.
row.notes: emotional and physical parental abuse, surreal violence, general horror and frightening situations

row.name: MUZY
row.detailed_description: This game was developed in collaboration with a Rybis Games, who has been unreachable for several months. Out of respect of our players, and Rybis Games, we’ve decided to make MUZY free to play. The events of MUZY take place in an abandoned industrial complex. Let me introduce 'NeuroWorld,' a trailblazing business that has effectively integrated artificial intelligence into toys for kids. For many children, these toys were first true friends, but when mishaps started to ruin their once joyful relationships, the beautiful story took a terrible turn. 'NeuroWorld' became a trailblazing company, becoming the first to successfully integrate artificial intelligence into a kid's toy. These creative toys were more than just playthings; they became true friends for a lot of kids. After experiencing great success, the business set up production facilities, which led to the development of the massive industrial complex known as 'Maybedi.' Many industries produce cutting-edge products within the complex, which is also home to NeuroWorld offices, a special daycare for the children of staff, and a large play area. Children actively participate in this situation by contributing comments on the company's continuing advances, going above and beyond simply providing amusement. The Maybedi complex is located in a quiet area a few miles from the closest populated area, strategically placed miles away from busy urban hubs. You're a private investigator, and one day you get an assignment to inspect the abandoned Maybedi Industrial Complex. You accept the offer after giving it some thought. You begin the game by entering the play area, where employees can leave their children to enjoy themselves. But why had the complex been closed? What lurks behind those rooms' doors? Why did a seemingly successful company decide to abandon this location? These are the questions you must answer. MUZY is a well-known character from the 'NeuroWorld' toy line. This amazing invention combines a robotic foundation wrapped in a soft knit cloth with an advanced artificial intelligence system. MUZY, one of the company's most notable projects, was incredibly successful and won over kids' hearts with its endearing appearance and amazing ability to move and interact on its own. A source of great success for the business, MUZY was essential in helping kids make friends, which was especially helpful for those who were shy. Because of its interactive features, which made it possible for meaningful connection in addition to providing entertainment, many people saw it as their best friend. At one point in time, word spread throughout the entire crew regarding the complex's imminent closure, a development that shocked and confused them all. There are still a lot of objects and traces of the once-bustling factory inside its walls. The complex was first gated off and guarded, which gave its abandoned grounds a sense of mystery. But eventually, for no apparent reason, the guards left their positions. Then, neighbors walking by the condominium started telling stories of a mix of eerie noises coming from its empty lot. There were also reports of strange animals seen nearby. In an attempt to solve the mystery surrounding the abandoned facility, it was decided to hire a private investigator in light of these odd circumstances. The detective enters the abandoned Maybedi Industrial Complex brandishing a toy gun. The detective uses the toy gun with small balls loaded to maneuver through the abandoned building and solve puzzles by firing precisely. The detective's path through the complex is distinguished by a calculated combination of puzzle-solving and exploration. The puzzles become more difficult as the detective goes along, necessitating strategic thinking to discover the truth behind the complex's closure. The toy gun is used by the detective in the third person as a dependable ally, a lighthearted but crucial component in the investigation into Maybedi's secrets. The investigator gets closer to comprehending the reasons for the complex's abandonment and the shadows that lurk in its forgotten corners with every picture. 1. Compelling Detective Story: Assume the role of a seasoned detective tasked with solving a series of mysterious and unsettling incidents connected to MUZY, some with fatal consequences. 2. Eerie Atmosphere: Explore a hauntingly atmospheric world filled with suspense, tension, and supernatural occurrences that will keep you on the edge of your seat. 3. Cryptic Puzzles: Challenge your wits with a variety of cryptic puzzles and riddles, each leading you closer to unraveling the true cause behind the terrifying events tied to MUZY. 4. Immersive Gameplay: Engage in an immersive gameplay experience with intuitive controls, realistic environments, and a gripping narrative that unfolds as you progress through the game. 5. Dark Secrets: Uncover the dark and hidden secrets surrounding MUZY, delving deep into its past and discovering the malevolent force that now lurks within this once-innocent children's toy. 6. Stunning Visuals: Enjoy high-quality graphics and visual effects that bring the nightmarish world of MUZY to life, intensifying the horror elements and enhancing the overall gaming experience. 7. Fear-Inducing Soundtrack: Immerse yourself further into the terror with a haunting soundtrack that enhances the atmosphere, keeping you on edge and heightening the suspense.
row.short_description: Explore the mystery behind a once-loved and hugely popular children's toy, also known as MUZY, in this terrifying horror adventure game. Several reports detail frightening incidents connected to accidents. Your job is to solve the puzzles and find the cause of these unsettling occurrences.

row.name: Saturn
row.detailed_description: 'Saturn' is a tactical RPG set on Earth and the moons of Saturn. A mysterious signal from space causes the AI of machines to rebel against their creators across the entire Solar System. Defend Earth from the threat and connect with the robots on Saturn's moons to stop the apocalypse. You only have 3 days to save the world. Explore the World of the Future The year is 2062, a new era in space exploration. ARKA from Russia, Huang-Di from China, and BUF from Britain have established research stations throughout the Solar System. The discovery of a new form of communication—ether threads—has enabled more efficient space exploration using robots and drones. From Earth, operators of the 'Reflection' program remotely control machines in real time. Thanks to their work, research stations have been built on the major moons of Saturn, where international expeditions have been working for the past twenty years. Stop the End of the World Scanners indicate that a malicious signal is traveling through the ether threads from somewhere in Saturn’s orbit. Only through the 'Reflection' program on Earth can the source of the threat be discovered, the mystery of the disaster that has struck humanity unraveled, and the world saved. Time is running out. There is no escape from the crazed robots, neither on Earth nor in space. A civilization dependent on robots and new technologies faces disaster with significant human casualties unless the catastrophe is averted. On Earth and Saturn You are Akim Kovalev, a scientist and one of the top operators of the 'Reflection' program. Your life's work was deemed obsolete and shut down two years ago. Stop the catastrophe and prove that both 'Reflection' and you still have a place in this world. Save your colleagues and friends on Earth while gathering information about what's happening. Connect to and control robots on Saturn’s moons through 'Reflection' to uncover the mysterious signal that is driving the machines insane. Experiment and Think Tactically Time in combat flows only for you. Use it to carefully plan your tactics and strategy. You have a wide array of weapons at your disposal, ranging from melee to powerful laser and electromagnetic cannons. Fight on Earth yourself and through robots on Saturn. Death is not the end. Failures along the way will return you to the start of the cycle. Use this to try different weapons and combat approaches. As many times as it takes... Make Important Decisions Solve emerging problems in different ways. The lives on Earth and the fate of the entire world depend on your choices. Negotiate or take an aggressive approach—the outcome of the game is shaped by your actions. Restart the cycle, make different decisions, and experience different outcomes. Experiment and find your own way to stop the catastrophe!
row.short_description: Saturn is a tactical RPG set on the moons of Saturn and on Earth. The protagonist controls robots on the moons of Saturn and explores an underground city where one can find keys to the secrets of deep space.

row.name: LISA: The First
row.detailed_description: Explore Lisa Armstrong’s mind as she tries to cope with the burden caused by her father Marty. Traverse a slipping reality as you attempt to leave home and recover your memories. Only, escape is not so easy. Features and Gameplay - LISA the First is a short and surreal exploration game reminiscent of retro-RPGs. - Navigate the twisting world of Lisa’s mind, finding hidden doors and pathways to strange and exotic places. - Explore these spaces to uncover Lisa’s memories and unveil the sinister forces laying in wait. - Interact with a cast of dark and strange characters who persist across multiple memories. - Collect faded thoughts as VHS tapes, and seek a way to replay them in order to gain insight into the sights and sounds you encounter.
row.short_description: A memory of madness.

row.name: My Friend The Spider
row.detailed_description: A small 'horror' narrative game about isolation and depression. My Friend The Spider is a 10-15 minute walking simulator where the player finds themselves voluntarily locked in a room to escape and isolate due to their current emotional state and befriending a spider that grows in size with the story's progression. I originally worked on the game for a month and a half around October 2022. My idea was to experiment with the Unity engine in order to practice my coding and get used to the engine. I had a short story in mind based on personal experiences and thought it would be a good idea to flesh it out as a narrative 'game' instead. Everything bar the art assets was done by me. My wife helped with the voice acting (and emotional support). After releasing it, it got quite a few number of views and plays - seeing people's comments about how they were moved by it, I realized a Steam release was in order. I took my time, but after sitting down and fixing some nasty bugs and others (white text on a white background? Really dude?) I am now happy to release it on Steam and let it be free with a nice, deserved final update. I hope you enjoy it. Take care.
row.short_description: A small 'horror' narrative game about isolation and depression.

row.name: Njuma
row.detailed_description: What is Njuma? Njuma is a narrative driven pixel art game with an offbeat interpretation of the Game Jam’s theme: Take a Deep Breath. Draw your last breath and become the family's Spirit-Guide and Guardian of the Ancestral Tree . Help your descendents in their final moments by bringing them comfort and serenity as they transition to the afterlife. The Ancestral Tree withers, generational trauma lurking in its shadow. You must piece together a tragedy and soothe a soul-scar which refuses to heal. The Fate of the family is in your hands. What you can expect A short walking simulator game, where you interact and get help from items and NPC's in the environment to interpret the story. The NPC's interact with you as you walk close to objects, giving you clues of what they are seeking. Pick up items, and place them to make a choice. Your choice matters! About development This game was developed as a submission for the Lv. 99 Game Jam in 2023. It was developed in the span of 10 days, and worked on further for 3 days for an update including bugfixes and a dialogue system unlocked by completing the game.
row.short_description: Njuma is a 2D narrative driven pixel game with multiple endings. Be the difference your family needs as they draw their final breath.

row.name: 英雄与霸主 Heroes and Overlord TD:Prologue
row.detailed_description: MyDiscord: This is a magical tower defense game where you choose a faction from the Human Alliance, Orcs, Demons, and Undead, assemble your heroes and legions, and march to the battlefield to conquer the continent. In this prologue version, you will have access to 6 basic units and corresponding talent trees for both the Human Alliance and the Undead, along with 3-4 basic buildings for each faction, 3-4 magical skills, and the ability to attack other players' strongholds. Each race can retain 2 strongholds.
row.short_description: This is a fantasy tower defence game , you select a faction from the Alliance, Orcs and Undead（The Orcs and Demons is in full version，not in this Prologue version), assemble your heroes and armies to conquer the land.

row.name: The Zhukov Line
row.detailed_description: The Zhukov Line is a short one-room-horror which takes place on a livestock train in a dystopian Soviet state. First day on the job... Accepting a new job as a transport supervisor for the Chernovar Oversight Division you have been tasked with transporting a special livestock specimen. As you awake on a cold iron train, you hear ungodly screams from the coaches behind you. Scrambling to your computer, you read your mission statement and learn that the only way to survive is by keeping the specimen restrained, by maintaining industrial grade systems built into the train Keep the train running... Can you keep the systems repaired long enough to reach your destination and escape the aberrant monstrosity tearing its way through the train carriages to meet you?
row.short_description: A short one-room-horror which takes place on a livestock train in a dystopian Soviet state

row.name: Run and Gun 2: Opossum City Playtest
Gamebox
row.detailed_description: Gamebox is a free and open source sandbox game centered on user generated content. You decide what you want to play, be it in 3D or 2D, single-player or multiplayer, or create and upload your own games. Features and content: * Included are two very basic games in 3D and 2D featuring basic physics to demonstrate how Gamebox can load games * Single-player and multiplayer games created by the community available in the Steam Workshop * Create and upload your own games to the Workshop (read the Help section in-game for instructions) * Both 3D and 2D are supported * Games may be moddable by using the Workshop * Some mods on the Workshop may be cross-compatible with multiple Gamebox games * Made with Godot Engine
row.short_description: Gamebox is a free and open source sandbox game centered on user generated content. You decide what you want to play, be it in 3D or 2D, single-player or multiplayer, or create and upload your own games.

row.name: Road Toad
row.detailed_description: Road Toad invites players into a world where whimsy meets challenge, delivering a unique twist on the classic arcade experience. As the goofy amphibian protagonist, navigate through captivating minimalist landscapes, encountering a variety of obstacles and dynamic challenges. Charming Minimalism: Road Toad boasts a visually appealing, minimalist art style that adds a touch of charm to the gameplay. Quirky Soundtrack: Immerse yourself in the world of Road Toad with a playful and goofy musical backdrop that complements the game's silly atmosphere. Dynamic Gameplay: Encounter a variety of obstacles and challenges as you guide your toad through themed levels, each offering a unique and engaging experience. Power-Up Bonanza: Experiment with an array of power-ups, and stay on your toes as we continue to introduce new strategic elements based on player feedback. Community-Driven Development: Join us in shaping the future of Road Toad! Engage with the community, share your thoughts, and witness the game evolve through regular updates and additions.
row.short_description: Embark on a whimsical journey with Road Toad, a charming arcade adventure featuring a goofy toad navigating minimalist landscapes, collecting power-ups, and facing quirky challenges.

row.name: Crystal Guardians Prologue
row.detailed_description: The prologue will be a small slice of the full game Crystal guardians is a rogue-like tower defense game where you need to defend your base crystal on an expanding procedural generated battlefield. Gain a strategic advantage using the many towers + crystal combinations and unique item combinations stored in those towers. Make use of the expanding battlefield by placing towers on strategic position for maximal damage to the enemies. Key features of the prologue Enjoy the first 40 waves in the prologue version Procedural generated levels, every run is different Upgrade towers using items Currently over 50 items available 25 tower combinations Extensive meta progression Loads of different enemies Procedural expansion Keep expanding the battlefield while fighting off relentless waves of enemies. Use the newly gained grounds to gain an advantage on the enemies or find the lands secrets. A roguelike system Buy and use items on your towers to create the optimal strategy for you. With currently over 50 items to choose from. Unique Bosses Adapt your strategy to the unique boss waves
row.short_description: Crystal Guardians prologue (small slice of the full game) is a tower defense game with rogue-like elements. Fight off waves and defend the base crystal. Gear up your towers with a powerful combination of items for your personal strategy. In a procedural map, find hidden powers and conquer the enemy.

row.name: Detective Kiwi
row.detailed_description: ABOUT 'Detective Kiwi' is a free to play multiplayer puzzle game that designed up to 6 players, featuring a simple rule: There will be 4 images every round. You need to find them as fast as you can. PURPOSE Simple and entertaining gameplay allows you to improve your finding skills and memory. Every round, you need to find 4 images in a bunch of others and press ring button as fast as you can. The player who find more images fastly, will get more score. CUSTOMIZABLES You can customize your avatar, avatar frames, emotes and icons.
row.short_description: 'Detective Kiwi' is a free to play multiplayer puzzle game that designed up to 6 players, featuring a simple rule: There will be 4 images every round. You need to find them as fast as you can.

row.name: Elf Kicker
row.detailed_description: It's the day after Christmas, following another successful night of delivering presents, Santa must endure one more challenge, The Elf Kicking contest. This relaxing 2D game features a player character kicking and punching Santa's elves through a variety of winter backdrops with a singular goal, to hit the target object and advance to the next level.
row.short_description: Punch and kick Santa's elves through a winter themed backdrop with relaxing Christmas music.

row.name: Grabbers in the Woods
row.detailed_description: A unique first person atmospheric exploration game set in a surreal woods nestled within the confines of a bizarre dream known as the Collective Reverie, a nexus of all dreamers where their individual hopes and fears coalesce into a bizarre nightmare. In this eerie landscape, you're not just a visitor but a catalyst for change. Your interactions—whether with the ethereal phantoms, the inexplicable creatures, or horrors that defy the limits of human comprehension—will shape the world around you. Each choice you make reveals a new path, offering a glimmer of hope to escape the nightmarish reality or, alternatively, seducing you further into the unfathomable depths of darkness. The world of your dream is an ever-shifting maze, generated anew with each step you take. The environment and its inhabitants respond dynamically to your actions, making every journey unique. The items you choose to interact with determine the creatures and challenges that will emerge, crafting a personalized tale of terror and wonder. Hidden within this dream are nine distinct endings, each a conclusion to the story you weave with your choices. These endings range from finding a way to break free from the grip of the nightmare, to surrendering to its sinister allure and plunging deeper into the abyss. Uncovering these conclusions requires keen observation, puzzle-solving prowess, and the courage to face the unknown. Discover the secrets hidden in plain sight, solve obscure puzzles that challenge your understanding, and decipher cryptic messages that hint at a deeper mystery. Your journey through the surreal woods is a quest for truth, a search for answers in a place where questions multiply with every whispered wind. Will you find your way out, or will you become a permanent resident of the dream?
row.short_description: A unique first person atmospheric exploration game set in a surreal woods nestled within the confines of a bizarre dream known as the Collective Reverie, a nexus of all dreamers where their individual hopes and fears coalesce into a bizarre nightmare.
