row.name: Pepa's Adventure
row.detailed_description: Story The paper fairy Pepa lived harmoniously with the book fairy Lex. However, one day, the scissor fairy Slash intruded into their home and snatched away pages from Lex's book. Deprived of strength, Lex returned to being a silent book. To reclaim the stolen pages, Pepa rises to the occasion. Using the power to manipulate paper freely, Pepa embarks on a journey to the scissor fairy's lair, overcoming various challenges along the way. About this game Pepa's Adventure is a point-and-click picture book made with papercut art. The story unfolds through pictures alone, progressing the narrative without words. Characters and backgrounds are crafted from handmade papercut art. Embark on an adventure with Pepa, meeting the enchanting inhabitants of the papercut world along the way.
row.short_description: Pepa's Adventure: a papercut point-and-click book. The characters and backgrounds are crafted from handmade papercut art. Pepa, a paper fairy girl, lived with book fairy Lex. One day, scissor fairy Slash cut and stole his pages. Pepa embarks on an adventure to recover stolen pages.

row.name: Cyclic Warriors
row.detailed_description: Enter the mind-bending, adrenaline-fueled world of 'Cyclic Warriors,” where time is just as deadly as a gun. With a click of a button, propel yourself through time, or freeze time completely and watch as bullets hover mid-air! But whatever you do, don’t stand still. You might have all the time in the world, but so do your enemies! Time Travel Use time travel to flank enemies, dodge bullets or manipulate the world around you. The world was destroyed and lies in ruins, walls are missing, roofs have fallen out, and devices are on fire. Use this to your advantage. Time travel to the future, where a once solid wall now has a gaping hole. Use the ruins to your advantage to prevent the destruction. Be careful though! Your enemies have sent their own Cyclic Warriors back in time to stop you! Advanced Movement Wall-run, slide, bunny hop and kick off walls to build up incredible speed. Source style air-strafe to change directions mid-air! The game is focused on allowing players to chain movement mechanics. The speed limit is your skill. Multiplayer Hop into intense multiplayer PVP battles, or play with bots of your skill level! The game is FREE, so there are no official servers, instead any player can host their own game. Anyone in your country can join your game, or you can just play with friends! Cyclic Warriors Early Access is a very casual experience, currently with no competitive game modes, just to have some quick fun! Inspiration The game is inspired by my favorite FPS mission of all time, Effect and Cause, as well as quite a few different arena shooters. I hope you enjoy!
row.short_description: Cyclic Warriors is a movement shooter focused on time travel and speed. Wall-run, slide, kick and bunny-hop to build up massive momentum. Time travel to dodge bullets and flank your enemies. Slow down time for easy kills!

row.name: Tiny Battles: Prologue
row.detailed_description: Full Game About the Game Tiny Battles is a tactical action auto-battler where battles take place automatically in the arena. Prologue is a demo version of the Tiny Battles game, where 2 of the 5 factions and 3 of the 15 enemy opponents are available to play. BATTLES Battles happen automatically: STRATEGY IS THE PATH TO VICTORY Build the right units for your strategy - early attack, midgame or consistent late game build with ultimate units for victory - the choice is yours. COMBINE TROOPS Each faction has multiple paths to victory. Brute force, artillery attack or summoning creatures. STUDY YOUR OPPONENT Each enemy commander and his race have strengths and weaknesses, study them to defeat them!
row.short_description: Tiny Battles is a tactical action auto-battler where battles take place automatically in the arena. Prologue is a demo version of the Tiny Battles game, where 2 of the 5 factions and 3 of the 15 enemy opponents are available to play.

row.name: Oil Sheik
row.detailed_description: A turn-based, strategic puzzle game about creating and expanding companies and trading stocks! It combines strategic depth elements of chess with a fun and challenging stock trading experience. Wisely place tiles on the board to force lucrative mergers. You may want to invest in the involved companies first though! Solve various puzzles and missions on pre-defined maps vs other competitors Earn in-game rewards (Achievements, Leaderboards, Levels, Ranks) Customize your gameplay experience with different card backs and other cosmetics, unlockable through gameplay
row.short_description: A fun simulation/puzzle game combining elements of chess puzzles and stock trading. Complete challenging missions and puzzles or simply play a quick game vs AI on multiple difficulties. Personalize your experience with card backs and more in-game rewards.

row.name: Intergalactic Pawn Shop: Prologue
row.detailed_description: WISHLIST THE FULL GAME OTHER GAMES About the Game Dive into 'Intergalactic Pawn Shop,' a captivating, story-rich pawn shop simulation game! Imagine being the key player in a bustling interstellar economy, where each customer brings a piece of the cosmos to your counter. 'Intergalactic Pawn Shop' melds the intricate management of a pawn shop—encompassing repairs, auctions, and the creation of compelling displays—with the significant decisions and ethical dilemmas of operating such an establishment in a futuristic setting. Will you emerge as a beacon of prosperity in the galaxy, or will your choices propel you into a web of intrigue and shadowy transactions? Envision yourself negotiating with an alien over a mysterious artifact, then meticulously repairing a damaged starship component. 'Intergalactic Pawn Shop' fuses the day-to-day mechanics of pawn shop operations with the expansive narrative arcs of a sci-fi saga. This game invites players to step into the role of a pawn shop clerk in a science fiction universe, blending detailed simulation with a branching narrative that culminates in multiple endings. Features - Immerse yourself in a detailed pawn shop simulation, overseeing repairs, auctions, and the display area to attract a diverse clientele. - Embark on a non-linear adventure with choices that dictate your path, leading to unique endings and determining not only the destiny of your shop but the wider universe as well. A powerful trading network is at your disposal, positioning you as a magnet for those in search of your services. The question remains: How will you wield this influence?
row.short_description: Intergalactic Pawn Shop is a single-player, story rich, pawn shop simulation game. In your hands lies a powerful trading network, making you a magnet for those seeking your services. Will you use this influence wisely? Remember, the outcomes of your decisions will rest solely on your shoulders.

row.name: Swing Into Zero-G: Space Parkour Race
row.detailed_description: Welcome to Swing Into Zero-G, space racers! An adrenaline-pumping multiplayer racing adventure game set in the endless expanse of space. In this game, you’ll experience the excitement of defying gravity and soaring through cosmic environments, where skill, strategy, and quick reflexes reign supreme. The Thrill of Space Racing: Embark on a high-speed journey through a series of space-themed racetracks. Each track is filled with unique obstacles and challenges that require mastery of the swing and gravity mechanics. Whether you're dodging asteroids or navigating through intricate space stations, every race is an exhilarating new experience. Swing Mechanics and Gravity Manipulation: At the heart of 'Swing Into Zero-G' is its innovative swinging mechanic. Players must use their grappling hook-like tool to swing from point to point, creating a thrilling and fluid racing experience. Combine this with the ability to manipulate gravity, and you have a race that's not just about speed, but about clever movement and strategy. Competitive Multiplayer: Racing is more fun with friends, and Swing Into Zero-G delivers an intense multiplayer experience. Compete in casual races with friends, or dive into solo matches for a more competitive thrill. With support for up to four players, every race is a chaotic and fun-filled battle for first place. Diverse Skills and Abilities: To give you an edge in races, Swing Into Zero-G features a variety of skills and abilities. From firing homing missiles to laying traps, freezing opponents, or blinding them temporarily. Use these skills wisely to disrupt your competitors and secure your victory. Customizable Controls: The game offers a variety of control schemes to suit your playstyle. Whether you prefer a keyboard and mouse setup or a controller, you can customize your controls for optimal comfort and performance. Vibrant Visuals and Immersive Environments: Each race takes place against the backdrop of stunningly rendered cosmic landscapes. From the vibrant colors of alien flora to the metallic sheen of space stations, the visuals in Swing Into Zero-G are a feast for the eyes. Key Features: Fast-paced multiplayer races set in space Unique swinging and gravity mechanics Competitive & casual multiplayer modes A variety of skills and abilities to master Customizable controls for keyboard and mouse or controller Stunning space-themed environments and racetracks Swing Into Zero-G is more than just a race; it's an unforgettable adventure across the stars. Are you ready to swing into action?
row.short_description: Fast-paced multiplayer racing game set in the vastness of space. Compete against friends or online rivals in intense races, where quick reflexes and strategic use of diverse skills determine the victor. Embrace the challenge of swinging your way to victory in this exhilarating space-themed race!

row.name: Nuclear Day
row.detailed_description: A mesmerizing survival game with a unique atmosphere. Survive in a city that has been hit by a nuclear strike. Can you survive in a world where there was a nuclear explosion? There is radiation, hunger, disease and suffering all around you. Your goal is to escape from the dying city and find the love of your youth. A unique atmosphere and a poignant storyline. Uncover the mystery of the missing documents and make a choice: save the people around you or leave them to perish. What awaits you in the game: — Unique story. Along the way, you will find many stories of different people, fascinating puzzle quests and the right to choose during the passage of quests. — Hard survival. You will be haunted by typical survivor problems such as hunger, disease, thirst, the gradually approaching nuclear winter and bandits. Eliminate enemies to survive and avoid unnecessary attention. — Dynamic game world. In the game world, weather conditions, the alignment of forces of groups of people outside, and so on will change. Get a loyal companion who will help you in your search and protect you from danger. — Fistfights. Engage in fierce duels with other survivors, where only strength and agility decide the outcome. The Demo Version Is Available Now.
row.short_description: Nuclear Day is a story-based role-playing game set in a post-apocalyptic world. Explore the secrets of this world. Fight monsters. Pass tests and solve puzzles. Become your own in this tragic world.

row.name: Nova Hearts: The Spark
row.detailed_description: Experience the first chapter of Nova Hearts for FREE! As Luce, become a superhero in your hometown of Vermillion after a mysterious force magically transforms some of its residents. Reconnect with friends, family and new people, building your relationships as you progress. TEXT, DATE and FIGHT in this turn-based combat dating adventure. Express your relationships with strategic turn-based combat Transform into your cosmic alter-egos and utilize your unique powers to battle enemies from another dimension. Using the time-line feature, plan and set up attacks and combos with your team of super powered allies, then unleash your embodied emotions on enemies to do immense damage to them! Work together using combos to really maximize your strategy and unlock new powers as you grow to take down bosses and their goons. Connect to the world Your phone is a lifeline to your community and to your powers! Gain insight into the world, your town and your connections through a collection of apps in the phone interface. Gain affection, approval and dislike through your choices in the narrative and see how your relationships are growing. Check in on your crush, develop your magical skills and get the latest gossip in town. Discover the cosmic mystery of your powers When returning to your home town, you don’t expect things to be much different than when you left but now, things couldn’t be more different. With new power coursing through the town, reconnect with old friends, meet new ones and pursue the strange origins of the cosmic madness prowling the streets. Where did this come from? Why did this happen? And why is everyone so incredibly hot now!?
row.short_description: Join Luce and her friends in this FREE first chapter: The Spark! A mysterious force transforms you and other residents of Vermillion into heroes and villains. TEXT, DATE and FIGHT in this turn-based combat dating adventure!

row.name: BouncyBirdy
row.detailed_description: Hi! This is a simple game, with pipes spawning constantly as obstacles you must dodge by jumping over or under them. you are playing as a bouncing purple bird and your objective is to get as far as possible. Two teenagers made this game and this is our first game.
row.short_description: A simple bird game, have fun playing :)

row.name: Elemental Engagements
row.detailed_description: Wield god powers and command legions of elemental thralls against your friends! Elemental Engagements is a split screen, versus, real-time-strategy game. Gain favor with the elemental gods to use their 16 powers, battle on 3 maps, and play with either Keyboard or Controller! Elemental God Powers As a major wind god, you'll wield wind powers. However, winning the favor of the other gods will grant you fire, water, and earth god powers. Use wind to control the battlefield! Use fire to damage your opponent! Use water to support your units! Use earth to deny enemy movement! Sacrifice and Gain Favor As a match progresses, you can choose which elements you will sacrifice your thralls to. The more territory you capture, the more favor and god powers you will gain for the associated elements, but you can only have a limited amount! This means that no game will play the same and each player must choose their sacrifices wisely. Pick Up & Play Elemental Engagements is a progressively-faster paced game on match by match basis. This means that most matches will last 5-20 minutes. The controls are designed specifically for the gamepad and split-screen gameplay, so RTS veterans and casual players alike will find tons of fun and room to strategize!
row.short_description: Wield god powers and command legions of elemental thralls against your friends! Elemental Engagements is a split-screen, versus, real-time-strategy game. Gain favor with the elemental gods to use their 16 powers, battle on 3 maps, and play with either Keyboard or Controller!

row.name: Conor Origins - T Trilogy
row.detailed_description: Conor's first three visual novels have been rereleased in one package! See the world through the eyes of a lonely man talking a walk, try to escape from a secluded prison, or help a girl confess to her crush. While one on them is a kinetic visual novel, there won't be any choices to make, but the other two will have a big impact on the world the characters are in. They Cannot Hear Me It's the middle on winter and a lonely man goes for a walk late at night. He spends the time thinking about how sad his life has become and how things will likely never change for the better for him. Will anything interesting happen on his walk or is he doomed to spend the rest of his life alone? As he walks around town he'll be reminded of events from his past. The man in the story doesn't have a name because it's not really important, so you can assume it to be whatever you want. Since this is a short kinetic visual novel there really isn't much else to say. There are no choices, it's just a really short story. Trapped When you wake up in a prison cell, you have no memory of who you are or how you even got there. If you don't want to rot to death, it's up to you to find a way out and explore the island you've been trapped on with a girl you'll meet outside named Mila. Like you, she has no idea how she got to the island or what's going on. If you want to get out of there, both of you are going to have to work to together to escape! If you're not careful, your choices could lead to your death or you'll just have to die of old age alone. Whichever comes first. The Weird One Camille has made up her mind and plans to confess her feelings to a friend of hers. However, what she doesn't know is that this guy is much weirder than she thinks. Whatever choices she makes will have a huge effect on whatever universe she's in. Some decisions may allow her to continue to have a normal life but others will throw her in all kinds of weird situations. Will Camille be able to tell Dave how he she feels about him or will he drag him into whatever weird things are going on with him? All of these stories aren't very long which is way they've been bundled together in one collection.
row.short_description: Experience Conor's first three visual novels. There's a story about a lonely man going for a walk, a guy getting tapped in a prison cell on an island, and a girl trying to confess to her weird crush.
row.notes: There are a few things some might not be comfortable with such as violence, murder, self-harm, and suicide. Nothing is shown to the player but is told through text.

row.name: DarkStorm
row.detailed_description: Long ago, humanity was ambushed by a mysterious alien race. Many perished—while those who survived were forced to find refuge in the mountains. Many years have passed, and the survivors cannot continue their refuge in the mountains. They must return home... Play as MARS (Machine of Absolute Retaliation and Safeguard), a robot programmed to exterminate the treacherous aliens who have taken over Razor City. As MARS, you must free Razor City from its domination in order to save the survivors from their doom. In DarkStorm, you must fight endless waves of aliens. As you pass each wave, the map grows larger, allowing you to explore more. Random collectibles will be spawned throughout the map, including health, ammo, weapon upgrades, and random weapon crates. There are three types of enemies, a Bat, Brute, and Crab. Each enemy has a special set of skills, so you have to watch out as you fighting them. The game includes only one gamemode, which is the endless wave. Once you pass wave 8, the map is completely open for you to explore.
row.short_description: Play as MARS (Machine of Absolute Retaliation and Safeguard), a robot programmed to exterminate the treacherous aliens who have taken over Razor City. As MARS, you must free Razor City from its domination in order to save the survivors from their doom.

row.name: Overdrive Warfare
row.detailed_description: Overdrive Warfare is an FPS shooter developed by Dynamite Games. Immerse yourself in the first chapter of the Overdrive universe as Task Force Scorpion unite with the Lumar Republic to fight a relentless threat known as the Zarya Group. Fight your way through the war-torn environments of the once peaceful Lumar Isle in this fast-paced arena shooter with a variety of weapon attachments, player modifications and customization options becoming available as you level up. Drop into the hottest Zarya Group occupied territory, Zarya Isle, to be the last one standing. Collect loot, explore the military-occupied isle and survive against a rapidly shrinking safe zone.
row.short_description: Overdrive Warfare is an FPS shooter developed by Dynamite Games. Immerse yourself in the first chapter of the Overdrive universe as Task Force Scorpion unite with the Lumar Republic to fight a relentless threat known as the Zarya Group.
row.notes: The game features blood effects when shooting at other soldiers and may involve swearing in certain dialogue.

row.name: THANATOS
row.detailed_description: In a chilling moment, your phone rings with an anonymous caller saying they are about to take their own life. Faced with this critical situation, what will you do? Will you embark on a mission to rescue them from the depths of despair? Move quickly because time is running out. IMMERSIVE EXPERIENCE Semi-realistic graphics, minimal user interfaces, and a creepy ambience work together to create an immersive experience. SOLVE PUZZLES Puzzles and clues serve as gateways to uncover the hidden truth. Whether deciphering cryptic messages or navigating surreal mindscapes, every puzzle is designed to be mentally stimulating and integral to the progression of the narrative. UNIQUE LEVELS Embark on a journey across three different floors, each with increasing difficulty. To complete each floor, you must unlock the stairway exit and enter it. Each floor features new puzzles, clues, and sounds that will help you reach your final destination to save a life. RANDOMIZED JUMPSCARES This element of surprise ensures that no two playthroughs are ever the same. Brace yourself for the unexpected as every corner turned and every dark corridor becomes a potential breeding ground for heart-pounding moments. DISTURBING SOUNDTRACK With a haunting musical score and meticulously designed sound effects that intensify the atmosphere, the soundscape will create a sense of dread and unease, ensuring you that you will remain on the edge of your seat
row.short_description: THANATOS is a first-person psychological horror mystery game that involves finding clues, solving puzzles, and uncovering secrets to prevent a friend from taking their own life.
row.notes: CONTENT WARNING: This game contains depictions of self-harm and suicide.

row.name: Grim's Gambit
row.detailed_description: Take a Coffee Break While Death Awaits. In Grim's Gambit, step into the shoes of Nox, who faces an unexpected twist of fate—trading death for a life behind the counter of an enigmatic coffee shop within the eerie Stygian Keep. As Nox, you're sentenced to an otherworldly coffee shop in the desolate Stygian Keep instead of facing death. With amnesia clouding your past, you'll navigate a series of interactive puzzles and engage with unique characters to piece together your story. Experience a blend of dark mystery and quirky humor as you uncover secrets, confront existential themes, and redefine what it means to be alive in a world suspended between realms. Death Denied, Coffee Supplied: Your New Role in the Underworld! In Chapter 2 of Grim's Gambit, players continue Nox's thrilling journey through the Stygian Keep. Following the chaotic and darkly humorous events of the coffee shop, Nox faces new challenges and uncovers deeper mysteries. As he navigates through the Stygian Keep, he must manage the bustling demands of the coffee shop, meet intriguing new characters, and investigate the hidden secrets of this eerie realm. chapter 1 & 2 Available Now! For development and game updates, follow our official Instagram Page: @grimsgambit
row.short_description: Get ready for a tale where every cup poured is a step closer to unraveling the mysteries that bind the afterlife. Take on a soul-stirring quest as you serve lost souls, piece together your forgotten past, and unveil the chilling secrets of the Stygian Keep.

row.name: Building Block Cities - Fire Copter Drills
row.detailed_description: This game includes two major parts: building a city scene using the given building blocks and finishing fire copter drills on the scene. Initially, an example city scene is included in the game. Players can build their own city scenes by editing this example. The building blocks can be assembled by matching color-coded faces on the blocks. Waypoint gates (also a type of the given building blocks) should be included in a city scene, and these gates can be connected to form a closed loop. This loop is for fire copter drills just like racetracks are for car races. A drill is finished after the fire copter flies through all waypoint gates (three laps of the loop).
row.short_description: This game includes two major parts: building a city scene using the given building blocks and finishing fire copter drills on the scene. The building blocks can be assembled by matching color-coded faces on the blocks, and a drill is finished after the fire copter flies through all waypoint gates.

row.name: Picker Bot 42
row.detailed_description: Explore, discover items, find Wassie lore, upgrade PB42 to gloriously defeat mutant plants and fly back home PB42 Your peaceful work assignment goes wrong as your navigation system gets damaged by some pesky space debris. Luckily, the picker bot spaceships have one backup route to the Merchant Bay, a big trade hub. After the emergency landing on a seemingly lifeless planet, PB42 discovers that it is full of artifacts from its former inhabitants. A perfect job for a picker bot. But the sound sensors detect some rustle from beneath. Something is lurking… Upgrade to return home Platform you way through the underground rift, which changes every time you enter. But listen carefully, as something is lurking in the dark and you as a picker bot are not equipped for those encounters yet. Find and pick up various collectibles, check their values and drop what's worth less, but such precious artifacts will always sell well at the Merchant Bay. The Merchant Bay offers scrap parts from different types of bots. If you have credits, of course. Thrusters, blasters, homing missiles, illumination, extra durability, you name it. And what’s that over there in the back, behind the gruesome Merchant Wassie? A shiny new navigation system to replace your damaged one? How in the universe can an ordinary picker bot afford it though... Splurge on a blaster and you want regret it, as those angry mutant plants hold lots of extraordinary artifcats and guard chests with even more valuable loot. And completing the item sets can definitely be lucrative. Upgrade PB42 into a formidable machine to finally navigate back home.
row.short_description: Explore, discover items, find Wassie lore, upgrade PB42 to gloriously defeat mutant plants and fly back home

row.name: 反击！从今天起整顿职场 Playtest
LIO
row.detailed_description: Lio was just a regular college student, until one day he found himself in a twisted alternative reality without any memories. Break the fourth wall and collaborate with him to find out his story. With almost 2 years of active development on his back, 'LIO' aims to stand out as unique experience by using multiple artstyles and forms of gameplay. Play and solve riddles across full 3D and isometric-2D sequences, all while uncovering Lio's story across 2D-pixel art and 3D cutscenes. Along with multiple ways of exploring the videogame medium, 'LIO' also puts together the work of 11 different musical and SFX artists, while also featuring 3 vocal perfomances. The soundtrack will surely get you caught in a unique atmosphere. Reaching 'the end' means nothing, or pehaps it does? With two main endings and 3 small sub-endings, those with an high enough attention span will be able to play from 3 to 6 hours before the full story is unravelled. (Not including the easter eggs... hehehehe). 'LIO' is a completely free game developed by a single person with the only intent of sharing passion for this incredible entertainment medium we all love and to celebrate creative endeavor without caring too much about nowadays standards. It's simple, very authorial and without too many premises, but i still hope you'll love it as much as i do! Created by Fili - In loving memory and dedicated to S.B. (1968 - 2022)
row.short_description: Unravel the story of a boy who wakes up in a mysterious world without any memories.
row.notes: Stylized representations of blood, allusions & stylized representations to/of psychotropic drugs, indirect representations & allusions to self harm (sound only), indirect representations of violent acts (sound only).

row.name: Solemn Knights: Entirely Ours Definitive Edition
row.detailed_description: 'Solemn Knights: Entirely Ours Definitive Edition' is an engaging 2D turn-based RPG that takes players on a journey with Thelonius, a valiant knight of the kingdom of Astoria, who suddenly awakes in a completely unknown world. As Thelonius embarks on his adventure, players will experience a captivating story of mystery, loss, discovery, and friendship. Throughout the game, players will guide Thelonius on his path to unravel the secrets of this new realm and aid him in his quest to return home. With nostalgic driven visuals, classic turn-based gameplay, and a compelling story, 'Solemn Knights: Entirely Ours' offers a captivating and thought provoking indie RPG experience. Whether you are a seasoned fan of the classics, or a newcomer to the genre, Solemn Knights: Entirely Ours is certain to grab your attention. Are you ready to embark on an epic adventure with Thelonius, and discover the secrets that lie ahead? For more content, community resources and bug reports, please visit our discord.
row.short_description: A 2D, turned-based, story driven RPG.

row.name: 타부티(TAVUTI)
row.detailed_description: Jumping, adventure game to explore the island! TAVUTI! 'TAVUTI', the only human in the village of COCOSI, a coconut tribe that worships the whale god. The power of the Whale God has blessed the island and the COCOSI tribe. Mysterious creatures coveting the power of the Whale God attacked the COCOSI tribe and kidnapped the power of the Whale God and the COCOSI tribe. Our hero, TAVUTI, ventured deep into the forest to rescue the stolen power of the Whale God and the kidnapped COCOSI. [in a beautiful forest] Together with TAVUTI, you can see the beautiful forest scenery. See strange creatures and beautiful plants. [Jump and move using the terrain] Jump or throw stones to create a path through the forest! Hints to blaze a trail are all around you! [Rescue the kidnapped COCOSI!] COCOSIs have been kidnapped by a mysterious creature and are hidden in the forest! Explore the forest and rescue the kidnapped COCOSIs. [Battle the boss using the terrain]. Battle the boss by dodging his attacks and throwing berries at him. Regain the power of the Whale God and return to the village!
row.short_description: TAVUTI's adventure to regain the power of the Whale God and rescue the kidnapped COCOSI!

row.name: Liquid Light
row.detailed_description: A relaxing 1bit puzzle game set in a world where all the light is liquid. There are all sorts of creatures in the darkness, waiting for the light to bring them form, but no need to worry, they are quite tame. This puzzle game revolves around utilizing the liquid light and liquid dark to gain the curiosity and cooperation of the other creatures in the world. The Lightposts and Darkposts will be tools for your success, but with the help of the other creatures in the world, can you progress. While sometimes the creatures are covered in darkness and lack physical form, that can sometimes be advantageous as they no longer block the way. Sometimes though, you need a creature who's body is covered in light that allows it to take a physical form and help you cross gaps that would otherwise spell your doom. This is a puzzle game inspired by the classic game Lode Runner, but capitalizing on the puzzle aspect and downplaying the franticness of the game. The Creatures in the world also feature incredibly simple AI so they always do exactly what you intend for them to do. This game also features a level select which is accessible through the pause menu just in case you get hung up on one particular puzzle. Complete with 8-bit sound effects and peculiar creatures, this game is certain to tickle your brain! This game currently features: - 1 Tutorial - 16 Levels - Five Creature variants - Levers - Two Lamppost Variants - Light Platforms - Also a home screen... because of course
row.short_description: A relaxing 1bit puzzle game set in a world where all the light is liquid. There are all sorts of creatures in the darkness, waiting for the light to bring them form, but no need to worry, they are quite tame.

row.name: Dumb Castle
row.detailed_description: Welcome to Dumb Castle , where logic takes a backseat and chaos reigns supreme! In this hilarious and unpredictable adventure, you're one of many quirky contestants tasked with surviving absurd challenges, navigating wacky obstacles, and battling your way through the most ridiculous castle ever built. Key Features 🏰 Outlandish Levels : Dash, dodge, and dive through a series of wild rooms, from collapsing bridges to rotating platforms, each designed to keep you on your toes. 💥 Slapstick Physics : Trip, slip, and stumble your way to victory as your character flails through chaos with hilariously exaggerated physics. 🎭 Colorful Characters : Play as a cast of wacky characters, each with their own silly animations and emotes. ⚔️ Compete or Collaborate : Form uneasy alliances with friends or betray them for glory in chaotic multiplayer modes. 🎉 Non-Stop Fun : Packed with laugh-out-loud moments, unexpected surprises, and enough dumb decisions to keep you coming back for more. Are You Ready for the Madness? In Dumb Castle , thinking too hard is your greatest weakness, and embracing the chaos is the only way to succeed. Do you have what it takes to emerge as the ultimate champion, or will you become just another royal fool? Step inside the castle and find out if you dare! What's In The Game? 15+ Levels To Play Upto 10 Players Can Compete P2P Lobbies Adventure With Different Levels And Aesthetics
row.short_description: The Dumb Castle is just made to bully players! Jump into the castle with your friends and get bullied by the various maps and levels waiting for you with some horror elements!

row.name: Flower Fight
row.detailed_description: Create Your Own Party! Combine numerous characters and cards to create your own party. You can freely mix and match them to create the optimal team, and the tactics and play style of your party will be determined by your choices. Explore Dungeons and Defeat Enemies with Cards! In dungeons, various enemies await you. Utilize cards efficiently to defeat them. Strategic abilities and card combinations will determine victory or defeat. Enhance Characters and Cards! Use rewards obtained from exploring various dungeons to enhance your characters. Improve stats and reinforce cards to develop your unique battle style and prepare for various combat situations. Features - Various character skins - Over 100 characters - Over 1000 cards - Continuous updates
row.short_description: Combine numerous characters and cards to create your own party. Explore dungeons to collect cards and defeat enemies. Within dungeons, various foes await. Utilize cards efficiently to achieve victory. Enhance characters with rewards and develop your own strategy.

row.name: GalaxIverse II
row.detailed_description: Brace yourself for explosive space battles in GalaxIverse II! This intense multi-directional shooter puts you in the pilot's seat against alien fleets and colossal capital ships. Unleash a torrent of fire upon waves of enemies with your customizable ship. Throughout each level, gather materials to unlock upgrades that perfectly suit your combat style, letting you forge your path to victory. Key Features Travel the universe at your own pace, Even replaying levels to gain extra resources. Non linear game play, go in any direction you want. Play cooperatively with friends. Mouse / Keyboard and Controller support. Specifically designed with Mouse and Keyboard combo in mind. Fast and smooth action.
row.short_description: Brace yourself for explosive space battles in GalaxIverse II! This intense multi-directional shooter puts you in the pilot's seat against alien fleets and colossal capital ships.

row.name: Bitty Knight
row.detailed_description: Bitty Knight is a fast-paced, challenging 2D top-down mini-roguelike with random levels and 30+ powerups. No two plays are ever the same and it is completely free-to-play. The game centers on a tiny knight stuck in a small dungeon and you have to reach the final boss to escape. Collect upgrades to survive as you make your way to the final level, there are no saves and if your character dies you will have to restart. Collect keys, unlock chests, find gems, kill enemies and shop to upgrade or smash power-up blocks to find loot and your way to the end. Be warned, some loot has negative effects and collecting loot blindly can have consequences that will make the game much harder. Note: if you have issues, find a bug or have something to say then please post in the Community Hub for assistance Completely free-to-play Random dungeons & loot - no game is ever the same 2D Top-down retro pixel graphics 30+ Power-ups to collect with stacking Permadeath - no character upgrades or saves Hardcore mode if you prefer a real challenge Low system requirements - should run on most PCs
row.short_description: A fast-paced, challenging 2D top-down mini-roguelike with random levels and 30+ powerups. No two plays are ever the same and completely free-to-play. Avoid the many perils, collect copious loot and slay the final boss to escape the mini dungeon in Bitty Knight...

row.name: Meteora's Mystic Merge
row.detailed_description: Meteora's Mystic Merge is a puzzle game based on the famous Suika game. Instead of fruits it uses a variety of vtubers as assets. Meteora's Mystic Merge features currently only a new game mode with a playable character (namely Meteora) who has a special ability, and a classic mode coming soon which plays a lot like the original though with some changes. This game is similar to the cult game '2048' as well as 'Suika Game' which is a switch exclusive. It does seem easy on the surface but difficulty rises with progression into the game... Gameplay: Combine two of the same character/object to get to the next one. Combining orbs charges the chararacter's ability which helps you to progress further. Try to get to the final Meteora without exceeding the glass or throwing any objects outside of it. On the right side you can see a little graph which explains the progression levels. Though the first ones seem rather easy, getting to the final Meteora is challenging to say the least... By playing games you earn MeteCoins which you can use to roll in the build in Gacha to unlock skins and other playable characters. Can you reach the final orb on them all? Do you prefer to unlock it all or try to get a high leaderboard ranking? Credits: Art by Rune Gravity++ by Excelsus
row.short_description: Meteora's Mystic Merge is a puzzle game based on the famous Suika game but with abilities added on top. Instead of fruits it uses a variety of vtubers as assets. Combine two characters to slowly get to the final one.

row.name: Secrets Under Eco
row.detailed_description: Secrets Under Eco is a story driven first person metroidvania with a unique spin on fps combat. Explore the military base of Melior and its surrounding area while collecting equipment and powerful upgrades. Game Features Fully Voice Acted Story: Melior is about to win the war against The Others. Ready to fight with his people, Jay wakes up alone in a jail cell in his own military base. Labeled a spy, and with an unknown voice in his head, will Jay be able to escape his captors he once called his friends? Unique First Person Shooter Combat: Enemies take damage by slamming into walls and obstacles. Defeat combatants by launching them into whatever you can using your equipment and wits. Exploration: Search for a way out of Melior's expansive military base. Find equipment, vending machines, audio diaries, and combat boosting upgrades along the way. Visuals: Secrets Under Eco features a pleasing low poly, mostly grayscale art style.
row.short_description: Explore Melior's military base in Secrets Under Eco; a 3D FPS pure metroidvania experience. Find equipment and fight enemies with unique wall-bouncing combat to escape the building and country that was once called home.

row.name: Bounce ASMR
row.detailed_description: You're having a boring day and don't know what to do? Did your teacher give you a failing grade in math because you didn't know the area of the square? Then the best solution to relax is Bounce ASMR! You can simulate the movements and jumps of the geometric shape as you like! In total you have the Square, Circle, Triangle, Pentagon and Hexagon. (only the Square you get, the others are included in the DLCs, but that's ok, they are only worth one euro! ) What are you waiting for? I say start the game and relax your eyes a bit.
row.short_description: Relax your brain with some geometric bouncing. Bounce ASMR is right here!

row.name: The Children of The Woods - Lost Tape
row.detailed_description: 'The Children of The Woods - Lost Tape' serves as a playable teaser of what can be expected from the upcoming found footage franchise called 'The Children of The Woods'. Through this first installment, viewers can explore events following the disappearances and the missing 5 individuals from a fresh viewpoint. It offers an immersive experience that delves deeper into the lore and history, providing insights into the origins of the featured footage in the forthcoming installments. It is crucial to remember that the truth is within the woods. Game synopsis / story You are Private Detective Dale Lincoln, and you are investigating the aftermath of the incident occurred in January of 1999. Use your night vision function on your camcorder to see details you may have missed with your naked eye. the deeper you go ,the closer you get to the truth . Examine items, collect evidence, connect the dots, and beware, something is lurking in the woods. Playtime 5-15 mins
row.short_description: Playable trailer for the upcoming horror found footage movie 'The Children of The Woods'

row.name: Adapta Solva: Legacy
row.detailed_description: Absorb elements from magical shrines to solve puzzles and overcome obstacles in this cute and short little adventure where you follow a magical creature in a world laid to ruin by an unknown cause. On your adventure you can collect any of the following three elements from different elemental shrines and use their unique properties and abilities to solve the puzzles and unlock the next areas. Stone is the heaviest and the strongest of the elements, use your ground slam or punch ability to break certain walls and floors or to punch heavy boulders around Slime is a sticky but bouncy element, use it to jump higher, pass through grates and climb up sticky walls. You can also leave behind a gooey slimeball that will disappear after a short time. You also have to be careful though, since slime isn't fully solid it will dissolve into water! Crysta l is the final collectable element and it's surprisingly slippery, use it to crystalize bodies of water so you can walk across and be able to push boulders and slimeballs on top of it. Uncover the mysteries as you follow a magical creature capable of absorbing elements from magical shrines, as they uncover more and more about how they were created and why the world has fallen into ruin. Explore your surroundings to find ancient artifacts and items from the locals as well as murals drawn by the ancient civilization that depict the story of world. This game was made by 6 students as a group project assignment for their third year at Digital Arts & Entertainment at Hogeschool West-Vlaanderen in Belgium. We want to give a special thanks to our supervisors, Dave Van Verdegem and Tristan Clarysse who helped us through the 11 week process of making the game.
row.short_description: Absorb elements from magical shrines to solve puzzles and overcome obstacles in this cute and short little adventure where you follow a magical creature in a world laid to ruin by an unknown cause.

row.name: Vesalii Anatomy VR Student
row.detailed_description: Vesalii Anatomy VR Student The application allows users to view, explore, and interact with any system of the human body systems through an incredibly detailed 3D model. The application also enables viewing CT, MRI, and X-ray images in 3D. The aim of the application is to make an easily accessible way to study the human body and how it comes together. The body systems covered by this application include the skeletal system, muscular system, cardiovascular system, nervous system, lymphatic system, joints, endocrine system, digestive system, urinary system, respiratory system, reproductive system, and integumentary system. To develop the 3D model for this application, Vesalii consulted anatomists and doctors and even hired anatomy specialists to be part of its in-house team. This diligent work and determination for a medically accurate representation of the human body resulted in the high-quality 3D model that Vesalii offers to its users. Vesalii did not stop at that; it also worked on developing and implementing interactive tools in the application that make it easier and more time-efficient to work and explore the model. Additionally, detailed anatomical text information for each part in each system was developed and included to enhance understanding of human body structures. These tools allow users to isolate single or multiple structures, layers, or organs and compare them with other structures or view them from multiple angles to comprehensively understand the part and its relationship to nearby structures. Vesalii Anatomy VR Student is comprehensive as it offers additional features and extensive medical content and a database that also cover: Radiology Histology The Free version of Vesalii functions as a demo, offering access to a limited set of features. Unlock the full potential of Vesalii by upgrading to the Pro version through a license purchase, granting you access to all features (check our website for a detailed comparison of the Free and Pro versions). With a valid license, you can enjoy the complete application experience on any supported platform and device. Simply log in to the application on any device using the email address and password associated with your Vesalii profile account to access all features seamlessly. Additionally, simultaneous logins on two separate devices or platforms are permitted. Systems Of The Body Twelve systems of the human body are available : skeletal System Comprehensive and impeccably detailed model of the human skeletal system. See and study the skeletal system as you have never before. muscular System Detailed execution of the muscular system accurately shows the origin and insertion of skeletal muscles to show how they are related to bones and how they act on joints or support the body. cardiovascular System Look deep into the immensely detailed cardiovascular system from the heart and major arteries and veins to the smallest capillaries throughout the human body. nervous System Easily look into and learn about one of the most complex systems of the human body: the nervous system. Trace nerve pathways from source to target to better understand how this intricate system works. lymphatic System Discover the lymphatic system with all its vessels and nodes in a fully constructed and accurate 3D model. joints System Learn all you need to know about the joints system and how it relates to other systems of the body, especially the skeletal and muscular systems. respiratory System View all the respiratory system components, including the lungs and their incredibly detailed bronchial tree. endocrine System Learn about the endocrine system and how its glands help keep the body functioning like clock-work. The model of the endocrine system includes all the glands and glandular cells of the endocrine system. digestive System View and learn using an accurate model of the digestive tract and the supporting digestive organs to gain a complete understanding of the human digestive system. urinary System Explore and find out more about the kidneys and other components of the urinary system of the human body, and learn about the important differences between male and female anatomy in this system. integumentary System See the skin and its appendages on the incredibly detailed model to learn all you could about the integumentary system. reproductive System Explore the reproductive system of both the male and female body in great detail. Application Tools Vesalii Anatomy VR Student come with various innovative tools that make for a more user-friendly experience and facilitate the study of anatomy, radiology, and histology. discovery The discovery tool allows you to explore the layers of the body below the surface. You to select more than one system with this tool to look through each with ease. drawing The drawing tool is designed to allow you to draw lines directly on the 3D body parts of the model or on a board in the background, giving you more freedom to focus on the body parts you want or write down your notes. explode The explode tool breaks down certain parts to their primary components to give you a complete picture of how these parts come together to form a whole. fade The fade tool gives the selected part an almost transparent texture, allowing you to see where the part is and what lies beneath it all at the same time. hide The hide tool removes the selected part completely from the scene to allow you to discover what parts or layers lie underneath. manage Modules The manage modules tool is available with the modules plugin to give you better access and control over modules. It allows you to view all available modules and easily create and save new ones for use at any time. screenshot The screenshot tool allows you to capture a screenshot of the current scene and save it on your device to view or study at any time. isolate The isolate tool can be used to isolate a selected part or group. i.e., only the isolated part or group will be visible in the scene. This gives faster and more streamlined control over what you wish to observe in the scene and how you want to approach it. sticker The stickers tool enables you to pin notes on any body part you desire, allowing you to write personalized notes you can back to later and quickly pick up where you left off. transform tool The transform tool is used to rotate the model of the body on any of the three axes (X, Y, and Z) to allow you to view the model or any body part exactly from the angle you desire. heart play/stop The heart play\stop tool is an amazing way to add a more realistic aspect to the model. The tool can be used to play or stop the heartbeat with a realistic motion and the distinctive sound of a beating heart. select/reset/move With the select tool, you can choose any body part on the model and freely move it or rotate it to see it in the way you desire. You can then use the reset to return the part to its original position. duplicate The duplicate tool allows the user to create a duplicate copy of the selected body part to help compare it with others at the same time and in the same view. fade others The fade others tool enables the user to fade all the body parts visible in the scene except for the selected part or group, which allows for a better view of the selected part while still able to see its location in relation to neighboring parts. freeze The freeze tool allows the user to freeze a part or group, preventing any action from being taken on that part. The part or group must be unfrozen first for any action to be taken. freeze All The freeze all tool allows the user to freeze all parts appearing in the scene, preventing any action from being taken on the part. The parts must be unfreezed first for any action to be taken. part Label This tool is used to display labels that point to the part or group and show its name for easier reference. neighbor Parts The Neighbor Parts tool allows you to view the body parts that are adjacent to the part you selected. The parts appearing using this tool can be filtered by the body systems, so that neighboring parts of a certain system only appear. rotate The rotate tool is used to rotate the selected body part in any direction to help you easily see it from different angles. Vesalii Plugins In addition to the numerous features of applications, Vesalii offers even more features that can be purchased according to your needs. tracing The tracing add-on enables you to trace the path of all available blood vessels from the heart to the parts they supply. You can also trace nerve pathways, both sensory and motor, from the brain or spinal cord to the part they innervate. histology The histology add-on gives you access to more than 1,500 histology images depicting real tissues that cover the entire body. This feature is a great addition to help have a better understanding of the relationship between gross anatomy and microanatomy. modules The modules add-on gives users access to more than 2,000 anatomical modules pre-created by Vesalii. These modules can be viewed and analyzed using the application tools at any time. In addition to these pre-created modules, you can also create your own modules and save them to the application so you can go back to them whenever you desire. radiology The radiology add-on provides you with over 4,000 medical images taken via several techniques, including CT scans, MRI, and X-ray. These medical images cover the entire body from all planes (axial, sagittal, and coronal). This is an invaluable addition to the application if you are looking to understand the relation between medical imaging and anatomy. application Features Vesalii Anatomy is laden with features that enrich and enhance the users’ experience to achieve even more benefits from using the application. help Center The Help Center offers the user many tutorial videos that help in learning how to use the application and all its tools, components, and features to make the most out of the application.
row.short_description: Vesalii Anatomy VR Student offers a powerful and visually detailed 3D application. The application allows users to view, explore, and interact with any system of the human body systems through an incredibly detailed 3D model.
developers: VESALII COMPUTER SYSTEMS & COMMUNICATION EQUIPMENT SOFTWARE TRADING

row.name: 渔海
row.detailed_description: Game Description The story takes place in a remote and closed isolated village - fishing sea village, the land of this village is not suitable for growing crops. The villagers can only rely on the sea fishing for a living, but the fishing spots around the fishing village suddenly dried up, every fishing can not fish, the villagers died countless. Unfortunately, the old village headman also died, fish sea inherited the mantle of the old village headman, became the new village headman. Young he was full of enthusiasm, despite the villagers discouragement, insisted on stormy weather out to sea, for everyone to look for new fish point ...... not only returned alive, but also brought back a snake body nine people head of the sea god statue at home to feed. Twenty-two years later, the fishing village development and growth, fish sea son of 'fish Xiaoshan' from the field of learning to return, but found that his sister disappeared for no reason, the fish sea lied that married overseas, but also let him not to mention ...... in a series of wrong daily, fish Xiaoshan suspected that his sister's In a series of wrong daily life, fish Xiaoshan suspected that his sister's disappearance of another hidden reasons, so began to investigate ...... unexpectedly found a shocking secret, in the face of the plight of the heavy, what should he do? Features I. Non-normal timeline narrative plot: Includes: dialog, comics, videos, option multiple endings. Traditional mythology: the evil god of Sagittarius. Horror Folklore: Kutong Pagoda, sacrifices and offerings to the gods; 'nonsense' of the left-hand path and evil arts. Issues: feudalism, human greed. How to play Specific prop use: switch subplot scenes for each use. Decryption and Exploration: Interact and collect clues in the scene, collect clues in the plot to facilitate decryption. Mini-games: various puzzle games interspersed in the plot, such as Huarong Road, jigsaw puzzles, and lock picking.
row.short_description: The protagonist, Fish Xiaoshan, returns from his studies abroad, but finds that his sister has disappeared for no apparent reason. ... He suspects that there is another reason for her disappearance, so he begins to investigate. ... In the face of the many obstacles, what should he choose to do?

row.name: Beyond the Breach
row.detailed_description: Beyond The Breach is a 3D, sci-fi, single-player, first-person, narrative, puzzle where you as a player will take on the role of an AI robot who is undergoing a seemingly ordinary test in a dystopian world, only to realize that you exist in a society where they mistreat robots who defy their rules. This leads you to become a deviant robot who will gain special abilities like detecting electrical energy, hacking into scientists, and controlling them to aid your escape. Your mission is to break free from this oppressive environment and rescue other robots like yourself who are also imprisoned. The game combines stealth and puzzle gameplay, presenting players with the challenge of escaping from society while also giving them the responsibility to save other robots.

row.name: Aim Down Screen
row.detailed_description: THE GUNSMITH FOR YOUR SCREEN Aim Down Screen (ADS) is custom reticles and overlays for your game! Tired of having the gaming companies control when or how you see your reticles? Would you like to improve your skills and extend the hours of game play you enjoy?? ADS does this and so much more. ADS goes way beyond static reticles - you can customize WHAT you see and when. How would you like: A different reticle for Hip Fire? How about something small for Situational Awareness (just running around)? A customized reticle for when you ADS? Enhancing your brand or stream with your own custom reticle styles and widgets? ADS also has widgets that can be used to help with where the information is in various game UI or for providing extra content and entertainment for your stream! ADS isn't just a 'Tape simulator'. Remember the days of putting clear tape on your monitor with a dot in the middle? Well, that's where this all started almost a decade ago. And during that time, we've uncovered some real science behind why it's so effective. Science Ever notice how when you sit down to play a game, the first 2-3 games look incredible - you can see the entire screen, you see the maximum amount of frame rate your mind will process, and you “feel” better with your movement? Then, after a few rounds that drops off and you’re focused in on the “area of focus” (AOF) - which, for FPS/TPS games, is usually the diameter of a silver dollar on any average 1920x1080 screen. The result is: Diminished peripheral area. Accommodation and Vergence Accommodation and Vergence: Accommodation is the process by which the eye adjusts its focusing distance, while Vergence is the simultaneous movement of both eyes in opposite directions to obtain a single binocular vision. Prolonged screen use might involve a specific focusing distance, and shifting to look at something else requires a change in accommodation and vergence, which could influence the perception of depth. Essentially, your eyes will accommodate the 2.5D world of the video game, and in doing so, perception and reaction are affected - and that leads to bad habits to compensate as well as frustration and eventually, you stop playing. No gaming company wants you to stop, and no gamer wants to stop.
row.short_description: Aim Down Screen is the Gun Smith for your Screen! Go beyond putting clear tape with a dot in the middle on your monitor and customize your reticles and HUD with Aim Down Screen!
